rows.source: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Masedóníà Zoran Zaev, ìyàwó rẹ̀ Zorica, àti ọmọ rẹ̀ Dushko dibo fún ìdìbò náà ní Masedóníà lórí yíyí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà láti ṣí i lọ sí NATO àti Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù ní Strumica, Masedóníà, ọjọ́ 30, oṣù kẹsàn-án, ọdún 2018.
rows.reference: Adarí Ìgbìmọ Ìjọba ti Masidóníà Zoran Zaev, aya rẹ̀ Zorica àti ọmọdékùnrin rẹ̀ Dushko fi ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí láti dìbò wọn sílẹ̀ fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ ní Masidónía lori yíyí orúkọ orilẹ-ede náà pada eyiti yóò sí ọ̀nà fún un láti darapọ mọ àjọ NATO àti Ẹgbẹ́ Àwọn Orilẹ'ede Yuroopu ní ìlú Strumica, lorilẹ-ede Masidóníà ni ọgbọ̀nọ́jọ́ oṣù Owewe ĺọ̀dún 2018.

rows.source: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.
rows.output: Ni iwaju ile-igbimọ aṣofin ni Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, n mọọmọọ ti n ṣeto ipele kekere kan ati fifi awọn ijoko si iwaju awọn ibudó ti a ṣeto nipasẹ awọn ti yoo kọju si idibo naa.
rows.reference: Níwájú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ àwọn aṣoju-ṣòfin ní ìlú Skopje, Vlamirir Kavardarkov, ẹni ọdún mẹ́rìnléláàádọ́ta, ńgba ìtàgé kékeré kan láradì tí ó sì fa àwọn àga tówà niwaju àwọn àgọ́ tí àwọn ti yóò dẹ́yẹ sí ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà ṣàtòpọ̀ wọn sókè.

rows.source: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.
rows.output: "A jẹ́ fún NATO àti EU, ṣùgbọ́n a fẹ́ darapọ̀ mọ́ wọn pẹ̀lú orí wa sókè, kì í ṣe nípasẹ̀ ẹnu ọ̀nà iṣẹ́" ni Kavadarkov sọ.
rows.reference: ''Àwa wà fún àjọ NATO àti EU, ṣugbọn a fẹ́ darapọ̀ pẹ̀lú orí wa lókè, kìí ṣe nípaṣẹ̀ iṣe ẹnu ọ̀nạ̀́'' Kadarkov ni o so bẹẹ̣́ ̣.

rows.source: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.
rows.output: "A jẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè tí kò ní owó púpọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n a ní ìwà rere."
rows.reference: “Àwá jẹ́ orilẹ-ede tí ò kúùṣẹ́, ṣ̵ùgbọ́n a ní ọ̀wọ̀ ara-ẹni.

rows.source: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."
rows.output: Bí wọn kò bá fẹ́ gba wa gẹ́gẹ́ bí Masedóníà, a lè yí padà sí àwọn mìíràn bíi Ṣáínà àti Rọ́ṣíà, kí a sì di apá kan ìṣọ̀kan Yúróòpù-Áṣíà.
rows.reference: Bí wọn kòbá fẹ́ gbà wá gẹ́gẹ́bí Masidóníà, a leè kọjú sí àwọn ẹlòmíràn bíi orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà àti Rọ́síà kí á sì dí ara ti àjọṣepọ̀ Euro-Asia.

rows.source: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Zaev sọ pé ìjọ̀bà NATO yóò mú owó tí ó pọ̀ sí i wá sí Masedóníà, orílẹ̀-èdè kan tí ìwọ̀n àìníṣẹ́ iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ti ju 20%.
rows.reference: Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Zaev sọpé ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ NATO yóò mú ìdókòòwò tíwọ́n nílò púpọ̀ wọ orilẹ-ede Masidóníà, eyiti tí ó ní òdiwọn àìríṣẹ́ṣe tí o ju ìdá ogún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún lọ.

rows.source: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.
rows.output: "Mo gbagbọ pe ọpọlọpọ julọ yoo ṣe atilẹyin nitori diẹ sii ju 80 ogorun awọn ara ilu wa ni atilẹyin ti EU ati NATO," Zaev sọ lẹhin ti o ti fi ibo rẹ silẹ.
rows.reference: ''Mo gbàgbọ́ wípé àwọn eniyan pupọ̀ yóò fi ojú rere hàn síi nitori àwọn ọmọ ìlú wa tóju ìdá ọgọ́rin ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún lọ ńfi ojú rere hàn sí ti àjọ EU àti NATO,'' Zaev ni o sọ báyií lẹ́yìn tí o ju ìwé amútẹ̀kàsí rẹ̀ sínu àpótí.

rows.source: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."
rows.output: Ó sọ pé “bèèrè” yóò jẹ́ “ìfọwọ́sí ti ọjọ́ iwájú wa.”
rows.reference: Ó sọpé ìbò ''bẹ́ẹ̀ni'' yóò jẹ ''ìjẹ́ríìsí ọjọ́ iwájú wa.”

rows.source: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.
rows.output: Ìdìbò kan tí wọ́n ṣe ní ọjọ́ Aarọ̀ tí ó kọjá ni Ilé-iṣẹ́ Ìwádì Ìlà Oòrùn ti sọ pé láàárín 30 sí 43 ogorun àwọn olùdìbò yóò kópa nínú ìdìbò náà - ní isalẹ ìwọ̀n tí a nílò.
rows.reference: Ìdìbò èrò ara ìlú kan tíwọ́n ṣàgbéjáde rẹ̀ lọ́jọ́ Ajé láti ọwọ́ Àjọ fún Ìwáàdí nípa Ìlàna Ìṣèjọba sọpé láàrin ìdá ọgbọ̀n àti ìdá mẹ́tàlélógójì ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn olùdìbò ni yóò kópa ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà - tí o ́lọ sílẹ̀ ju iye ìjáde-dìbò tíwọ́n nílò lọ.

rows.source: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.
rows.output: Ìdìbò mìíràn tí wọ́n ṣe ní Telma TV ti Orílẹ̀-èdè Macedonia rí pé 57 ogorun àwọn tí wọ́n dáhùn ní wọ́n ń ṣètò láti dìbò ní ọjọ́ Sunday.
rows.reference: Ìdìbò èrò ara ìlú miran, tí ilé iṣẹ́ Amóhùnmáwòrán Telma ṣe, ríi pé ìdá mẹ́tàdínlọ́gọ́ta ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn olùdáhùn ni wọ́n ńgbèrò láti di ìbò náà lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.

rows.source: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.
rows.output: Lára àwọn náà, 70 ogorun sọ pé wọn yóò dibo bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Nínú wọ̀n, ìdá àádọ́rin nínú ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún sọpé àwọn yóò dìbò fún bẹ́ẹ̀ni.

rows.source: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.
rows.output: Láti jẹ́ kí ìdìbò náà ṣeyebíye, ìdá ọgọ́rùn-ún ènìyàn níláti wà ní ìdìbò náà.
rows.reference: Fún ki ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà láti jẹ́ àṣeyọrí ìjáde-dìbò nílò láti jẹ́ ìbò ìdá àádọ́ta ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àti ẹyọ kan.

rows.source: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.
rows.output: Ìdánilójú tí kò dára nínú ìdìbò náà yóò jẹ́ ìdààmú àkọ́kọ́ tó ṣe pàtàkì sí ètò ìṣúná ìjọba tí ó fẹ́ ìwọ̀ oòrùn láti ìgbà tí wọ́n ti gba ìjọba ní May ọdún tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Ìkùnà ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà yóò duro fún àbùkù gbòógì àkọ́kọ́ tí yóò kan ìlànà ìṣèjọba ti ìjọba tó ńṣeti awọn orilẹ-ede Yuroopu ati ilẹ Amẹ́ríkà látígbà tóti gba ìjọba lóṣù Ẹ̀bibi lọ́dún tó kọjá.

rows.source: Watch: Manchester City's Sergio Aguero navigates through entire Brighton defense for goal
rows.output: Watch: Sergio Aguero ti Manchester City n ṣe lilọ kiri nipasẹ gbogbo eto aabo Brighton fun ibọn
rows.reference: Wòran: Sergio Aguero ti Manchester City bóti ńtukọ̀ ara rẹ káàkiri gbogbo àabo Brighton láti gbá ayò wọlé

rows.source: Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling dispatched of the Brighton defense in Manchester City's 2-0 win on Saturday at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England.
rows.output: Sergio Aguero ati Raheem Sterling ti fọ awọn aabo Brighton ni Manchester City's 2-0 win ni Satidee ni Etihad Stadium ni Manchester, England.
rows.reference: Sergio Aguero àti Raheem Sterling rán iṣẹ́ sínú ààbò Brighton ninu bíborí oní 2-0 ti Manchester City lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹta ni Pápá Ìṣeré ti Etihad ní ìlú Manchester, lorilẹ-ede Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

rows.source: Aguero made it look ridiculously easy on his score in the 65th minute.
rows.output: Aguero jẹ ki o dabi irọrun pupọ lori ami rẹ ni iṣẹju 65th.
rows.reference: Aguero jẹ́kí ó dàbí pé ó ti rọrùn ju nípa ayò afiniṣẹ̀ṣín rẹ̀ eyiti ó gbá wọlé ni ìṣẹ́jú karùndínláàdọ́rin náà.

rows.source: The Argentine striker received a pass at midfield at the start of the sequence.
rows.output: Agbá bọ́ọ̀lù Argentina gba ìkólù ní àárín pápá ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àtọkànwá náà.
rows.reference: Agbábọ́ọ̀lùmátàṣé ọmọ ilẹ̀ Ajẹntína gba ìgbásíni kan láàrin gungun orí pápá ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ti ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé náà.

rows.source: He raced between three Brighton defenders, before slashing into the open field.
rows.output: Ó sáré láàárín àwọn olùgbèjà Brighton mẹ́ta, kí ó tó gé sínú pápá tí ó ṣí sílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó sáré láàrin àwọn olùdáààbòbò ilé Brighton mẹ́ta kí ó tó lọ bí abẹ ninu pápá tósí sílẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: Aguero then found himself surrounded by four green shirts.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, Aguerọ́ náà rí ara rẹ̀ tí ó yí ká pẹ̀lú àwọn aṣọ aláwọ̀ ewé mẹ́rin.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà Aguero rí ara níbití àwọn ẹlẹ́wù aláwọ̀ ewé mẹ́rin ti yìí ká.

rows.source: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.
rows.output: Ó fi ọwọ́ kan olùdáàbò bo ara rẹ̀ kí ó tó yára kọjá àwọn olùdáàbò mẹ́ta mìíràn ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ àgbègbè Brighton.
rows.reference: Ó taari yíka olùdáààbòbò kan kí ó tó sáré tayọ àwọn pupọ síi ni etí ̀apoti ìjìyà pẹnariti ti Brighton.

rows.source: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.
rows.output: Ó sì fi bọ́ọ̀lù náà fún ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀, ó sì rí Sterling.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà ó taari ìgbásíni kan sí apá òsì rẹ̀, tósì rí Sterling.

rows.source: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.
rows.output: Olùgbọ́wọ́ náà lo ìfọwọ́kù àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ nínú àgbègbè náà láti fún bọ́ọ̀lù náà padà sí Aguero, ẹni tí ó lo ẹsẹ̀ ọ̀tún rẹ̀ láti lu olùgbọ́wọ́ Brighton Mathew Ryan pẹ̀lú ìkùnsín kan sí ẹ̀gbẹ́ ọ̀tún ti àgbègbè náà.
rows.reference: Onípò-iwájú ọmọ ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì náà ìfẹsẹ̀kàn àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ ninu apoti náà láti dá bọ́ọ̀lù padà sọ́dọ̀ Aguero, ẹniti ó lo bàtà ẹsẹ̀ ọ̀tún rẹ̀ láti ta aṣọ́lé Brighton Mathew Ryan yọ pẹ̀lú bọ́ọ̀lù ayárabí-àṣá kan sínú apá ọ̀tún àwọn náà.

rows.source: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.
rows.output: "Àgúrẹ́ ń tiraka pẹ̀lú àwọn ìṣòro kan nínú ẹsì rẹ̀, "Olùdarí ìlú Pep Guardiola sọ fún àwọn oníròyìn.
rows.reference: ''Aguero ńlàkàkà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìṣòro kan ní àtẹ́lẹs̵ẹ̀ rẹ̀,'' ni aláàkóso City Pep Guardiola sọ fún àwọn oníròyìn.

rows.source: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.
rows.output: "A sọ̀rọ̀ nípa rẹ̀ tí ń ṣeré 55, 60 ìṣẹ́jú."
rows.reference: ''A sọ̀rọ̀ nípa kí òun gbá bọ́ọ̀lù fún àwọn ìṣẹ́jú márùndínlọ́gọ́ta, ọgọ́ta.

rows.source: That's what happened.
rows.output: Ìyẹn ni ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ìyẹn ni ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̵̀.

rows.source: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."
rows.output: A ní oríire pé ó gba góòlù kan ní àkókò yẹn."
rows.reference: À ṣe oríire nigbati ó gbá bọ́ọ̀lù kan wọlé ní àkókò yẹn.''

rows.source: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ó jẹ́ Sterling tó fún àwọn òkùnkùn náà ní ìlà àkọ́kọ́ nínú ìdíje Premier League.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n Sterling ni ẹni náà tí ó fún Sky Blues ní àǹfààní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ninu ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ti Líìgì Aláàkọ́kọ́.

rows.source: That goal came in the 29th minute.
rows.output: Ìlépa yẹn wá ní ìṣẹ́jú 29.
rows.reference: Bọ́ọ̀lù tí ó wọlé yẹn wá ní ìṣẹ́jú ìkọkàndínlọ́gbọ̀n.

rows.source: Aguero received the ball deep in Brighton territory on that play.
rows.output: Aguero gba bọọlu jinlẹ̀ nínú àgbègbè Brighton nígbati wọ́n ṣe eré náà.
rows.reference: Aguero gba bọ́ọ̀lù náà níbi tówọnú lórí ilẹ̵̀ Brighton ninu ìdíje yẹn.

rows.source: He sent a beautiful through ball along the left flank to Leroy Sane.
rows.output: Ó fi bọ́ọ̀lù tí ó rẹwà ránṣẹ́ sí apá òsì, ó sì rán Leroy Sane lọ.
rows.reference: Ó fi bọ́ọ̀lù kan tó rẹwà ránṣ̵ẹ́ wọnú lọ́na igun apá sí Leroy Sane.

rows.source: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.
rows.output: Sane gba awọn ifọwọkan diẹ ṣaaju ki o to dari Sterling si ọna jijin.
rows.reference: Sane ṣe àwọn ìfẹsẹ̀kàn diẹ́ kan kí ó tó darí Sterling sí ọ̀nà igun ojú-ilé náà.

rows.source: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.
rows.output: Agbábọ́ọ̀lù náà tẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù náà sínú àgbègbè náà ní ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ ṣáájú kí ó tó jáde níta.
rows.reference: Onípò-iwáju Sky Blues náà taari bọ́ọ̀lú sínú àwọn kí ó to yọ́ jáde kuro ninu ààlà.

rows.source: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.output: Ìlú ń jà pẹ̀lú Hoffenheim nínú ìdíje àwùjọ́ Champions League ní àkókò 12:55 ìrọ̀lè ọjọ́ Tùesdé ní pápá ìṣere Rhein-Neckar-Arena ní Sinsheim, Jámánì.
rows.reference: City ńdojúkọ Hoffenheim ninu ìdíje oníṣòrí ti Líìgì Àwọn Akọni ní aago kan ku ìṣẹ́jú máàrún lọ́ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun ní Rhein-Neckar-Arena ní ìlú Sinsheim, lorilẹ̵-ede Jamani.

rows.source: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies
rows.output: Scherzer fẹ́ láti jẹ́ olùfọ́kansìn sí àwọn Rockies
rows.reference: Scherzer ńfẹ́ gba ayò abàṣèjẹ́ dojúkọ. Rockies

rows.source: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.
rows.output: Pẹ̀lú àwọn Nationals tí wọ́n ti yọ kúrò nínú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà, kò sí ìdí kan tó fi ń ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ mìíràn.
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú Àwọn Nationals náà tíwọ́n ti yọ kuro ninu àríyànjiyàn àṣekágbá ìdíje, kòsí ìdí púpọ̀ mọ́ láti fi ipá bẹ̀rẹ̀ òmíràn.

rows.source: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n Scherzer tí ó ń ṣe ìpèníjà nígbà gbogbo ń lérò pé kí ó lọ sí pápá ní ọjọ́ Sunday lòdì sí àwọn Rockies ti Colorado, ṣùgbọ́n ó kàn nígbè tí ó bá ṣe pàtàkì fún àwọn Rockies, tí wọ́n ní ìpèníjà kan ṣoṣo lórí Dodgers ti Los Angeles ní Ìwọ̀ Oòrùn Ìlà Oòrùn.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọn Scherzer tójẹ́pé ìgbà gbogbo ló ndíje ńretí láti mú òkè gùn lòdì sí Colorado Rockies lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, ṣùgbọ́n bí àwọn ìtọ́kasí bá tún wà fún ìdíje àṣekágbá fún Àwọn Rockies, tí ó ńfi ìdíje kan síwáju Los Angeles Dodgers ní Ìwọ̀-oòrùn NL náà.

rows.source: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.
rows.output: Àwọn Rockies ti gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan pẹ̀lú ìbọ̀wọ̀lù 5-2 lórí àwọn Nationals ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ Aarọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ṣi ń wá láti ṣàkóso àmì ẹ̀yẹ ìpìlẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ wọn.
rows.reference: Àwọn Rockies gba ó kéré tán ọ̀gangan-ibi tí kòṣeé sọtẹ́lẹ̀ kan pẹ̀lú ìṣẹ́gun kan tíwọ́n ní lórí Àwọn Nationals lálẹ̵́ ọjọ́ Ẹtì, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n sí ńwá láti pa ìlẹ̀kùn dé mọ oyè àkọ́kọ́ wọn ní ìpín ìkínní.

rows.source: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.
rows.output: "Àní bí a bá ń ṣeré fún ohunkóhun, ó kéré jù láti lè lè fi ẹsọ ara wa mọ́ rọ́bà tí a mọ̀ pé ìṣípáàdé níbè ní Denver pẹ̀lú àwọn olùgbọ́ àti ẹgbẹ́ mìíràn yóò ṣeé ṣe ní ìpele tó ga jù lọ ní àkókò kankan tí mo bá dojú kọ ní ọdún yìí."
rows.reference: ''Àní botilẹjepe à ńdíje fún òfo, ó kéré tán á sáà leè fi ọmọ-ìka ẹsẹ̀ taari rọ́bà náà pẹ̀lú ìmọ̀ wípé àyíká Denver níbí pẹ̀lú àwọn èrò àti ikọ̀ miran yóò maá gba bọ́ọ̀lù ní ipele tóṣeé ṣe kójẹ́ eyiti ó ga jùlọ ti emi yóò kojú lọ́dún yìí.

rows.source: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"
rows.output: Kí nìdí tí n kò fi fẹ́ sọ́dọ̀ nínú ìyẹn?
rows.reference: Kínni ìdí ti emi kòfi ní nifẹ́ láti díje ninu ìyẹn?''

rows.source: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.
rows.output: Àwọn Nationals kò tíì kéde ẹni tí wọ́n máa ṣe ní ọjọ́ Sunday, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n sọ pé wọ́n fẹ́ kí Scherzer máa ṣe ní ipò bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn Nationals síbẹ̀síbẹ̀ sì níláti kéde oníbẹ̀rẹ̀ kan  fún ọjọ́ Àìkú, ṣùgbọ́n ìròyìn sọpé wọn faramọ́ láti jẹ́kí Scherzer máa ju bọ́ọ̀lù ninu irú ipò bẹ́ẹ̀.

rows.source: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.
rows.output: Scherzer, ẹni tí yóò ṣe ìbèré rẹ̀ 34, ṣe ìpàdé ìpàdé kan ní ọjọ́ Tọ́kà, yóò sì máa ṣe eré rẹ̀ ní ìsinmi rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.
rows.reference: Scherzer, ẹniti yóò máa jẹ́ oníbẹ̀rẹ̀ fún ìgbà kẹrìnlélọ́gbọ̀n rẹ̀, ju bọ́ọ̀lù sáà kan láti ibi ìgbaradì aju-bọ́ọ̀lù lọ́jọ́ 'Bọ̀ ti yóò sì máa ju bọ́ọ̀lu lọ́jọ́ Àìkú tííṣe ọjọ́ ìsinmi rẹ̀.

rows.source: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
rows.output: Ọmọ Washington ọwọ́ ọ̀tún náà jẹ́ 18-7 pẹ̀lú 2.53 ERA àti 300 strikeouts nínú innings 220 2/3 yìí.
rows.reference: Ọlọ́wọ́-ọ̀tún ti Washington náà jẹ́ 18-7 pẹ̀lú 2.53 ERA kan àti àwọn ìkọlù ọ̀ọ́dún ninu àwọn i̇̀yíwọ́padà ní sáà yìí.

rows.source: Trump rallies in West Virginia
rows.output: Trump rallies in West Virginia
rows.reference: Àwọn ìpéjọpọ̀ èrò ti Trump ní Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Ààrẹ náà tọ́ka sí ipò tó yí ìdìbò ilé ẹjọ́ gíga rẹ̀ ní Brett Kavanaugh, nígbà tó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa pàtàkì ìdìbò àwọn olùgbèjà ní ìdìbò àarín.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ náà fi ọgbọ́n tọ́kasí ipò tóyí mímú Adájọ́ Brett Kavanaugh fún iṣẹ̀ ká nigbati ó ńsọ̀rọ̀ nípa pàtàkì jíjáde àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican ninu àwọn ìbò ààrin sáà.

rows.source: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.
rows.output: "Gbogbo ohun tí a ti ṣe wà ní ewu ní November.
rows.reference: ''Gbogbo ohun tí a tíṣe ní ó wà ninu ewu ní oṣù Bélú.

rows.source: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: Mẹ́wàá ọ̀sẹ̀ lọ sí ìdìbò pàtàkì jùlọ nínú ìgbésí ayé wa.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́fà sí ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ìdìbò tóṣe pàtàkì jùlọ ní àwọn àkókò ìgbésí-ayé wa.

rows.source: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.
rows.output: Èyí jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn tó tóbi jù lọ, tó tóbi jù lọ --Èmi kì í ṣe eré ṣùgbọ́n mo ń ṣiṣẹ́ gan-an, ó sì jẹ́ pé mo ń rìn káàkiri láti máa jà fún àwọn olùdíje tó dára.
rows.reference: Èyí jẹ́ ọ̀kan ninu àwọn títóbi, títóbi-- Èmi kò díje ṣùgbọ́n Mo ńdíje nítòótọ ìdí nìyí tí Mo fi ńwa níbi gbogbo tí mo sì ńjà fún àwọn olùdíje ńlá,'' ni ó sọ.

rows.source: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.
rows.output: Trump tẹsiwaju, "O ri ẹgbẹ́ ìrònú yìí, ẹgbèẹgbèrun ènìyàn, o ri bi wọn ti n ṣe ni bayii.
rows.reference: Trump tẹ̀síwájú, ''Se ẹ̀ rí ọ̀kànràn ẹgbẹ́ búburú, búburú ti Àwọn Democrats, ẹ́ rí i tó ńṣẹlẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ báyìí.

rows.source: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.
rows.output: Wọ́n ti pinnu láti gba agbára padà nípa lílo ọ̀nà èyíkéyìí tó yẹ, o rí ìwà ìbàjẹ́, ìwà ìbàjẹ́.
rows.reference: Wọ́n sì ̈ti pinnu láti gba agbára padà nípa lílo ọ̀nà èyíkéyìí tó pọn dandan, sé ẹ rí ìwà aìláàánu, àiṣ̵̵eésúnmọ náà.

rows.source: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."
rows.output: Wọn kò kọ̀ láti ṣe ìpalára fún ẹnikẹ́ni, láti sáré lórí ẹnikẹ́ni láti gba agbára àti ìṣàkóso, ìyẹn ni ohun tí wọ́n fẹ́ ni agbára àti ìṣàkóso, a kò ní fún wọn.
rows.reference: Wọn kò bìkítà nípa ẹnití wọ́n pa lára, ẹnití wọ́n nilati kọjá lórí rẹ̀ láti lee gba agbára àti ìṣàkóso, ìyẹn nípe ohun tíwọ́n fẹ́ ni agbára àti ìṣàkóso, a kò ní fi i fún wọn.

rows.source: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Àwọn Démókíràtà, ó sọ, ń lọ sí “ìdààmú àti ìdènà.”
rows.reference: Àwọn Democrats, ni ó sọpé, wọn wà ninu ìlépa láti ''dínilọ́wọ àti dínamọ́ni.''

rows.source: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: "Àti pé o rí i pé ní àwọn ọjọ́ mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn," ó sọ pé, tí ó ń pè àwọn Démókírétìkì "ìbínú àti ìbínú àti ìbínú àti àìlèdá."
rows.reference: ''Bẹ́ẹ̀ ẹ rí ìyẹn láàrin ọjọ́ mẹ́rin ṣẹ́yìn,''ni o sọ, tó sì ńpe Awọn Democrats ní ''bínubínú àti aláìláàánú àti aláìṣeésúnmọ àti aláiṣòtítọ́.

rows.source: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.
rows.output: Ó tọ́ka sí ipò Alága Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin Démókráàsì Dianne Feinstein, èyí sì mú kí àwọn olùgbọ́ náà gbọ́ ohùn tí ó ga.
rows.reference: Ó tọ́kasí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrats Àsojú-ṣòfin Àgbà Dianne Feinstein ti Ìgbìmọ̀ Ètò Ìdájọ́ ti Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà nípa orúkọ, eyiti o gba ariwo oní-ìbínú láti ọdọ́ àwọn olùtẹ́tígbọ náà.

rows.source: "Remember her answer?
rows.output: "Ranti bi o ṣe dahun?
rows.reference: ''Ránti ìdáhùn rẹ̀?

rows.source: Did you leak the document?
rows.output: Ǹjẹ́ o ṣí ìwé náà sílẹ̀?
rows.reference: Ǹjẹ ìwọ tú àṣ̵írí ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ náà?

rows.source: Uh, uh, what.
rows.output: Uh, uh, kini.
rows.reference: Uh, uh, kínni.

rows.source: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Rárá, ẹ̀rù ń bà mí, mo dúró de - ìyẹn gan-an ni ìhùwàsí ara tí ó burú jù lọ - ìhùwàsí ara tí ó burú jù lọ tí mo ti rí rí.
rows.reference: Bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́, uh bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́, Mo dúró ọ̀kan - ìyẹn jẹ́ èdè ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ tí kò dára - èdè ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ náà tó burú jùlọ tí Mo tí ì rírí.''

rows.source: Labour is no longer a broad church.
rows.output: Iṣẹ́ kò sí ní ilé ìjọsìn tó gbooro mọ́.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ òṣèlú Labour ko dàbíi ilé ìjọsín tó gbòòrò kan mọ.

rows.source: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ aláìfẹ́ àwọn tí wọ́n ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ohun tí wọ́n gbà gbọ́.
rows.reference: Kòní ìpamọ́ra fún àwọn ti wọ́n ńsọ èrò ọkàn wọn

rows.source: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.
rows.output: Nígbà tí àwọn alágbára Momentum nínú ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú mi níbè ni wọ́n dìbò láti fi ẹ̀sùn kan mi, kò sí ìyàlẹ́nu.
rows.reference: Nigbati àwọn aṣatúnṣe ti Momentum ni ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlu agbègbè mi dìbò láti bámi wí, kò fi gbogbo ara jẹ́ ìyàlẹ̵́nu.

rows.source: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn gbogbo rẹ̀, èmi ni tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ dé nínú àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour láti sọ fún wa pé a kò fẹ́ wá – gbogbo rẹ̀ nítorí pé a ń sọ̀rọ̀ wa.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn gbogbo rẹ̀, Èmi ni ẹni tó tuntun jùlọ lórí ìlà àwọn MP ti ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour tíwọn yóò sọ fún pé àwọn kòfẹ́ rí - gbogbo rẹ̀ fún sísọ àwọn èrò ọkàn wa.

rows.source: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́rún ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin mi, Joan Ryan, gba ìtọ́jú kan náà nítorí pé ó dúró ṣinṣin lòdì sí ìkórìíra àwọn Júù.
rows.reference: Akẹgbẹ́ mi ní ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin Joan Ryan gba irú ìfọwọ́múni kan náà nitoripe o fi ọkàn tó pinnu díde dúró sí ìgbógun ti àwọn Júù.

rows.source: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: Nínú ọ̀ràn mi, ìṣòro ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà fi mí ṣe ẹ̀sùn pé mi ò bá Jeremy Corbyn mu.
rows.reference: Nítèmi, àbá láti bámi wi bú ẹnu àtẹ́ lù mi nitoripe N ko fohùnṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.
rows.output: Lori pàtàkì ètò ọrọ̀ ajé tó ní ojúṣe, lórí ààbò orílẹ̀-èdè, lórí Yúróòpù, ní ìtàkurí tí ó jọra pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀ràn tí Jeremy ti kọ́ àwọn aṣáájú tó ti kọjá.
rows.reference: Lórí ìṣepàtàkì ti ìlànà ètò ọ̀rọ̀ ajé kan, lórí ààbò orilẹ-ede, lórí Yuroopu, lọ́nà tó panilẹ́ẹ̀rín àwọm ọ̀rọ̀ tó farajọ ohun tí Jeremy kòfi fohùnṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú àwọn adarí tó saáju.

rows.source: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."
rows.output: Ìkìlọ̀ fún ìpàdé ẹgbẹ́ Labour ní Ìlà-oòrùn Nóttinghámù ní ọjọ́ Friday sọ pé “a fẹ́ kí àwọn ìpàdé náà jẹ́ ìkìlọ̀ àti ìmúṣẹ.”
rows.reference: ̀Ìfitónilétí fún ìpàdé ẹ̵gbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour ti Ìlà-oòrùn Nottingham lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì sọpé ''a fẹ́ kí ìpàdé náà jẹ́ eyiti ó fààyè gba gbogbo eniyan tí ó sì lérè.''

rows.source: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.
rows.output: Fun ọpọlọpọ ọdun mẹjọ mi gẹgẹ bi ọmọ ẹgbẹ Labour ti agbegbe, awọn ipade GC ti alẹ ọjọ Jimọ ti jẹ nitootọ bẹẹ.
rows.reference: Fún púpọ̀ ninu ọdún mẹ́jọ mi gẹ́gẹ́bí MP ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour agbègbè, àwọn ìpàdé GC àlẹ́ ọjọ́ Ẹtì náà ti rí bẹ́ẹ̀ gẹ́lẹ́.

rows.source: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.
rows.output: Láàárín àwọn ènìyàn, kò sí ìdùnnú báyìí, nítorí pé ìtànkálẹ̀ ìrònú yìí ti di àdánidá.
rows.reference: Ó banilọ́kàn pé lóòní, kìí ṣe ohùn ti ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ìpàdé àtipe ìlérí ti òṣèlú ''tó láàánú, tó ńṣe jẹ́jẹ́ díẹ̀ síi'' ni a ti gbàgbé tipẹ́ bí ó bájẹ̀pé, lóòtítọ́, ó tiẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ rí rárá.

rows.source: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.
rows.output: Ó ti di kedere pé àwọn èrò tí ó yàtọ̀ síra kò jẹ́ kí wọ́n farada nínú ẹgbẹ́ Labour, àti pé gbogbo èrò kan ni a ṣe ìdájọ́ nípa bóyá ó jẹ́ ìgbọ́kùú fún aṣáájú ẹgbẹ́ náà.
rows.reference: Ó ti wá ńhàn gbangba síwájú síi wipe wọn kò fààyè àwọn ojú ìwòye tó yàtọ̀ ninu ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour àtipé gbogbo èrò ọkàn ni wọn ńṣédájọ́ wọn lórí bóyá ó jẹ́ ìtẹ́wọ́gbá sí àwọn adarí ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú náà.

rows.source: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.
rows.output: Èyí bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní kíákíá lẹ́yìn tí Jeremy di olórí, bí àwọn ẹlẹ́gbẹ́ kan tí mo ti rò pé mo ní ìwòye òṣèlú kan náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní retí pé kí n yí padà kí n sì gba ipò tí mo kò ní gbà rí rárá - bóyá lórí ààbò orílẹ̀-èdè tàbí ọjà kan ṣoṣo ti EU.
rows.reference: Èyí bẹ̀rẹ̀ láìpẹ́ lẹ́yìn tí Jeremy di olórí, bí àwọn akẹgbẹ́ tí Mo ti rò tẹ́lẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀ wípé a jọ ńṣàjọpín ojú-ìwòye òṣèlú kan tójọrawọn bẹ̀rèsí rétí wipe kí ńyà bàrà láti gba àwọn ipò tí N kòní fẹ́ ṣe ohun miran láti fohùnṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú rẹ̀ láilái - bóyá lórí ààbò orilẹ-ede tàbí lórí ọjà kan ṣoṣo ti àjọ EU.

rows.source: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.
rows.output: Nígbà gbogbo tí mo bá ń sọ̀rọ̀ ní gbangba - kò ṣe pàtàkì ohun tí mo ń sọ - àwọn ìkésíni ìkórìíra lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìkìlọ̀ lórí ìk
rows.reference: Nígbàkúùgbà tí Mo bá sọ̀rọ̀ ni gbangba - tí kòsì ní fiṣe irú ohun ti Mo sọ - níbẹ̀ ni àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ èèbú alásọfitakoni kan yóò ti tẹ̀lé e lórí àwọn ojú-òpó ìbáṣepọ̀ ti ayelujara tíwọn ńpè fún ìyọkúrò, títako òṣèlú ti ààrin náà, tó sì ńsọ fún mi wipe kòyẹ ki N wà ninu ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour.

rows.source: And that is not just my experience.
rows.output: Àti pé èyí kìí ṣe ìrírí mi nìkan.
rows.reference: Àtipé ìyẹn kìí ṣe ìrírí tèmi nìkan.

rows.source: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.
rows.output: Ní tòótọ́, mo mọ̀ pé mo ní ìbàlẹ̀-ọkàn ju àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ mi kan lọ nítorí pé àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí wọ́n ń sọ fún mi máa ń jẹ́ òṣèlú.
rows.reference: Ní tòótọ́, Mo mọ̀ wipe Mo jẹ́ olóríire ju àwọn kan ninu àwọn akẹgbẹ́ mi lọ bí ó ṣe jẹ́pé àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí a darí sọ́dọ̀ mi tí máa ńjẹ́ ti òṣèlú.

rows.source: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.
rows.output: Mo ń bẹ̀rù fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ mi tí wọ́n ń dojú kọ ìkùnsínú ìbàjẹ́ akọ tàbí ìbàjẹ́ ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ lójoojúmọ́, ṣùgbọ́n kò sọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ rí rárá.
rows.reference: Ẹnu máa ńyà mi nípa ti ìwà akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ àti ìṣọkàngírí ti àwọn akẹgbẹ́ wọ̀nyen tí wọ́n ńdojúkọ òjò èèbù ti àwọn tí kòka obìnrin sí nǹkan àti àwọn ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà lójoojúmọ́ ṣùgbọ́n tíwọn kò sálọ nígbà kankan.

rows.source: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.
rows.output: Ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ohun tí ó jẹ́ ìbànújẹ́ jùlọ nínú àkókò yìí ti òṣèlú ni bí ìwọ̀n ìbàjẹ́ ti di àṣìṣe.
rows.reference: Ọ̀kan ninu àwọn nǹkan tó ńjánikulẹ̀ jùlọ ninu òṣèlú ti òde-ìwòyí ni bí àwọn ipele èèbù bíbú ti wá di àṣà tó bójúmu.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn sọ pé ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá pé ẹgbẹ́ Labour gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe àgbègbè ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn  sọ lọ́sẹ̀ tókọjá wipe ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlu Labour níláti jẹ́kí ìdàgbàsókè bá àṣà ìpamọ́ra.

rows.source: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.
rows.output: Ìtànkálẹ̀ náà ni pé a kò sí ìjọ tó gbooro bẹ́ẹ̀ mọ́ rárá, àti pé pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìgbìmó ìdánilójú tàbí ìyípadà nínú àwọn ìlànà ìdìbò, ẹgbẹ́ náà ń dínkù.
rows.reference: Òtítọ náà nipé a kìí ṣe sọọsi tó gbòòrò yẹn mọ́ àtipé pẹ̀lu gbogbo àbá ''kòsí-ìgbẹkẹ̀lé'' tabi àwọn ìlàna ìyípadà ti ìyannisipò ẹgbẹ òṣèlu náà ńdi eyiti ó ńtín-ín-rín púpọ síi.

rows.source: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."
rows.output: Mo ti gba ọpọlọpọ imọran ni ọdun meji to kọja ti wọn n gbiyanju lati jẹ ki n tọju ori mi, ki n má sọ̀rọ̀ púpọ̀, lẹ́yìn náà n óo “dáadọ́gba.”
rows.reference: Mo ti ní ọpọ ìmọràn láàrin ọdún méjì tókọjá tó ńpàrọwà fún mi láti jẹ́kí orí mi wà nísàlẹ̀, kí ńmá fí bẹ́ẹ̀ sọ̀rọ̀ mọ́ àtipé lẹ́yìn náà N ó ''wà dáadáa.''

rows.source: But that is not what I came into politics to do.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìyẹn kìí ṣe ohun tí mo wá sí ìṣèlú láti ṣe.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n ìyẹn kìí ṣe ohun tí Mo wá sínú òṣèlú láti ṣe.

rows.source: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.
rows.output: Láti ìgbà tí mo ti darapọ̀ mọ́ Ẹgbẹ́ Ìṣiṣẹ́ fún ọdún 32 sẹ́yìn gẹ́gẹ́ bí akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga, tí ìdààmú ìjọba Thatcher ti fi sílẹ̀ tí ó fi jẹ́ kí ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga mi ṣubú, mo ti ń wá láti jẹ́ alágbára fún àwọn iṣẹ́ ìjọba tó dára fún àwọn tí wọ́n nílò rẹ̀ jùlọ - bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmúṣẹ́ àgbègbè tàbí minisita ìjọba.
rows.reference: Láti ìgbà tí Mo ti darapọ̀ mọ́ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour bí ọmọ ilé ìwé kan, lẹ́yìn inú tó bí mi nípa àìbìkítà ìjọba Thatcher eyiti ó fi kíláàsì ilé-ìwé onígbogbo-ẹ̀kọ́ mi sílẹ̀ nípò tóti fẹ́rẹ̀ wólulẹ̀ tán, Mo ti ṣe àwárí láti máa jà fún ìmúdára síi àwọn iṣẹ́ ìlú fún àwọn tí wọ́n nílò wọn jùlọ - bóyá gẹ́gẹ́bí káńsílọ̀ agbègbè kan tàbí aláàkóso ìjọba.

rows.source: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.
rows.output: Mi ò sọ pé mi ò sọ̀rọ̀ nípa òṣèlú mi, pẹ̀lú ní ìdìbò tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Èmi kòfi ìgbà kankan fi òṣèlú mi pamọ́, àti ninu ìdìbò tókọjá náà.

rows.source: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.output: Kòsí ẹni kan ní Ìlà Oòrùn Nóttinghámù tí ó lè ní ìdààmú nípa àwọn ipò ìlàkàkà mi àti àwọn àgbègbè tí mo bá aṣáájú tí ó wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ní ìforígbárí.
rows.reference: Kòsí ẹnikan ninu Ìla-oòrùn Nottingham tí ó leè ní ìpòrúùru ọkàn lọ́nàkọnà nípa àwọn ipò ìlànà mi àti àwọn ipele àìleèfohùnṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú àwọn adàri tówànípò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́.

rows.source: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.
rows.output: Fun awọn ti o ṣe agbero iṣipopada naa ni ọjọ Jimọ, ohun nikan ti mo le sọ ni pe nigbati orilẹ-ede naa ba nṣiṣẹ si Brexit ti yoo fa ipa buburu lori awọn idile, awọn iṣẹ ati awọn iṣẹ wa, emi ko loye ifẹ lati fi akoko ati agbara mi ṣe si igbọran mi si olori ẹgbẹ Labour.
rows.reference: Fún àwọn tíwọn jẹ́kí ìtẹ̀síwájú bá àbá náà lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì, gbogbo ohun ti N ó sọ nipé nigbati orilẹ-ede náà ńroko sọ́nà ọ̀dọ̀ Brexit kan eyiti yóò pa àwọn ara-ilé, àwọn oko-òwò, àti àwọn iṣé ìlú lára, Èmi kòní òye ìfẹ́ náà láti máa fi àkókò àti agbára mi ṣofo lórí jíjẹ́ olóòtítọ́ si adarí ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour.

rows.source: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n gan-an ni ìsọfọ́ tí mo ní kì í ṣe sí Momentum ti Nottingham, ó jẹ́ sí àwọn ará ìlú mi, bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Labour tàbí kò sí: Mo ní ìgbádùn láti ṣiṣẹ́ fún yín, mo sì ṣe ileri pé kò sí iye ìyàtọ̀ ìdìbò tàbí ìmúṣẹ òṣèlú tí yóò dènà mi láti ṣe ohun tí mo gbà pé ó dára jùlọ fún gbogbo yín.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọn lóòtítọ iṣẹ ìránṣẹ́ kan tí Mo ní kìí ṣe sí Nothingham Momentum, o wá fún àwọn to dìbò fún mí, bóyá wọ́n jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour tàbí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́: Mo ń yangàn láti sìn yín tí Mo sì ṣe ìlérì wipe kòsí iye àwọn ìdúnkookò ìyọnikúrò tàbi ti òṣèlú   kòṣẹlẹ̀-kíákíá tí yóò dámi lọ́wọ́ kọ́ láti máṣe kópa mọ́ ninu ohun tí Mo gbàgbó wipe wọ́n jẹ́ àwọn ohun dára jùlọ fún gbogbo yín.

rows.source: Chris Leslie is MP for Nottingham East
rows.output: Chris Leslie ni o n ṣoju fun Nottingham East ni Ile-igbimọ aṣofin.
rows.reference: Chris Leslie  ni MP fún Ìla-oòrùn Nottingham

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr ti ko tii ṣẹgun ti wa ni ipo akọkọ
rows.reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr tíwọn kòlù rí lọ sóke

rows.source: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.
rows.output: Ìsapá méjì tó pọ̀ jù lọ lè ti yí àbájade náà padà díẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kò sí ìdààmú pé Ayr yẹ kí wọ́n ṣẹ́gun nínú ìpàdé Premiership Tennent tó yanilẹ́nu yìí.
rows.reference: Awọn ìgbìyànjú ìgbẹ̀yìn méjì leè ti sún èsì ìpari náà bákan-bákan, ṣùgbọ́n kòsí àni-àní wipe Ayr yẹ láti borí ninu ìdíje ọjọ́ náà yìí tójẹ́ apanilẹ́ẹ̀rín tótún yanilẹ́nu ninu Ìṣọ̀rí Aláàkọ́kọ́ ti Tennent.

rows.source: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.
rows.output: Wọ́n wà ní orí tábìlì, ẹgbẹ́ kan ṣoṣo tí kò tíì ṣẹ́gun nínú mẹ́wàá.
rows.reference: Báyìí àwọn ni ó wà lóòkè tábìlì náà, ikọ̀ kan ṣoṣo ninu mẹ́wàá tíwọn kò tíì lù rí.

rows.source: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.
rows.output: Ní ìparí, ó jẹ́ ààbò wọn tó dára jù, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìmúrasílẹ̀ wọn tó dára jù, tó mú kí ẹgbẹ́ ilé náà borí, tí olùkó Peter Murchie sì ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti ní ìdùnnú.
rows.reference: Ní òpin rẹ̀, ààbò wọn tógbópọn ni, pẹ̀lú pé wọ́n ńṣàmúlò àwọn àǹfààní lọ́ná tódára jù, eyiti ó gbé ikọ̀ ti ilé náà tí olùkọ́ni wọn sì ní gbogbo ẹ̀tọ́ láti máa dunnú.

rows.source: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.
rows.output: "A ti ṣe àyẹ̀wò lórí àwọn eré wa títí di báyìí, a sì ṣì jẹ́ aláìlábùkù, nítorí náà mo ní láti dunnú."
rows.reference: ''A ti dán wa wò nínú àwọn ayò wa tìtí dé ibí yìí, àtipé síbẹ̀ kòsí ẹnití ó tíì lù wá, nitorinaa Mo nílatí máa dunnú,'' ni ó sọ.

rows.source: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."
rows.output: Robyn Christie ti Melrose sọ pé: “Àyè sí Ayr, wọ́n mú àwọn àǹfààní wọn dára ju bí a ṣe ṣe lọ.”
rows.reference: Robyn Christie ti Melrose sọpé: ''Òṣùba lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ayr, wọ́n ṣàmúlò àwọn àǹfààní wọn lọ́nà tódára ju bí àwa tiṣe lọ.''

rows.source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
rows.reference: Ìgbìyànjú ìṣẹ́jú ìkẹrìnlá ti Grant Anderson, ti a yípada nípaṣẹ̀ Frazier Climo, fi Ayr síwájú, ṣùgbọ́n káàdì aláwọ̀ òfééèfé kan fún onífìla ilẹ̀ Scotland Rory Hughes, tí Warriors fi sílẹ̀ fún ìdíje náà, gba Melrose láyè láti jẹ́kí àwọn nọmba sọ̀rọ̀ tí Jason Baggot sì sáré di ìgbìyànjú kan tí a kò yípadà mu.

rows.source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
rows.output: Climo fa ìyàtọ̀ sí Ayr pẹ̀lú ìfọwọ́kan, kí ó tó, ní àkókò ìsinmi, ó gba wọ́n, ó sì yí padà láti jẹ́ 17-5 fún Ayr ní ìparapọ̀.
rows.reference: Climo fẹ ìléwájú Ayr lójú pẹ̀lú ìjìyà pẹnariti kan, saájú, ní ìdajì àkókò gan-an, ó gbá ayò wọlé lẹ́yìn náà ó yí ìgbìyànjú aláàdáṣe kan padà láti sọ ọ́ di 17-5 fún Ayr ní àkókò ìsinmi náà.

rows.source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n Melrose bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìdá kejì pẹ̀lú ìmúṣẹ, àti pé Patrick Anderson gba wọ́n, Baggot sì yí padà, dín ìyàtọ̀ sí márùn-ún.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n Melrose bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìdajì ìdíje ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì náà lọ́nà tódára tí ìgbìyànjú Patrick Anderson, tí Baggot yípadà sì dín ìyàtọ̀ náà kù sí àwọn kókó máàrún.

rows.source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, ìdákẹ́jẹ́ kan wà fún ìfarapa tó ṣe pàtàkì sí Ruaridh Knott, ẹni tó ti gbé e lọ síbi ìtọ́jú, àti láti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìṣere náà, Ayr tẹ̀síwájú síwájú nípasẹ̀ ìgbọ̀nrì Stafford McDowall, tí Climo sì ṣe ìyàtọ̀.
rows.reference: Ìdádúró gígùn kan wà lẹ́yìn náà fún ìfarapa púpọ̀ tí Ruaridh Knott ní, ẹnití wọ́n gbé jáde kúrò, àtipé láti àtúnbẹ̀rẹ̀ náà, Ayr tún yọrí síwájú nípaṣẹ̀ ìgbìyànjú Stafford McDowall kan, eyití wọ́n yípadà láti ọwọ́ Climo.

rows.source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
rows.output: Ìgbà tí Ayr ṣe olórì Blair Macpherson, wọ́n fún un ní kaadi ofeefee, Melrose sì lo àǹfààní náà pẹ̀lú ìgbọ̀nrì Bruce Colvine, ní ìparí àkókò ìmúrasílẹ̀ tó lágbára.
rows.reference: Adele balógun ti Ayr Blair Macpherson niwọ́n fún ní káàdì aláwọ̀ òfééèfé lẹ́yìn náà, àtipé lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi, Melrose jẹ́kì ọkùnrin àfikún náà sanwó pẹ̀lú ìgbìyànjú Bruce Colvine kan tíwọn kò yípadà, ní òpin èèdi oní-ìdààmu tó gbóná gidigidi kan.

rows.source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
rows.output: Ìyàlẹ́nu ni ẹgbẹ́ ilé náà padà, ó sì jẹ́ kí Struan Hutchinson gba kaadi ofeefee fún ṣíṣe ìfọ́kùnsìn sí Climo láìsí bọ́ọ̀lù, láti ìlà ìlà ìlà, MacPherson sì fi ọwọ́ kan ilẹ̀ ní ẹ̀yìn ọkùnrín Ayr tí ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Ikọ̀ onílé náà padà wá, lábẹ̀ botiwukori, àtipé nigbati wọ́n fún Struan Hutchinson ni káàdì aláwọ̀ òfééèfé fún títako Climo láìsí bọ́ọ̀lù, láti ibi ìlà ìjìyà pẹnariti, MacPherson fẹṣẹ̀ kan ilẹ̀ lẹ́yìn òòlù àwọn Ayr tó ńtẹ̀síwájú.

rows.source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
rows.output: Climo yí padà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti ṣe lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i lẹ́yìn ìtúsílẹ̀, lẹ́yìn tí Kyle Rowe gba ìkùúkù David Armstrong àti fi flanker Gregor Henry sílẹ̀ fún ẹgbẹ́ ilé fún ìgbọ̀nrìrì karùún.
rows.reference: Climo yí padà, bí ó tunṣe ṣe n’ibẹ̀rẹ̀, lẹ́yìn tí Kyle Rowe gba bọ́ọ̀lù ti David Armstrong gbá lati inú apoti tí ó sì fi onípò-igun ránṣẹ́ síta fún ìgbìyànjú ẹlẹẹ̀kaàrún fun àwọn ikọ̀ onílé náà.

rows.source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
rows.output: Ìtàn Ìtànkálẹ̀ Star ti Still Game ń lọ sí iṣẹ́ tuntun ní ilé oúnjẹ
rows.reference: Ìràwọ Still Game dábì ẹniti óti ṣetán fún iṣẹ́-ìṣe tuntun ní ilé iṣẹ́ ẹka ti olóúnjẹ.

rows.source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
rows.output: Ìtàn Ìtànkálẹ̀ Star Still Game Ford Kieran ṣeé ṣe kí ó lọ sí ilé iṣẹ́ ìgbafẹ́ lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n rí i pé ó jẹ́ olùdarí ilé-iṣẹ́ ilé oúnjẹ tí ó ní ìwé-àṣẹ.
rows.reference: Ìràwọ Still Game Ford Kieran dábì ẹnitó ṣetán láti lọ sínú ilé iṣẹ́ ti ẹka olóúnjẹ lẹ́yìn tíwọ́n ṣàwárí wipe wọ́n ti dárúkọ rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́bí olùdarí ile iṣẹ́ tóní àwọn ile ìsoúnjẹta oníìwé-àṣẹ kan.

rows.source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: Ẹni ọgọ́ta ọdún (56) náà ṣe Jack Jarvis lórí eré tẹlifíṣọ̀n BBC tó gbajúmọ̀, èyí tó jẹ́ pé òun ni ó kọ àti pé ó ń ṣe pẹ̀lú alágbára rẹ̀ ní eré ìtàgé Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: Ẹni ọdún mẹ́rìndínlọ́gọ́ta náà ló ńkópa bíi Jack Jarvis lórí ètò BBC tó gbajúmọ̀ náà, níbití ó ti ńkọ̀wé tó sì ńdìjọ ṣeré pẹ̀lú akẹgbẹ́ aláàwàdà ọlọ́jọ́-pípẹ́ Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
rows.output: Àwọn méjèèjì ti kéde pé jara kọ̀ọ̀kan tí ń bọ̀ ni àkọ́kọ́ nínú àwọn jara mẹ́sàn-án, àti pé ó dàbí ẹni pé Kiernan ń ṣètò fún ìgbésí ayé lẹ́yìn Craiglang.
rows.reference: Àwọn méjèèjì ti kédé wipe oníṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé ìkẹẹ̀sán tó ńbọ náà yóò jẹ́ ìkẹyìn ninu eré ti ètò náà, tí o sì dàbí wípé Kiernan ńṣètò fún ìgbésí-ayé lẹ́yìn Craiglang.

rows.source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ ìjọba ṣe sọ, ó jẹ́ olùdarí Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn àtòkọ àkọsìlẹ́ ilé iṣẹ́, òun ni olùdarí Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
rows.output: Ìṣàkóso náà kọ̀ láti sọ̀rọ̀ lórí ìtàn náà, ṣùgbọ́n orísun Sun Scotland kan fi hàn pé Kiernan fẹ́ kó sínú iṣẹ́ ìdókòwò ilé oúnjẹ Glasgow tó ń dàgbà.
rows.reference: Òṣèré náà kọ láti sọ̀rọ̀ ìtàn náà, botilẹjẹpe orísun ìwé ìròyìn Scottish Sun yọ́ ọ sọpé Kiernan tí ńfojú wá ọ̀nà láti dásí ''oko-òwò ilé iṣẹ́ olóúnjẹ tó ńgbèrú'' ti Glasgow.

rows.source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
rows.output: "Òkun náà jẹ́ tiwa": Bolivia tí kò ní ìsopọ̀ pẹ̀lú òkun ń retí ilé ẹjọ́ láti tún ṣí ọ̀nà sí Òkun Pàṣífíìkì
rows.reference: 'Òkun náà jẹ́ tiwa': Orilẹ-ede Bolifia tí ilẹ̀ gbígbẹ yípo pátápátá ńretí wipe ilé ẹjọ́ yóò tún sí ọ̀nà sínú òkun Pàsífíìkì

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi ń ṣọ́ ọkùnrín kan tó ní àwọn ohun èlò ọkọ̀ ojú omi ní ilé-iṣẹ́ ológun ní La Paz.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ ogun orí-omi ńlọ káàkiri yíka àwọn olú ilé iṣẹ àwọn ọmọ ogun orí-omi tíwọn wọ̀ lásọ ní ìlú La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.reference: Awọn ilé ìjọba ńgbé àsìá aláwọ omi òkun sókê.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Àwọn ibi ìgbafẹ́ omi láti Lake Titicaca sí Amazon ni a fi àmì ẹ̀yà náà: "Òkun náà jẹ́ tiwa ní ẹ̀tọ́."
rows.reference: Àwọn ibùdó àwọn ọmọ ogun orí-omi láti adágún Titicaca sí Amazon náà ni wọ́n lẹ àkọmọ̀nà náà mọ́pé: ''Òkun náà jẹ́ tiwa nípa ẹ̀tọ́.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Láti tún un ṣe jẹ́ ojúṣe."
rows.reference: Láti gbà á padà jẹ́ ojúṣe kan.''

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: Ni gbogbo Bolivia ti o wa ni ilẹ, iranti etikun ti o sọnu si Chile ni ija ohun elo ti o ni ẹjẹ ni 19th orundun ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o wa ni ti o
rows.reference: Jákè-jádò orilẹ-ede Bolifia tí ilẹ̀ gbígbẹ yí káàkiri, ìrántí ti bèbè òkun tíwọ́n pàdánù sọ́wọ́ orilẹ-ede Ṣílè nínú aáwọ̀ ohun àmúṣọrọ̀ ti ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún ìkọkàndínlógún ninu eyiti ẹ̀jẹ̀ ti sàn sì hàn kedere - gẹ́gẹ́bí ìpòǹgbẹ láti tún tukọ̀ lórí òkun Pasífíìkì lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: Àwọn ìrètí wọ̀nyí lè jẹ́ àwọn tó ga jù lọ ní ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún, bí Bolivia ṣe ń dúró de ìpinnu ilé ẹjọ́ àgbáyé ní ọjọ́ 1 Oṣù Kẹwàá lẹ́yìn ọdún márùn-ún tí wọ́n ti ń ronú.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìrètí wọ̀nyẹn ní wọ́n wà ní bóyá nípò tóga jùlọ ninu àwọn ọdún, bí orilẹ-ede Bolifia ti ńdúró dé ìdájọ́ ilé ẹjọ́ àgbáyé lọ́jọ́ ìkínní oṣù Ọ̀wàrà lẹ́yìn àwọn ìfikùnlukùn ọdún máàrún.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "Bólífíà ní agbára, ẹ̀mí ìṣọ̀kan àti ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀, ó sì ń retí pẹ̀lú ìmúlò rere fún àbájáde náà," ni Roberto Calzadilla, ọ̀mọ̀wé àjùmọ̀fọ́ Bólífíà sọ.
rows.reference: ''Bolifia ni ipá náà tó ńti, ẹ̀mí ìṣọ̀kan àti ìbàlẹ̀-ọkàn, tí ó sì ńretí àbájáde náà pẹ̀lú ojú-ìwòye rere,'' gẹgẹ bíi Roberto Calzadilla, aṣojú orilẹ-ede Bolifia kan ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ará Bolivia yóò wo ìpinnu Ilé Ẹjọ́ Àgbáyé ní àwọn iboju tó tóbi jù lọ káàkiri orílẹ̀-èdè náà, wọ́n ń retí pé ilé ẹjọ́ ní Hague yóò rí pé Bolivia ní ẹ̀tọ́ sí ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú Chile láti gba ọ̀nà ìsọ̀rí sí òkun, lẹ́yìn ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún tí wọ́n ti ń sọ̀rọ̀ tí kò ní ìdánilójú.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede Bolifia yóô ìdájọ́ ICJ náà lórí àwọn ojú-ìwòran ńlá jáke-jádò orilẹ-ede náà, pẹ̀lú ìrètí wipe ìgbìmọ ìdájọ́ náà ní The Hague yóò fi ojú rere wo àwíjàre Bolifia wipe - lẹ́yìn àwọn ọdún ti àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí kò yọrísí rere - orilẹ-ede Ṣílè wà lábẹ́ ojúṣe tójẹ́ danfan eyiti ó ńfún Bolifia ní ẹ̀tọ́ sí ọ̀nà láti jade sí òkun náà.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, ààrẹ Bolivia tí ó ní ìfọkànsìn tí ó jẹ́ ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè - tí ó dojú kọ́ ìjà tó ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n tún dìbò lọ́dún tó ń bọ̀ - tún ní ohun púpọ̀ tó ń dúró de ìpinnu ọjọ́ Àarọ̀ yìí.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, ààrẹ orilẹ-ede Bolifia tójẹ́ ojúlówó ọmọ ìlú táyé ńfẹ́ - ẹniti on ja ìjà aláàríyànjiyàn atún dìbò yàn lọ́dún tó ńbọ̀ - tí ó sì̀ ní igùn púpọ̀ láti ṣe bákannáa lórí ìdájọ́ ti ọjọ́ Aje ́.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "A ti sunmọ́ láti padà sí Òkun Pàṣífíìkì," ó ṣe ìlérí ní August.
rows.reference: ó ṣèlérí ní òpin oṣù Ògún pe ''A ti súnmọ pípadà sí Òkun Pàsif́ìkì gidi gáàn''.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn olùṣàkóso kan gbà pé ilé ẹjọ́ kò ṣeé ṣe láti pinnu fún Bolivia—àti pé kò sí ohun tó lè yí padà bí ó bá ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọ̀mọràn kan gbàgbọ́ wipe kòṣeé ṣe kí ilé ẹjọ́ pinnu lọ́nà ti yóò ṣe orilẹ-ede Bolifia ní rere - àtipé nǹkan kékeré ni yóò yípadà bí ó bá ṣée.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka UN tó wà ní Netherlands kò ní agbára láti fún ilẹ̀ Chile, ó sì ti sọ pé kò ní ṣe ìpinnu àbájade ìjíròrò tó lè wáyé.
rows.reference: Àjọ UN náà tófìdí kalẹ̀ sí orilẹ-ede Nẹdáláǹdi kòní agbára láti fi ilẹ̀ Ṣílì dánilọ́lá, àtipé ó ti sọ wipe òun kòni pinnu àbájáde àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ṣeé ṣe.

rows.source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
rows.output: Ìtọ́nisọ́nà ICJ náà wá ní oṣù mẹ́fà lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti gbọ́ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ ìpinnu, ó túmọ̀ sí pé ọ̀ràn náà “kì í ṣe ìṣòro,” ni Paz Zárate, amoye Chilean ní òfin àgbáyé sọ.
rows.reference: Wipe ìdájọ́ ICJ náà ńwáyé ní oṣù mẹ́fà péré lẹ́yìn tíwọ́n gbọ́ àwọn àwíjàre ìgbẹ̀yìn tọ́kasíi pé ẹjọ́ náà ''kò ta kókó’,-  gẹgẹ bíi Paz Zárate, ọmọ orilẹ-ede Ṣílè kan tójẹ́ akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ ninu òfin àgbáyé ṣe sọ.

rows.source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
rows.output: Àti pé kìí ṣe láti mú kí Bolivia lọ síwájú, ọdún mẹ́rin tó kọjá lè ti mú un padà sílè.
rows.reference: Àtipé ní jíjìnnà sí mímú ìtẹ̵̀síwájú bá ìlépa orilẹ-ede Bolifia, àwọn ọdún mẹ́rin náà tókọjá leè ti fà á sẹ́yìn.

rows.source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
rows.output: "Ìṣòro ìwọlé sí òkun ti di ìdààmú láti ọwọ́ ìjọba Bolivia lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́," ni Zárate sọ.
rows.reference: “Ọ̀rọ̀ nípa àtirọ́nàde òkun náà ni ìṣàkóso orilẹ-ede Bolifia tówà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ náà ti já gbà,'' gẹgẹ bíi Zárate ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
rows.output: Ìtàn Morales ti ń ṣe ìdààmú ti mú kí gbogbo ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ tí ó ti ṣẹlẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ ní Chile, ó sọ.
rows.reference: Ọ̀rọ̀ oníjà dúndùn ti Morales ti fa ìfẹ́ inú rere tóṣékù ti orilẹ-ede Bolifia mu tán, ni ó dá láàbá.

rows.source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
rows.output: Bolivia àti Chile yóò ní ìjíròrò nígbèkù, ṣùgbọ́n yóò ṣòro gan-an láti ní ìjíròrò lẹ́yìn èyí.
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede Bolifia àti Ṣílì̀ yóò tẹ̀síwajú láti máa sọ̀rọ̀ ni àwọn ibi kan, ṣùgbọ́n yóò ṣòro gidigidi láti ní àwọn ìjíròrò lẹ́yìn èyí.

rows.source: The two countries have not exchanged ambassadors since 1962.
rows.output: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè méjèèjì náà kò tíì ṣe àjọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn aṣojú ní ọdún 1962.
rows.reference: Àwọn orilẹ-ede méjì náà kò tíì ṣe pàsípààrọ̀ àwọn aṣoju láti ọdún 1962.

rows.source: Former president Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, Bolivia's representative at The Hague, rejected the idea that the court's decision-making was unusually speedy.
rows.output: Tẹ́lẹ̀ rí, ààrẹ Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, aṣojú Bolivia ní The Hague, kọ̀ láti gbà pé ìpinnu ilé ẹjọ́ náà jẹ́ kí ó yára ju.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ tẹ́lẹ̀rí Eduardo Rodriguez Veltzé, aṣojú orilẹ-ede Bolifia ní The Hague, kọ èròǹgbà náà wipe ìpinnu-ṣíṣe ti ilé-ẹjọ́ náà tiyá kíakía ju bótiyẹ lọ.

rows.source: Monday will bring Bolivia "an extraordinary opportunity to open a new era of relations with Chile" and a chance to "put an end to 139 years of disagreements with mutual benefits," he said.
rows.output: Ọjọ Aarọ̀ yóò mú Bolivia “ànfàní àjèjì láti ṣí àkóónú tuntun ti ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Chile” àti àǹfààní láti “parí ọgọ́rùn-ún ọdún mẹ́rìnlá [139] ti ìforígbárí pẹ̀lú àwọn àǹfààní tó jẹ́ ti ara ẹni,” ó sọ.
rows.reference: O sowipe Ọjọ́ Ajé yóò mu orilẹ-ede Bolifia wọnú ''ànfààní tóṣe àrà-ọ̀tọ̀ kan láti sí ìgbà ọ̀tun ti àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Ṣílì̀'' àti ààyè kan láti ''fi òpin sí àwọn ọdún mọ́kàndínlógóje ti àwọn èdé-àìyedè pẹ̀lú àwọn àǹfààní aláàjùmọ̀je”̣̣.

rows.source: Calzadilla also denied that Morales - still one of Latin America's most popular presidents - was using the maritime issue as a political crutch.
rows.output: Calzadilla tún tako pé Morales - tó ṣì jẹ́ ààrẹ tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ ní Gúúsù Amẹ́ríkà - ń lo ọ̀rọ̀ omi gúlegúle gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun èlò ìṣèlú.
rows.reference: Bákannáà Calzadilla tún ṣẹ́ wipe Morales - tó sí jẹ ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ààrẹ̀ ilẹ Latinni Amẹ́ríkà tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ - ńlo ọ̀rọ̀ ìgbòke-gbodò lórí omi òkun bí ọ̀pákùtẹ̀lẹ̀ òṣèlú kan.

rows.source: "Bolivia will never give up its right to have access to the Pacific Ocean," he added.
rows.output: "Bólífíà kò ní fi ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ láti ní ìbàlẹ̀ sí Òkun Pásífíìkì," ó fi kún un.
rows.reference: ó tun fi kún un pe Bolifia kòní fi ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ̀ sí Òkun Pàsífíìkì náà sílẹ̀ láíláí’.

rows.source: "The ruling is an opportunity to see that we need to overcome the past."
rows.output: "Ìpinnu náà jẹ́ àǹfààní láti ríi pé a nílò láti borí ohun tí ó ti kọjá."
rows.reference: ''Ìdájọ́ náà jẹ àǹfààní láti rí i pé a nì láti borí ohun àtijọ́ náà

rows.source: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US
rows.output: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Gúúsù Kòríà sọ pé ìparun ohun ìjà àgbáyé kò ní ṣẹlẹ̀ títí tí wọ́n ó fi gbàgbọ́ pé àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà yóò ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede Àrìwá Kòríà sọpé kíkó àwọn àdó olóro dánù kòní ṣẹlẹ́ àyàfi tí òun bá leè gba orilẹ-ede US gbọ́

rows.source: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.
rows.output: Minisita fun Oro Ajeji ti North Korea, Ri Yong Ho, sọ pe orilẹ-ede rẹ yoo ma tọju ohun ija iparun rẹ ni akọkọ ti Washington ko ba ni igbẹkẹle.
rows.reference: Aláàkóso Ọ̀rọ̀ Ilẹ̀ Òkèèrè ti orilẹ-ede Àrìwá Kòríà Ri Yong sọpé orilẹ-ede òun kòni kó àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóro rẹ̀ dánù láilái bí kòbá leè gba orilẹ-ede Washingtọn gbọ́.

rows.source: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.
rows.output: Ri ń sọ̀rọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Satide ni Ìgbìmọ̀ Gbogbogbòò Àwọn Orílẹ̀-èdè Àgbáyé.
rows.reference: Ri ńsọ̀rọ̀ lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta níbi Ìpéjọpọ̀ Gbogbogbòò ti Àjọ Ìṣọ̀kan Àgbáyé náà.

rows.source: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.
rows.output: Ó pe orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà láti tẹ̀síwájú lórí àwọn ìlérí tí wọ́n ṣe nígbà ìpàdé kan ní Singapore láàárín àwọn olórí àwọn alátakò.
rows.reference: Ó pe orilẹ-ede Àmẹ́ríkà láti tẹ̀lé àwọn ìlérí tí ó ṣe nígbà ìpàdé kan ní orilẹ-ede Singapore láàrin àwọn adarí tí ńbá ara wọn ṣe orogún náà.

rows.source: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ wá gẹ́gẹ́ bí Akọ̀wé Ìṣọ̀kan Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, Mike Pompeo ṣeé ṣe láti tún ìjíròrò àgbègbè ìparun tí ó ti di ìdákẹ́jẹ́ fún oṣù mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn ìpàdé Singapore pẹ̀lú Kim Jong Un ti North Korea.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ wá bí US. Akọwe ti Ilẹ̀ Òkèèrè Mike Pompeo ti ńṣe bí ẹnití ó wà ní bèbe àtítúnbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjíròrò lórí ọ̀rọ̀ àdó olóró tóti dúró sójú kan ju oṣù mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn ti Singapore náà pẹ̀lú Kim Jong Un ti Àríwá Kòríà.

rows.source: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.
rows.output: Ri sọ pé ó jẹ́ “láàlà” pé ìdènà tí ó ń lọ àti ìdáhùnpadà tí U.S. ṣe sí ìkéde tí ó parí Ogun Koria yóò jẹ́ kí ìlà-oòrùn dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ri sọpé ó jẹ́ ''àlá tí kò leè ṣẹ'' kan wipe àwọn ìjẹniníyà tó ńtẹ̀síwájú àti àtakò ti U.S. sí ìkéde kan tó ńparí Ogun Kòríà yóò mú Àríwá náà wá sórí àwọn orúnkún rẹ̀.

rows.source: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.
rows.output: Washington ti wa ni iṣọra lati gba ikede naa lai ṣe Pyongyang ni akọkọ ṣe awọn gbigbe iparun pataki.
rows.reference: Washington ńsọ́raṣè láti faramọ́ ìkéde náà láijẹ́ wipe Pyongyang kọ́kọ́ gbé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ pàtàkì láti kó àwọn nǹkan ogun dánù.

rows.source: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.
rows.output: Mejeeji Kim ati Aarẹ Amẹrika Donald Trump fẹ́ ìpàdé kejì.
rows.reference: Kim àti U.S. Ààrẹ Donald Trump fẹ́ ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì.

rows.source: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìdààmú ńlá ni pé Pyongyang ṣe pàtàkì sí ìdáwọ́lè fún ohun ìjà tí orílẹ̀-èdè náà ṣeé ṣe kí ó rí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀nà kan ṣoṣo láti fi ìdáàbò bo ààbò rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n ìsiyèméjì tótàn káàkiri wà wipe Pyongyang  kòfi ọ̀rọ̀ ṣeré nípa kíkọ àwọn nǹkan ogun tí orilẹ-ede náà rí bí ọ̀nà kan ṣoṣo láti jẹ́kí ààbò rẹ̀ dájú sílẹ̀.

rows.source: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.
rows.output: Pompeo n gbero lati ṣabẹwo si Pyongyang ni oṣu ti nbọ lati gbaradẹ fun ipade keji Kim-Trump.
rows.reference: Pompeo ńṣètò láti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí Pyongyang lóṣù tó ńbọ láti gbaradì fún ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì Kim-Trump kan.

rows.source: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you
rows.output: Àwọn àfihàn aṣọ Paris ṣàfihàn ìlà tókàn nínú àwọn aṣọ tí ó tóbi jù lọ lórí ọ̀nà rẹ̀ sí ọ̀nà ìtajà kan tó wà nítòsí rẹ
rows.reference: Àfihàn aṣọ wíwọ̀ ti ìlú Paris fi ìlà àṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀jáde tuntun ninu nǹkan àwọ̀sóri tópọlọ́kan lójú ọ̀nà rẹ̀ sí Òpópónà High nítòsí rẹ.

rows.source: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.
rows.output: Ti o ba fẹ lati faagun ikojọpọ fila rẹ tabi ki o bo oju oorun patapata, wo ko si siwaju.
rows.reference: Bí o báfẹ́ mú ìgbéga bá àkójọpọ̀ ate-orí rẹ tàbí kí o dínàmọ́ òòrùn náà pátápátá máṣe wá a lọ síwájú mọ́.

rows.source: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Àwọn apẹẹrẹ Valentino àti Thom Browne ṣe àfihàn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ohun èlò orí tó tóbi jù lọ, tó sì ń ṣe àfihàn àwọ̀tọ́wọ́tọ́ fún àkójọpọ̀ SS19 wọn lórí pẹpẹ, tó sì ń ṣe ìyàlẹ́nu àwọn olùkópa ní Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Àwọn aránsọ Valentino àti Thom Browne sị́́ óju àkójọpọ àwọn asọ wíwọ̀ orí wọn eyiti o bùyààri fún àkójọpọ̀ SS19 wọn lójú ọ̀nà-eré náà eyiti o ta àkojọpọ̀ irúfẹ́ wọn yọ níbi Ọ̀sẹ̀ Àfihàn Asọ ní Ìlú Paris.

rows.source: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.
rows.output: Àwọn ìbọ̀wọ̀ tí kò ṣeé ṣe ní wọ́n ti ń fọ́ Instagram ní ìgbà ooru yìí, àwọn oníṣèdá wọ̀nyí sì ti fi àwọn ẹ̀dá wọn tí ó ń fa ojú sílẹ̀ sílẹ̀ sórí pẹpẹ ìtàgé.
rows.reference: Àwọn ate-ori tí kòṣeé lò lọ́nà tóga ti gba Instagram pátá nígbà ooru yìí ti àwọn aránsọ wọ̀nyí sì ti fi àwọn ìṣẹ̀dá wọn tó ńṣẹ́jú síni ránṣẹ́ sí ìsàlẹ̀ àwọn ọ̀nà tóóró náa.

rows.source: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.
rows.output: Ẹ̀yà tó ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ láti ọ̀dọ̀ Valentino ni ọ̀pá àwọ̀tọ́ kan tó tóbi gan-an, tó ní ìrísí ẹ̀fọ́ kan, tó sì bo orí àwọn aṣọ.
rows.reference: Iṣẹ́ ara-ọ̀tọ̀ kan tótayọ láti ọwọ́ Valentino ni ate aláwọ̀ búráùn tó-ń-fòlókè eyiti wọ́n fi àṣomọ́ tódàbí ìyẹ́ sí etí-òkè rẹ̀ tókún gbogbo orí àwọn àwòṣe náà.

rows.source: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.
rows.output: Àwọn ohun èlò tó tóbi jù lọ ni àwọn ọ̀pọ̀tọ́ omi, àkísà ọ̀pọ̀tọ́ àti ọ̀pọ̀tọ́ ọ̀pọ̀tọ́ - ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò ṣe láti mú orí rẹ̀ gbóná.
rows.reference: Àwọn àṣomọ tí ìwọ̀n wọn pọ̀ lápọ̀jù ní àwọn ẹ̀gúsí-olómi tíwọ́n ṣe lọ́ọ̀ṣọ́, ate-orí oṣó kan àti ọ̀pọ̀n-òyìnbó kan - ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò rán wọn láti jẹ́kí ori rẹ móooru.

rows.source: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne tun ṣafihan akojopọ awọn ibori aibikita-ati ni akoko to tọ fun Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne tún ṣàfihàn àṣàyan ti àwọn ìbòjú tókọyìnsáyé - tíwọn sí dé láàkókò tóyẹ fún àjọdún Halloween.

rows.source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn màsìkì aláwọ̀ tí wọ́n fi ọwọ́ ṣe ẹnu wọn, wọ́n sì dàbí ẹni pé wọ́n jẹ́ bíi Hannibal Lecter ju haute couture lọ.
rows.reference: Púpọ̀ ninu àwọn ìbòjú náà niwọ́n rán àwọn ètè wọn pa ti wọ́n sì jọ Olóri-ogun Hannibal Lecter ju àwọn asọ tó ńgbayì lóde ìwòyí lọ.

rows.source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
rows.output: Ìdá kan jẹ́ ohun tí ó dàbí ohun èlò ìdáwọ́ omi tí ó ní snorkel àti goggles, nígbà tí èkejì dàbíi ìyàrá yinyin tí a ti yo.
rows.reference: Ìṣẹdá kan jọ àwọn asọ ẹ̀rọ ìbẹ́lumi tí ó pé pẹ̀lu ẹ̀rọ amúnimílábẹ-omi àti àwọn awò ojú, nigbati òmíràn wò bíi òkòtó ohun mímu aládùn dídì bíi yìnyín tóti yo.

rows.source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
rows.output: Àti pé bí o bá tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìṣípayá ẹ̀wà ńlá- o ní orire.
rows.reference: Àtipé bí ó bá tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú gbólóhùn asọ ìgbàlódé tó gbòòrò náà- ó ṣe oríire.

rows.source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
rows.output: Àwọn olùṣàkóso aṣọ ń sọ pé àwọn ìbọ̀sọ̀ ńláńlá lè ń lọ sí àwọn òpópónà tó wà nítòsí rẹ.
rows.reference: Àwọn olùwòran àrà sọtẹ́lẹ̀ wipe àwọn ate-ori títóbi tíwọn ńsomó àgbọ̀n náà leè máa wá ọ̀nà wọn dé àwọn òpópónà ńlá nítòsí rẹ̀.

rows.source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: Àwọn ìbọ̀wọ́ ńláńlá ń bọ̀ lọ́wọ́ àwọn ẹsọ̀rù 'La Bomba', ìbọ̀wọ́ onígi tí ó ní ìbọ̀wọ́ tí ó gùn ní ẹsọ̀rù méjì tí a ti rí ní gbogbo ibi láti ọ̀dọ̀ Rihanna sí Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: Àwọn ate-ori oníwọn-ńlá náà dé ní yàjóyàjó lẹ́yìn gìgìrísẹ̀ ti 'La Bomba', ate-ori tíwọn fi ìko hun pẹ̀lú etí oníwọn ẹsẹ̀ bàtà méjì ní fífẹ̀ eyiti wọ́n ńrí lórí gbogbo eniyan láti orí Rihanna dé Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.
rows.output: Àmì ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀yà ẹ
rows.reference: Àlẹ̀mọ́ ẹ̀ṣìn náà tówà lẹ́yìn ate-ori tóṣòro láti lò  tíwọ́n fọ́n káàkiri ojú-òpò ìbáṣepọ̀ ayelujara fi ìṣẹ̀dá ńlá miran rańṣẹ́ sísàlẹ̀ ojú ìrìn náá - àpò etíkun tíwọ́n fi ìko hun tí ó fẹ́rẹ̀ tóbi tó asọ ìwẹ̀lódò àwòṣe náà tí ó kó o jọ papọ̀.

rows.source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Àpótí tí a fi awọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣe àwọ̀ tí a fi ń ṣ
rows.reference: Àpọ raffia aláwọ̀ omi-ọsàn tóti jóna náà, tíwọn fi raffia gbá létí tíwọ́n sì fi awọ funfun kan ṣe ìfàlọ́wọ́ rẹ̀, ni ó dádúró yàtọ̀ níbi àkójọpọ̀ ti Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 ní Ọ̀sẹ̀ Àfihàn Asọ ní Ìlu Paris.

rows.source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
rows.output: Olùṣàkóso olùṣàkóso Luke Armitage sọ fún FEMAIL: 'Mo ń retí láti rí àwọn ìbọ̀wọ̀ ńlá àti àwọn àpò etíkun dé sórí òpópónà fún ìgbà ọ̀dún tó ń bọ̀ - gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùṣàkóso ti ṣe ìyàlẹ́nu tó, yóò ṣòro láti foju foju wo ìbéèrè fún àwọn ohun èlò ńlá.'
rows.reference: Ìlúmọ̀ọ́ká gbajúmọ̀ afasọdárà Luke Armitage sọ fún FEMAIL: ''Mo ńretí láti rí àwọn ate-ori ńlá àti awọn àpò ìfàlọ́wọ́ etíkun ní òpópónà ńlá fún ìgba ooru tókàn - bí aránsọ náà ti ṣèdá irú ipa títóbi yóò ṣòro láti fóju fo àwọn ìbéèrè fún àwọn àṣomọ́ oníwọ̀n-tópọ̀lápọ̀jù náà.

rows.source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
rows.output: John Edward: Ìmúlò èdè pàtàkì fún àwọn ará àgbáyé
rows.reference: John Edward: Àwọn ìmọ̀ èdè jẹ kòṣeémáàní fún àwọn ọmọ ìlú àgbáyé

rows.source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
rows.output: Àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ tí ó jẹ́ òmìnira ní Scotland ń ṣetọ́jú ìtọ́kasí ẹ̀kọ́ gíga, èyí sì ti tẹ̀síwájú ní ọdún 2018 pẹ̀lú àtòkọ àwọn àbájáde ìdánwò tí ó tayọ, èyí tí ó tún jẹ́ kí ìyàsímímọ́ àti ìyàsímímọ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan àti ti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ nínú eré ìdárayá, ẹ̀dá, orin, àti àwọn ìgbìmóṣe àwùjọ mìíràn.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ti ilẹ̀ Sikọtiland ńsì ríipé àkọsílẹ̀ eyiti o lààmì-laaka wọn ninu ẹ̀kọ́ tótayọ sì wà síbẹ̀, tí èyí sì ńtẹ̀síwájú lọ́dún 2018 pẹ̀lú àkójọpọ̀ àwọn èsì ìdánwò miran, eyiti wọ́n fún lágbára nípa àṣeyọrí ẹnìkọ̀òkan àti alápapọ̀ ninu eré ìdárayá, iṣẹ́-ọwọ́, orin àti àwọn ìdáwọlé àwùjọ.

rows.source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
rows.output: Pẹ̀lú àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tó lé ní 30,000 ní gbogbo ilẹ̀ Scotland, àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ wọ̀nyí, tí a ṣe aṣoju rẹ̀ ní Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Àwọn Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ Aládani ti Scotland (SCIS), ń tiraka láti pèsè iṣẹ́ tó dára jùlọ fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti àwọn òbí wọn.
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lu àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tíwọ́n tó ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ọgbọ̀n jákè-jádò Sikọtiland, àwọn ilé ìwé wọ̀nyí, ti igbìmọ̀ ti àwọn Ilé ìwé olómìnira Ilẹ Sikotiland ńṣojú fún. ńgbìyaǹjú láti máa pèsè iṣẹ́ onípele tódára jùlọ fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti àwọn òbí wọn.

rows.source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
rows.output: Àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ alágbára ń wá láti mú àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ wọn lọ́wọ́ fún ẹ̀kọ́ síwájú àti gíga, iṣẹ́ tí wọ́n yàn, àti ipò wọn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè àgbáyé.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ńlépa láti gba àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ wọn lárádi fún ẹ̀kọ́ tójinlẹ̀ tí o síga síi, iṣẹ́-ìṣe tíwọ́n yàn láàyò àti ipò wọn gẹ̵́gẹ́bí ọmọ ìlú àgbáyé.

rows.source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀ka ẹ̀kọ́ tí ó lè ṣe àtúnṣe àti ṣe àtúnṣe ètò ẹ̀kọ́ ilé ẹ̀kọ́ kan, a ń rí èdè ìgbàlódé tí ń tẹ̀síwájú gẹ́gẹ́ bí kókó tó gbajúmọ̀ àti tí a fẹ́ nínú àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́.
rows.reference: Bí ẹ̀ka ètò ẹ̀kọ́ kan eyiti ó leè ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ètò tí ó sì leè ṣàmúlò ètò ìkẹkọ̀ọ́ ti ilé ìwé àṣetẹ́ra-ẹnilọ́rùn kan, a ńrí àwọn èdè ọ̀làjù tó ńtẹ̀síwájú bí iṣẹ́ kan tógbajúmọ̀ táyé-ńfẹ́ láàrin àwọn ilé ìwé.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela sọ pé: “Bí o bá bá ọkùnrin kan sọ̀rọ̀ ní èdè tí ó lè lóye, ìyẹn yóò wà ní orí rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela sọpé: ''Bí o bá sọ̀rọ̀ sí ọkùnrin kan ní èdè tí ó yé e, ìyẹn yóò wọ inú orí rẹ lọ.

rows.source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
rows.output: Bí o bá bá a sọ̀rọ̀ ní èdè rẹ̀ tó jẹ́ ti ara rẹ̀, ìyẹn yóò kan ọkàn rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí o bá sọ̀rọ̀ sí i ní èdè tiẹ gan-aṇ̀ ìyẹn yóò wọ inú ọkàn rẹ lọ.''

rows.source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.output: Èyí jẹ́ ìrantí tí ó lágbára pé a kò lè gbẹ́kù lé èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìkan nígbà tí a bá fẹ́ ṣe ìbáṣepọ̀ àti ìgbọ́kùú pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn láti orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
rows.reference: Èyí jẹ́ ìránnilétí tólágbára kan wipe a kò kàn leè gbáralé èdé Gẹ́ẹ̀si nigbati a báfẹ ṣàgbéró àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn eniyan latí àwọn orilẹ-ede miran.

rows.source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
rows.output: Láti inú àwọn àbájáde ìdánwò tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ jáde ní ọdún yìí, a lè rí i pé àwọn èdè ń ṣe àtọkànwá nínú àwọn tábìlì ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìwọ̀n àṣeyọrí tó ga jù lọ nínú àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ aládàáni.
rows.reference: Láti àwọn èsì ìdánwò àìpẹ́ ti ọdún yìí, a leè ríi pé àwọn èdè ló ńwà lókè àwọn tábìlì líìgí náà  pẹ̀lú àwọn òdiwọn ìṣọwọ́yege láàrin àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira.

rows.source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
rows.output: Ìpìlẹ̀ 68 ní ọgọ́rùn-ún nínú àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí wọ́n kọ́ èdè òkèèrè tí wọ́n gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ gíga A.
rows.reference: Àpapọ ìdá méjìdínláàdọrin ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí wọ́n kọ́ èdè ilẹ̀ òkèèrè lógba giredi Giga A.

rows.source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
rows.output: Ìtàn náà, tí a gbà láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ mẹ́rìnlélọ́gọ́rin [74] tó jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ SCIS, fi hàn pé 72 ní ọgọ́rùn-ún nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà gba àmì A gíga nínú Mandarin, nígbà tí 72 ní ọgọ́rùn-ún nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn tí wọ́n ń kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ èdè Jámánì, 69 ní ọgọ́rùn-ún nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn tí wọ́n ń kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ èdè Faransé àti 63 ní ọgọ́rùn-ún nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn tí wọ́n ń kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ èdè Sípéènì tún gba
rows.reference: Àkọsilẹ̀ dátà náà, tíwọ́n gbà láti ọwọ́ àwọn ilé ìwé mẹ́rìnléláàádọ́rin tójẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ SCIS fihàn pé ìdá méjìléláàádọ́rin ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gba giredi A Giga ninu èdè Mandarin, nigbati ìdá méjìléláàádọ́rin ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti àwọn tó ńkọ́ èdè Jamani, ìdá mọ́kàndínláàádọ́rin ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti àwọn tó ńkọ́ èdè Faranṣe, àti ìdá mẹ́tàdínláàádọ́rin ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti àwọn tó ńkọ́ èdè Sipeeni bákannáà gba giredi A.

rows.source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
rows.output: Èyí fi hàn pé àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ tí kò ní ìbàjẹ́ ní Scotland ń ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún àwọn èdè òkèèrè gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ọgbọ́n tí ó ṣe pàtàkì tí àwọn ọmọdé àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ yóò nílò ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
rows.reference: Èyì ńfihàn wipe àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ní ilẹ Sikọtilandi ńṣàtílẹ́yìn fún àwọn èdè ilẹ̀ òkèèrè gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn ìmọ̀ tóṣe pàtàkì èyìtí àwọn ọmọdé àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ yóò nílò láisì àní-àní lọ́jọ́ iwájú.

rows.source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
rows.output: Àwọn èdè báyìí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀ka-ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́, ni a ń gbà gbọ́ pé ó jẹ́ ìbọ̀wọ̀ kan náà pẹ̀lú STEM (ìmúlò sáyẹ́ǹsì, ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ, ẹ̀kọ́ ẹ̀rọ, àti ìṣirò) nínú àwọn ètò ẹ̀kọ́ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ aládàáni àti níbikíbi.
rows.reference: Àwọn èdè nísinsìnyí, bí i̇ṣẹ́ yíyàn, niwọ́n ńmú pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ àpọ́nlẹ́ kaǹ gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn iṣẹ́ STEM (sáyẹ́ńsì, tẹkinọlọji, ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ àti ẹ̀kọ́ ìsiró tójinlẹ̀) ninu àwọn ìlànà ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira àti níbiimíràn.

rows.source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
rows.output: Ìwádìí tí UK Commission for Employment and Skills ṣe ní ọdún 2014 rí i pé lára àwọn ìdí tí àwọn agbanisíṣẹ́ fi ń tiraka láti kún àwọn ipò, 17 nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún ni wọ́n sọ pé ó jẹ́ àìsí ọgbọ́n èdè.
rows.reference: Ìwáàdí nípa èrò-ọkàn àwọn ènìyàn láti ọwọ Ìgbìmọ̀ Amúṣẹ́ṣe fún Ìgbaniṣíṣẹ́ àti Àwọn Ìmọ̀ lọ́dún 2014 ṣàwárí pé ninu àwọn ìdí tí àwọn agbaniṣ̵íṣẹ́ sọ fún lílàkàkà wọn láti di àwọn ààyè òṣìṣẹ́ tó ṣófo, ìdá mẹ́tàdínlógún ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún wọn ni wọ́n sọpé ó jẹ́ nitori àìni ìmọ̀ ède miraǹ.

rows.source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
