rows.output: Vettel ya shiga cikin tarkacen farko kuma ya bar Hamilton ya yi gudu zuwa cikin cikar jikar a karshen tarukan, wanda ya kamata ya zama mai yanke hukunci.
rows.reference: Vettel ya shiga cikinf filin farko kuma ya bar Hamilton don ya shiga cikin zirga-zirga a wutsiyar fakitin, wani abin da ya kamata ya kasance na yanke shawara.

rows.source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
rows.output: Motar Mercedes ta tsaya a zagayowar gaba bayan hucewar ta, amma Hamilton ya ci gaba bayan wani yanayi na gasa da ya ga direban Ferrari ya bar wurin da ya dace a cikin hadarinsa na biyu don kare a kusurwar uku.
rows.reference: Mercedes ya zarce layi daga baya kuma ya fito bayan Vettel, amma Hamilton ya yi gaba bayan wani tukin kan duki da sukayi da direban Ferrari wanda ya bari ba da son ran shi cikin kyakkyawan yanayi na rike wa bayan yunkuri-biyu na kare kusurwa na uku.

rows.source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.
rows.output: Max Verstappen ya fara daga layin da ya fi karshe na grid kuma ya kasance na bakwai a karshen farko na zagaye a ranar haihuwarsa ta 21.
rows.reference: Max Verstappen ya fara daga jerin baya na grid kuma ya kasance a cikin bakwai bayan ƙarshen karon farko a ranar haihuwarsa 21.

rows.source: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.
rows.output: Daga nan ya jagoranci mafi yawan tseren ya riƙe tayoyinsa don nufin gamawa cikin sauri ya zarce Kimi Raikkonen na hudu.
rows.reference: Sai ya jagoranci babban ɓangare na tseren yayin da yake rike da tayar don ya kai ga dagacin karewa da sauri kuma ya samu shan gaban Kimi Raikkonen na hudu.

rows.source: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.
rows.output: A ƙarshe ya zo cikin tarkacen a zagayen na 44 amma bai sami damar ƙara saurin sa a cikin saura takwas na zagayen ba yayin da Raikkonen ya ɗauki na hudu.
rows.reference: Daga bisani sai ya shiga cikin filin a karo na 44 amma bai sami damar kara karfinsa a sauran ragowan karon takwas ba yayin da Raikkonen yazo na hudu.

rows.source: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.
rows.output: Wannnan rana ce mai wahala saboda Valtteri ya yi aiki mai kyau a duk lokacin da muka yi wasa kuma ya kasance mutum mai kyau da ya bar ni.
rows.reference: Rana ce mai wuya saboda Valtteri ya yi aiki mai kyau cikin dukan karshen mako kuma ya kasance mai saukin kai da ya gaya mini.

rows.source: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar ta yi aiki sosai don samun matsayi na ɗaya da biyu," in ji Hamilton.
rows.reference: Kungiyar sunyi aikin yabawa da suka sami na daya da biyu,” cewar Hamilton.

rows.source: That Was Really Bad Body Language
rows.output: Wannan Ya Yi Muguwar Harsashi
rows.reference: Wannan mumunan alamar nuni ne

rows.source: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.
rows.output: Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump ya yi dariya kan Sanatan Dianne Feinstein a wani gangami a ranar Asabar kan taɓar da ta yi cewa ba ta fitar da wasiƙar da Christine Blasey Ford ta yi wa alkalin kotun koli Brett Kavanaugh na cin zarafi.
rows.reference: Shugaban kasar Donald Trump ya zolayi Sanata Dianne Feinstein a wani taron sintirin a ranar Asabar game da zarginta cewa ba ta fitar da wasika daga Christine Blasey Ford ba, da ke zargin zababben dan Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh akan cin zarafin jima'i.

rows.source: Speaking at a rally in West Virginia, the president did not directly address the testimony given by Ford before the Senate Judiciary Committee, instead commenting that what was going on in the Senate showed that people were "mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: A yayin wani gangami a West Virginia, shugaban kasa bai yi magana kai tsaye kan shaidan da Ford ya bayar a gaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dinkin Amurka ba, maimakon haka ya bayyana cewa abin da ke faruwa a majalisar dinkin ya nuna cewa mutane "suna da zagi da mugunta da rashin gaskiya."
rows.reference: Da yake jawabi a taron sintirin a West Virginia, shugaban kasa ya ba da adireshin da Ford ya bayar a gaban komitin shari'ar Majalisar Dattijai, maimakon bayyana cewa abin da ke gudana a Majalisar Dattijai ya nuna cewa mutane sun kasance "maƙaryata marar sa gaskiya."

rows.source: "The one thing that could happen and the beautiful thing that is going on over the last few days in the Senate, when you see the anger, when you see people that are angry and mean and nasty and untruthful," he said.
rows.output: "Abin da zai iya faruwa kuma abin da ya fi kyau da ke faruwa a cikin Majalisar a cikin 'yan kwanaki da suka gabata, lokacin da kake ganin fushi, lokacin da kake ganin mutane masu fushi da mugunta da mugunta da rashin gaskiya," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Abu daya da zai iya faruwa da kuma kyakkyawar abin da ke faruwa a cikin 'yan kwanakin karshe a Majalisar Dattijai, lokacin da su ka ga fushi, lokacin da ka ga mutanen masu fushi da tauri kuma maƙaryata marar sa gaskiya," in ji shi.

rows.source: "When you look at releases and leaks and then they say "oh, I didn't do it.
rows.output: "Idan ka duba sakin da kuma zubewar, sai su ce "oh, ban yi ba.
rows.reference: “Idan ka kalli sakewan da fitowan bayanan sirri kuma sai suce “kai, ba ni nayi ba.

rows.source: I didn't do it."
rows.output: "Ban yi ba."
rows.reference: Ba ni nayi ba.”

rows.source: Remember?
rows.output: Ka tuna?
rows.reference: Ka tuna?

rows.source: Dianne Feinstein, did you leak?
rows.output: Dianne Feinstein, ka yi satar?
rows.reference: Dianne Feinstein, ka fitar?

rows.source: Remember her answer... did you leak the document - "oh, oh, what?
rows.output: Ka tuna amsarta... ka yi amfani da takardan? - "oh, oh, me?
rows.reference: Ka tuna da amsarta ... shin ka fitar da wannan takardar - "oh, oh, mene?

rows.source: Oh, no.
rows.output: A'a, ba.
rows.reference: Oh, a’a.

rows.source: I didn't leak."
rows.output: Ba na yin tsagaita."
rows.reference: Ban fitar ba.”

rows.source: Well, wait one minute.
rows.output: To, jira mintuna ɗaya.
rows.reference: To, jira minti daya.

rows.source: Did we leak...No, we didn't leak," he added, in an impression of the senator.
rows.output: Mun yi...A'a, ba mu yi ba," ya kara, a cikin kamannin sanata.
rows.reference: Shin mun fitar dashi... A'a, ba mu fitar ba, "ya kara da cewa, kamar yadda sanatan ya nuna.

rows.source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
rows.output: An aika da wasiƙar da ke bayyana zarginsa da aka yi wa Kavanaugh ga Feinstein a watan Yuli, kuma an yi ta a watan Satumba, amma Feinstein ta musanta cewa an yi ta daga ofishin ta.
rows.reference: An aika ma Feinstein wasikar da ke dauke da bayanan zargin da ake ma Kavanaugh daga Ford a watan Yulin, kuma takaddar ta fita a farkon watan Satumbar - amma Feinstein ya musanta zargin cewa daga cikin ofishin takaddar ta fito.

rows.source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
rows.output: "Ban ɓoye da'awar Dr. Ford ba, ban fitar da labarin ta ba," in ji Feinstein ga kwamitin, The Hill ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: “Ban boye ba Dr. Zargin, ban fitar da labarinta ba,” Feinstein ya fada ma kwamitin, Hill suka ruwaito.

rows.source: "She asked me to hold it confidential and I kept it confidential as she asked."
rows.output: "Ta roƙe ni in ɓoye shi kuma na ɓoye shi kamar yadda ta roƙe."
rows.reference: "Ta ce min in rike shi da sirri kuma na aje shi asiri kamar yadda ta ce min."

rows.source: But her denial did not appear to sit well with the president, who commented during the Saturday night rally: "I'll tell you what, that was really bad body language.
rows.output: Amma kin musanta hakan bai ji dadin shugaban kasa ba, wanda ya yi tsokaci a lokacin taron ranar Asabar: "Zan gaya miki, hakan na da muguwar al'amarar jiki.
rows.reference: Amma rashin amincewarta bai nuna ya samu shiga a wurin shugaban kasa ba, wanda ya yi sharhi yayin taron sintirin daren Asabar: “Zan fada maka wani abu, Wannan mummunan alamar nunin jiki ne.

rows.source: Maybe she didn't, but that's the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Wataƙila ba ta yi ba, amma wannan shine mafi muni da na taɓa gani."
rows.reference: Wataƙila ba ta yi ba, amma wannan ita ce mafi munin alamar nunin jiki da na taɓa gani. "

rows.source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
rows.output: Ci gaba da kare shugaban kotun koli, wanda aka zarge shi da cin zarafi ta hanyar jima'i da mata uku, shugaban ya ba da shawarar cewa 'yan Democrat suna amfani da zarge-zargen don amfaninsu.
rows.reference: Yayin ci gaba da kare zababbun Kotun Koli, wanda ake zargi da cin zarafin jima’i daga mata uku, shugaban ya bada shawarar cewa jam'iyyar Democrat ta yi amfani da zargin don biyan bukatar su.

rows.source: "They are determined to take back power by any means necessary.
rows.output: "Suka yi niyyan su dawo da iko ta kowace hanya da ta dace.
rows.reference: “Sun jajirce don karbar mulki ta ko wane hali.

rows.source: You see the meanness, the nastiness, they don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over to get power and control," Mediaite reported the president saying.
rows.output: Ka ga munafuncinsu, mugun halinsu, ba su damu da wanda suka cutar ba, wanda suka yi amfani da shi wajen samun iko da iko," Mediaite ta ruwaito shi.
rows.reference: Kuna ganin muguntar, rashin da’a, ba su damu da waɗanda suka cutar ba,waɗanda zasu cutar domin su samu mulki da iko, Mediaite ya ruwaito shugaban kasar na cewa.

rows.source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.output: League Elite: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.reference: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants

rows.source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
rows.output: Patrick Dwyer ya zura kwallaye biyu ga Giants a kan Dundee
rows.reference: Patrick Dwyer ya zura kwallaye biyu ma Giants ga Dundee

rows.source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
rows.output: Taurarin Dundee sun yi wa rashin nasara a gasar Elite League da Belfast Giants a ranar Juma'a, ta hanyar lashe wasan da aka yi a Dundee a ranar Asabar da ci 5-3.
rows.reference: Kungiyar Dundee Stars sun dau fansar rashin da sukayi ga Elite League a kan Belfast Giants ta hanyar lashe gasar 5-3 a Dundee ranar Asabar.

rows.source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
rows.output: An fara da kwallaye biyu daga hannun Patrick Dwyer da Francis Beauvillier.
rows.reference: Kungiya The Giants ne suka fara samun damar zura kwallo biyu ta hanyar Patrick Dwyer da Francis Beauvillier.

rows.source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
rows.output: Mike Sullivan da Jordan Cownie sun kawo daidaikun 'yan wasan gida, kafin Dwyer ya dawo da Giants a gaba.
rows.reference: Mike Sullivan da Jordan Cownie sun kawo matakin gida kafin Dwyer ya sake jagorancin Giants.

rows.source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
rows.output: François Bouchard ya zura kwallo a raga ga Dundee, kafin kwallayen Lukas Lundvald Nielsen biyu suka tabbatar da nasara.
rows.reference: Francois Bouchard ya ci kwallon da suka zo kunnen doki da Dundee kafin kwallo biyun Lucas Lundvald Nielsen su zama nasarar su.

rows.source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
rows.output: An yi wa Adam Keefe na uku a kakar wasa ta Elite League, wanda ya zo daga baya ya doke Dundee da ci 2-1 a Belfast a daren Juma'a.
rows.reference: Wannan dai shi ne karo na uku na gasar cin kofin kwallon kafa da Elite League suka rasa ga 'yan wasan Adam Keefe, wanda daga baya ya buga Dundee 2-1 a Belfast a daren ranar Jumma'a.

rows.source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
rows.output: An yi wasan na hudu a kakar a tsakanin kungiyoyin biyu, inda Giants suka lashe wasanni uku da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Shi ne karo na hudu na kakar a tsakanin bangare biyun,da Giants su na cin wassannin da suka gabata guda uku.

rows.source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
rows.output: An bude wasan Dwyer a minti na hudu a 3:35 daga taimakon Kendall McFaull, tare da David Rutherford ya ba da taimako yayin da Beauvillier ya ninka kwallayen a mintoci hudu bayan haka.
rows.reference: Buɗewar Dwyer ya zo minti na hudu a kan 3:35 daga taimakon Kendall McFaull, tare da David Rutherford ya ba da taimakon kuma Beauvillier ninka jagorancin zuwa biyu minti hudu gabani.

rows.source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
rows.output: A cikin wani lokacin bude, Sullivan ya dawo da kungiyarsa zuwa wasan a minti na 13:10, sannan Matt Marquardt ya zama mai bayar da gudummawa ga Cownie a minti na 15:16.
rows.reference: wasan da yayi kamari daga farawa, Sullivan ya dawo da gidan su wasan cikin wasan a 13:10 kafin Matt Marquardt ya zama mai taimakawa a cin Cownie' na kunnen doki a 15:16.

rows.source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
rows.output: Dwyer ya tabbatar da cewa Giants sun ɗauki jagora zuwa lokacin hutun farko lokacin da ya zura kwallo ta biyu a daren a karshen lokacin farko.
rows.reference: Dwyer ya tabbatar da cewa Giants sun jagoranci wasan a farkon lokaci da ya ci kwallo na biyu na daren a karshen wannan lokacin.

rows.source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
rows.output: An sake haɗewa a gida kuma Bouchard ya sake sanya su a mataki ɗaya da burin wasan da ya yi a minti na 27:37.
rows.reference: Ƙungiyar da ke gidasun sun canza salo kuma Buchard ta sake jirkita su da wasan kwallon fin karfi akan 27:37.

rows.source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
rows.output: Cownie da Charles Corcoran sun taimaka wa Nielsen ya ba Dundee jagora a karon farko a wasan a karshen rabin na biyu, kuma ya tabbatar da nasara da kwallaye na biyar a tsakiyar rabin karshe.
rows.reference: Cownie da Charles Corcoran sun hade don taimakama Nielsen don ya ba Dundee jagoraci a karo na farko a wasan a karshen wasa biyu kuma ya tabbatar da nasarar da ta samu a rukuni na biyar na tawagar a karshen wasa yakai karshe.

rows.source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
rows.output: Kwallayen, wadanda yanzu sun yi rashin nasara a wasanni hudu na karshe, za su yi wasan gida da Milton Keynes a wasan da za su yi a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: Giants, waɗanda yanzu suka rasa hudu daga wasanni biyar na baya, su na cikin gida da Milton Keynes a wasan da za su buga na gaba a ranar Jumma'a.

rows.source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
rows.output: Mai kula da zirga-zirgar jirgin sama ya mutu don tabbatar da cewa mutane da yawa a cikin jirgin na iya tserewa girgizar kasa
rows.reference: Mai kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama ya mutu don tabbatar da rayuwar mutane a cikin jirgin sama sun tseru daga girgizar kasa

rows.source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
rows.output: Wani mai kula da zirga-zirgar jirgin sama a Indonesia ya samu yabo a matsayin jarumi bayan ya mutu domin ya tabbatar da cewa jirgin da ke dauke da mutane da yawa ya tashi cikin aminci.
rows.reference: An yaba ma wani mai kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama a Indonesiya a matsayin gwarzo bayan ya mutu don tabbatar da cewa jirgin saman da ke dauke da daruruwan mutane ya tashi lafiya daga ƙasa.

rows.source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
rows.output: Akwai sama da mutane 800 da suka mutu kuma da yawa suna bace bayan wani babban girgizar kasa ya afku a tsibirin Sulawesi a ranar Juma'a, wanda ya haifar da tsunami.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane 800 sun mutu kuma mutane da yawa sun bata bayan babban girgizar kasa ya mamaye tsibirin Sulawesi a ranar Jumma'a, yayin da ya haifar da tsunami.

rows.source: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.
rows.output: Ƙarfafa girgizar ƙasa na ci gaba da damun yankin kuma da yawa suna makale a cikin tarkacen a birnin Palu.
rows.reference: Kananan girgizar kasa mai karfi sun ci gaba da zama annoba a yankin kuma mutane da yawa su na cikin tarzoma a birnin Palu.

rows.source: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.
rows.output: Amma duk da abokan aikinsa sun gudu don rayuwarsu, Anthonius Gunawan Agung mai shekaru 21 ya ki barinsa a kan babban ginin da ke jujjuyawa a filin jirgin sama na Mutiara Sis Al Jufri na Palu.
rows.reference: Amma duk da abokan aikin sa sun gudu don tserar da rayukansu, Anthonius Gunawan Agung, mai shekaru 21, ya ki ya bar gurin aikin sa a gini hasumiya a filin jirgin saman Maniara Sis Al Jufri dake filin jirgin saman Palu.

rows.source: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.
rows.output: Ya tsaya a wurin don tabbatar da cewa jirgin Batik Air 6321, wanda ke kan titin jirgin sama a lokacin, zai iya tashi lafiyayye.
rows.reference: Ya ci gaba da tabbatar da cewa Batik Air Flight 6321, wanda yake kokarin tashi a lokacin, ya tashi lafiya.

rows.source: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.
rows.output: Sannan ya yi tsalle daga kan ginin sarrafa zirga-zirga lokacin da ya yi tunanin yana rugujewa.
rows.reference: Yayi tsalle daga ginin hasumiyar a lokacin da yayi tunanin zai zube.

rows.source: He died later in hospital.
rows.output: Ya mutu daga baya a asibitin.
rows.reference: Ya mutu daga baya a asibiti.

rows.source: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.
rows.output: Mai magana da yawun jirgin sama na Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, ya ce wannan shawaran na iya ceto rayuka da yawa, a cewarararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararar
rows.reference: Mai magana da yawun kamfanin Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, ya ce hukuncin zai iya ceto daruruwan rayuka, rahoton ABC News na Australia.

rows.source: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.
rows.output: Mun shirya jirgin sama daga Balikpapan a Kalimantan don kai shi babban asibiti a wani birni.
rows.reference: Mun shirya jirgi mai tashin angulu daga Balikpapan a Kalimantan don ya dauke shi zuwa babban asibiti a wani garin.

rows.source: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.
rows.output: Abin takaici, mun rasa shi da safe kafin jirgin ya kai Palu.
rows.reference: Wani abin bakin ciki shi ne mun rasa shi a wannan safiya kafin jirgi mai tashin angulun ya isa Palu.

rows.source: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.
rows.output: "Zuciyarmu ta fashe da jin wannan," ya kara.
rows.reference: "Zukatanmu na cikin jimamin jin wannan labarin," in ji shi.

rows.source: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, hukumomi suna tsoron cewa adadin wadanda suka mutu na iya kai ga dubu tare da hukumar kare muhalli ta ƙasar ta ce cewa samun damar shiga garuruwan Donggala, Sigi da Boutong ya takaita.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, hukumomi su na tsoron cewa mutuwar za ta iya kaiwa dubbai da hukumar rage bala’o’i ta kasar na cewa samun damar shiga garuruwan Donggala, Sigi da Boutong takaitacce ne.

rows.source: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.
rows.output: "Ana ganin cajin ya ci gaba da karuwa tun da har yanzu akwai jikoki da dama a ƙarƙashin tarkacen yayin da da yawa ba a iya isa ba," in ji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho.
rows.reference: "An yi imani akwai yiwuwar karuwar matattun tunda gawawwaki da yawa na karkashin fasashshen jirgin yayin da an kasa samun da yawan su," in ji kakakin kungiyar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho.

rows.source: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.
rows.output: Guguwar ruwa mai tsawon mita shida ta lalata Palu, wanda zai gudanar da jana'izar tarayya a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Taguwar ruwa da ya kai kimanin mita shida ya lalata Palu wanda za a binne gawawwakin wuri daya ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.
rows.output: Jiragen sama na soja da na kasuwanci suna kawo agajin gaggawa da kayan aga.
rows.reference: Jirgin sojoji da jiragen sama na haya su na kawo taimako da kayayyaki.

rows.source: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: Risa Kusuma, wata mata mai shekaru 35, ta gaya wa Sky News: "Kowane mintuna, motocin daukar marasa lafiya suna kawo gawarwaki.
rows.reference: Risa Kusuma, mahaifiyar mai shekaru 35, ta bayyana ma Sky News: "Kowane minti motar asibiti na kawo gawawwaki.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce.
rows.output: Ruwan da ba ya da kyau yana da wahala a samu.
rows.reference: Ruwa mai tsafta na da wahalar samu.

rows.source: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."
rows.output: Ana satar shagunan karami a ko'ina."
rows.reference: Ana kama kananan kasuwanni a ko'ina. "

rows.source: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.
rows.output: Jan Gelfand, shugaban kungiyar Red Cross ta kasa da kasa a Indonesia, ya gaya wa CNN: "Kungiyar Red Cross ta Indonesia na gudu don taimakawa wanda ya tsira amma ba mu san abin da za mu samu a can ba.
rows.reference: Jan Gelfand, shugaban kungiyar international Red Cross a Indonesia, ya shaida wa CNN: "Red Cross din Indonesia yana gaggawar zuwa don taimaka ma waɗanda suka rayu amma ba mu san abin da za su samu a can ba.

rows.source: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."
rows.output: Wannan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya ƙara tabarbarewa."
rows.reference: Wannan abun bakin ciki ne, amma zai iya fin haka. "

rows.source: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.
rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Indonesiya Joko Widodo ya isa Palu a ranar Lahadi ya gaya wa sojojin ƙasar: "Ina rokon ku duka ku yi aiki rana da dare don kammala dukkan ayyuka da suka shafi ceto.
rows.reference: Shugaban kasar Indonesiya, Joko Widodo, ya isa Palu ranar Lahadi kuma ya shaidawa sojojin kasar: "Ina umurtar ku duka ku yi aiki dare da rana don kammala dukkan ayyukan da suka shafi fitarwa.

rows.source: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
rows.output: Shin kun shirya?" CNN ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: Kun shirya?” CNN suka ruwaito.

rows.source: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.
rows.output: An yi ta'addanci a Indonesia a wannan shekarar ta girgizar kasa a Lombok, wanda ya yi sanadiyyan mutuwar sama da mutane 550.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar, Indonesia ta samu girgizar kasa a Lombok, inda mutane fiye da 550 suka mutu.

rows.source: Micronesia plane crash: Air Niugini now says one man missing after lagoon plane crash
rows.output: Halin jirgin sama na Micronesia: Air Niugini yanzu ya ce mutum ɗaya ya ɓace bayan hadar jirgin ruwa
rows.reference: Hadarin Jirgin Micronesia Air Niugini sun ce mutum daya ya bata bayan hadarin jirgin sama

rows.source: The airline operating a flight that crashed into a Pacific lagoon in Micronesia now says one man is missing, after earlier saying all 47 passengers and crew had safely evacuated the sinking plane.
rows.output: Halin jirgin sama da ya yi hatsari a cikin wani lagon Pacific a Micronesia yanzu ya ce mutum daya ya bace, bayan da ya fara cewa duk fasinjoji 47 da ma'aikatan jirgin sun fita cikin aminci daga jirgin da ke nutsewa.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jiragen saman da ke aiki da jirgin da ya fada cikin tekun Pacific a Micronesia yanzu ya ce mutum guda ya bata, bayan da ya fadi cewa duk fasinjoji 47 da ma'aikatan jirgin da aka ceto daga cikin jirgin sama.

rows.source: Air Niugini said in a release that as of Saturday afternoon, it was unable to account for a male passenger.
rows.output: Halin da Air Niugini ta fitar ya bayyana cewa a ranar Asabar da yamma, ba ta iya gano wani fasinjoji.
rows.reference: Air Niugini sun ce a cikin takarda da su ka saki cewa tun daga ranar Asabar da yamma, ba su iya bada bayanin namiji daya ba.

rows.source: The airline said it was working with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to try to find the man.
rows.output: Sakatarorin jirgin ya ce suna aiki da hukumomin gida, asibitoci da masu bincike domin nemo mutumin.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jirgin sama sun ce su na aiki tare da hukumomi, asibitoci da masu bincike don kokarin gano mutumin.

rows.source: The airline did not immediately respond to requests for more details about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.
rows.output: Halin jirgin ya yi watsi da buƙatun ƙarin bayani game da fasinjojin, kamar shekaru ko ƙasa.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jirgin sama bai amsa tambayoyin nan da nan ba don ƙarin bayani game da fasinja, kamar shekarunsa ko kasa

rows.source: Local boats helped rescue the other passengers and crew after the plane hit the water while trying to land at the Chuuk Island airport.
rows.output: Jiragen ruwa na gida sun taimaka wajen ceto sauran fasinjoji da ma'aikatan jirgin bayan ya yi karo da ruwa yayin da yake kokarin sauka a filin jirgin sama na Chuuk.
rows.reference: kwale-kwalen gargajiya sun taimaka wajen ceton sauran fasinjoji da ma'aikatan bayan jirgin ya fada ruwa yayin da yake ƙoƙarin sauka a filin jirgin saman Chuuk Island.

rows.source: Officials said on Friday that seven people had been taken to a hospital.
rows.output: An ruwaito a ranar Juma'a cewa mutane bakwai an kai su asibiti.
rows.reference: Jami'ai sun ce ranar Jumma'a mutane bakwai ne aka kai asibiti.

rows.source: The airline said six passengers remained at the hospital Saturday, and all of them were in stable condition.
rows.output: Halin da kamfanin jirgin ya ce, fasinjoji shida ne suka rage a asibitin ranar Asabar, kuma duk sun kasance cikin yanayi mai kyau.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jiragen sama sun ce mutane shida fasinjoji sun kasance a asibiti a ranar Asabar, kuma dukansu su na cikin yanayi mai kyau.

rows.source: What caused the crash and the exact sequence of events remains unclear.
rows.output: Abin da ya haifar da hadarar da kuma jerin abubuwan da suka faru a cikin su har yanzu ba a bayyana su ba.
rows.reference: Abin da ya haifar da hadarin da kuma ainihin jerin abubuwan da suka faru ya kasance a boye.

rows.source: The airline and the U.S. Navy both said the plane landed in the lagoon short of the runway.
rows.output: Halin jirgin ya sauka a cikin lagon, kafin ya kai kan titin jirgin sama.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jirgin sama da Amurka Sojan ruwa duka sun ce jirgin saman ya sauka a cikin gabar kogin ta saboda karancin hanyar gudu.

rows.source: Some witnesses thought the plane overshot the runway.
rows.output: Wasu shaidu sun yi tunanin jirgin ya wuce filin jirgin sama.
rows.reference: Wasu shaidu sun yi zaton jirgin ya zarce hanyar gudun ne.

rows.source: American passenger Bill Jaynes said the plane came in very low.
rows.output: Matsayin jirgin sama na Amurka Bill Jaynes ya ce jirgin ya zo da kyau.
rows.reference: Fasinjan Amurka Bill Jaynes ya ce jirgin saman ya zo a kasa sosai.

rows.source: "That's an extremely good thing," said Jaynes.
rows.output: "Wannan abu ne mai kyau sosai," in ji Jaynes.
rows.reference: "Wannan abu ne mai kyau," in ji Jaynes.

rows.source: Jaynes said he and others managed to wade through waist-deep water to the emergency exits on the sinking plane.
rows.output: Jaynes ya ce ya yi nasara da wasu wajen shiga ruwa mai zurfi zuwa hanyoyin tserewa a cikin jirgin da ke nutsewa.
rows.reference: Jaynes ya ce shi da wasu sun gudanar da tafiya cikin zurfin ruwa zuwa bude kofar gaggawa ga jirgin dake nutsewa.

rows.source: He said the flight attendants were panicking and yelling, and that he suffered a minor head injury.
rows.output: Ya ce ma’aikatan jirgin suna firgita kuma suna ihu, kuma ya samu rauni a kai.
rows.reference: Yace masu ma’aikatan jirgin saman sun rikice su na ihu, kuma ya sha wahala da rauni a kansa.

rows.source: The U.S. Navy said sailors working nearby on improving a wharf also helped in the rescue by using an inflatable boat to shuttle people ashore before the plane sank in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water.
rows.output: Sojin ruwa na Amurka sun ce ma'aikatan da ke wurin gyara tashoshin jiragen ruwa sun taimaka wajen ceto ta hanyar amfani da kwale-kwalen da za a iya fesawa don jigilar mutane zuwa bakin teku kafin jirgin ya nutse a cikin zurfin mita 30 (kafa 100) na ruwa.
rows.reference: U.S din. Rundunar sojan ruwa ta ce masu aikin jirgi na aiki a kusa don inganta tashar jirgin ruwa kuma sun taimaka wajen ceto ta hanyar amfani da kwale-kwale mai iska don jigilar mutane zuwa gefen ruwa kafin jirgi ya nutse a cikin mita 30 (feet 100) na ruwa.

rows.source: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates 111 people have died in crashes of PNG-registered airlines in the past two decades but none involved Air Niugini.
rows.output: Bayanan daga Cibiyar Tsaro ta Jiragen Sama sun nuna cewa mutane 111 sun mutu a hadurran da suka shafi jiragen sama da aka yi wa rajista a Papua New Guinea a cikin shekaru ashirin da suka gabata, amma babu wanda ya shafi Air Niugini.
rows.reference: Bayanai daga Cibiyar Tsaro na Jirage ya nuna cewa mutane 111 sun mutu a hadarin PNG-kamfanonin jiragen sama mai rajista a cikin shekaru ashirin da suka gabata amma babu wanda ya shafi Air Niugini.

rows.source: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive
rows.output: Mai nazari ya bayyana jadawali na daren da akaona mace a cikin kogon.
rows.reference: Masu bincike sun fitar da zangon lokacin dare da aka ƙona matar da rai

rows.source: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
rows.output: An kammala shari'ar a ranar Asabar a sake shari'ar wani mutum da ake zarginsa da kashe wata mata a Mississippi da wuta a shekarar 2014.
rows.reference: Mai Shari'ar ya dakatar da shari'arsa a ranar Asabar a lokacin da aka yanke hukuncin wani mutumin da ake tuhumar kone matar Mississippi da rai a shekarar 2014.

rows.source: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.
rows.output: An yi wa mai binciken shari'a na Ma'aikatar Shige da Fice ta Amurka, Paul Rowlett, shaida na tsawon sa'o'i a matsayin kwararre a fannin nazarin bayanai.
rows.reference: Amurka Mai bincike na sashen Ma'aikatar Shari'a Paul Rowlett ya bada shaida na tsawon sa'o'i kamar yadda mai shaidar gani da ido gwani yake a cikin binciken yake.

rows.source: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.
rows.output: Ya bayyana wa juriya yadda ya yi amfani da rajistar waya don haɗa motsin mai shekaru 29, Quinton Tellis, da kuma wanda aka azabtar, mai shekaru 19, Jessica Chambers, a daren da ta rasu.
rows.reference: Ya bayyana wa alkalai yadda ya yi amfani da daukar murya ta wayar salula yana bibiyar mai shekaru 29 Quinton Tellis mai aikata laifi da mai shekaru 19 da haihuwa, Jessica Chambers wadda aka aikata wa laifin, a daren da ta mutu.

rows.source: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .
rows.output: Rowlett ya ce ya samu bayanan wuri daga waya da yawa da ke nuna cewa Tellis yana tare da Chambers a daren da ta rasu, wanda ya sabawa da ikirari da ya yi a baya, a cewar The Clarion Ledger.
rows.reference: Rowlett ya ce ya karbi bayanan wuri daga wasu wayoyin salula wanda ya nuna cewa Tellis yana tare da Chambers a yammacin mutuwar ta, ya saba wa zargin da ya gabata, in ji Clarion Ledger.

rows.source: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.
rows.output: Lokacin da bayanan suka nuna cewa waya ce ta Chambers a lokacin da ya ce yana tare da abokinsa Michael Sanford, ‘yan sanda sun tafi su yi magana da Sanford.
rows.reference: Lokacin da bayanai suka nuna cewa wayarsa ta kasance tare da Chambers 'a lokacin da ya ce yana tare da abokinsa Michael Sanford,' yan sanda sun yi magana da Sanford.

rows.source: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.
rows.output: Sanford ya tsaya a kan shiri a ranar Asabar ya shaida cewa bai kasance a garin a wannan ranar ba.
rows.reference: Sanford ya haw akwaki a ranar Asabar kuma ya shaida cewa ba ya garin a wannan rana ba.

rows.source: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."
rows.output: Lokacin da alkalan suka tambayi ko Tellis yana cewa gaskiya ne lokacin da ya ce yana cikin motar Sanford a daren, Sanford ya ce yana "ƙarya, saboda motar tana Nashville."
rows.reference: Lokacin da masu gabatar da kara suka tambaye shi idan Tellis yana faɗar gaskiya lokacin da ya ce yana cikin motar Sanford a wannan dare, Sanford ya ce yana "kwance, domin motar tana Nashville."

rows.source: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.
rows.output: Wani rashin daidaito shi ne cewa Tellis ya ce ya san Chambers kusan makwanni biyu kafin ta mutu.
rows.reference: Wani kuma rashin daidaito shi ne cewa Tellis ya ce ya san Chambers ne kusan sati biyu kafin mutuwar ta.

rows.source: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.
rows.output: Rikodin waya sun nuna cewa sun san juna tsawon mako guda kawai.
rows.reference: bayanan waya sun nuna cewa sun san juna ne kawai a sati daya.

rows.source: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.
rows.output: Rowlett ya ce wani lokaci bayan mutuwar Chambers, Tellis ya goge saƙonnin, kira da bayanan tuntuɓar Chambers daga waya.
rows.reference: Rowlett ya ce wani lokaci bayan mutuwar Chambers, Tellis ya goge sakonin Chambers, kira da bayanin lamba daga wayarsa.

rows.source: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.
rows.output: "Ya goge ta daga rayuwarsu," Hale ya faɗa.
rows.reference: "Ya goge ta daga rayuwarsa," in ji Hale.

rows.source: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.
rows.output: An tsara karewa ya fara gabatar da hujjojinsa a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Za a fara sauraron masu kare shi a ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.
rows.output: Alkalin ya ce yana sa ran shari’ar za ta kai ga juriya a wannan ranar.
rows.reference: Alkalin ya ce yana tsammanin za a gabatar da shari'a zuwa ga alkalai bayan wannan ranar.

rows.source: The High Breed: What is conscious hip hop?
rows.output: The High Breed: Menene conscious hip hop?
rows.reference: Jinsi Mai Saurin Girma: Menene sanannen hip hop?

rows.source: A hip hop trio wants to challenge the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.
rows.output: Wani rukunin hip hop na son kalubalantar ra'ayin da ba daidai ba na nau'in ta hanyar cika kiɗansu da saƙonnin da suka cika da kyau.
rows.reference: Wasu hip hop uku na so su kalubalanci ra'ayi mara kyau game da jinsin ta hanyar cikawa da kiɗa tare da sakonni masu kyau.

rows.source: The High Breed, from Bristol, claim hip hop moved away from its origins of political messages and tackling social issues.
rows.output: The High Breed, daga Bristol, sun yi iƙirarin cewa hip hop ya tafi daga asalin sa na saƙon siyasa da magance matsalolin zamantakewa.
rows.reference: Jinsi Mai Saurin Girma, daga Bristol, da'awar cewa hip hop ya bar shi asalin sakonnin siyasa da kuma magance matsalolin zamantakewa.

rows.source: They want to go back to its roots and make conscious hip hop popular again.
rows.output: Suna son komawa ga tushen sa kuma su sanya waƙar hip hop ta sanin kai ta zama shahara.
rows.reference: Su na son komawa tushensu kuma su yi sanannen hip hop da zai dawo da martabar su.

rows.source: Artists like The Fugees and Common have seen a recent resurgence in the UK through artists such as Akala and Lowkey.
rows.output: Masu zane kamar The Fugees da Common sun ga sabunta shahara a Birtaniya ta hanyar masu zane kamar Akala da Lowkey.
rows.reference: Mawaki kamar Fugees da Common sun ga sake tashin shi a Birtaniya ta hanyar fasaha irin su Akala da LowKey.

rows.source: Another black person?!
rows.output: Wani baƙar fata?!
rows.reference: Wani baƙar fata?!

rows.source: NY nanny sues couple over firing after "racist" text
rows.output: Ma'aikaciyar Jinya ta New York ta yi ƙararrawar ma'aurata kan korar da ta yi bayan "maganar ƙin jituwa"
rows.reference: Mai kula da yaran NY tayi karan ma’aurata akan koranta bayan rubutun "wariyar launin fata"

rows.source: A New York nanny is suing a couple for discriminatory firing after receiving a misdirected text from the mother complaining that she was "another black person."
rows.output: Ma'aikaciyar Jinya a New York tana neman diyya daga ma'aurata saboda korar ta bisa la'akari da la'akari da ita bayan ta samu saƙo mara kyau daga mahaifiyarta tana cewa tana "wata baƙar fata."
rows.reference: Mai kula da yara a New York tayi karan ma’aurata akan koranta ba bisa ka’ida ba bayan rubutun da ba ita aka nufata daga wata uwa tana korafin cewa ita "wata baƙar fata ce kuma"

rows.source: The couple deny they are racist, likening the suit to "extortion."
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun musanta cewa su 'yan tsiraru ne, suna kwatanta karar da "damfarar."
rows.reference: Ma’auratan sun karyata cewa su na da wariyar launin fata, cewa karar na da alaka da “kwace”

rows.source: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, a mother of two, expressed dismay when finding out that the new child care provider, Giselle Maurice, was black upon arriving for her first day of work in 2016.
rows.output: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, wata uwa mai yara biyu, ta nuna rashin jin dadi lokacin da ta gano cewa sabon mai kula da yara, Giselle Maurice, baƴe ce a ranar farko ta aiki a 2016.
rows.reference: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, mahaifiyar mai yaya biyu, ta nuna damuwa lokacin da aka gano cewa sabon mai kulawa da yara, Giselle Maurice, baƙar fata ce daga isowa a ranar ta na farkon aiki a shekarar 2016.

rows.source: "NOOOOOOOOOOO ANOTHER BLACK PERSON," wrote Mrs Plasco-Flaxman to her husband in a text.
rows.output: "BA KOMA BAKIYYA," Mrs Plasco-Flaxman ta rubuta wa mijinta a cikin rubutu.
rows.reference: “a’aaaaaaaaaaaaaa WATA BAKAR FATA,” in ji Misis Plasco-Flaxman ga mijinta a cikin rubutu.

rows.source: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Maurice, twice.
rows.output: Duk da haka, maimakon ta aika masa da shi, ta aika masa da shi ga Ms. Maurice sau biyu.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, maimakon aikawa zuwa ga mijinta, ta aika ta ga Ms. Maurice, sau biyu.

rows.source: After realizing her gaffe, an "uncomfortable" Plasco-Flaxman fired Ms. Maurice, stating that their outgoing nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and that she was instead expecting a Filipino, according to the New York Post.
rows.output: Bayan da ta gane kuskurensa, Plasco-Flaxman ya yi wa Ms. Maurice "mugun yanayi" ya kore ta, yana mai cewa mai kula da yara na fitowa, wanda Ba'amurke ne, ya yi mummunan aiki kuma suna sa ran wani Filipino ne, a cewar New York Post.
rows.reference: Bayan ta gane kuskurenta, "rashin jin dadi" Plasco-Flaxman ya kori Ms. Maurice, inda ta bayyana cewa tsohuwar ma’aikaciyar tasu wace yar afuruka-Amurka ce, ta yi mummunan aiki kuma yana da tsammanin za a kawo Filipino ne, a cewar New York Post.

rows.source: Ms. Maurice was paid for her one day of work and then sent home for an Uber.
rows.output: Misis Maurice ta samu albashi don ranar da ta yi aiki sannan aka tura ta gida don Uber.
rows.reference: An biya ms. Maurice kudin aikin ta na rana daya sannan kuma aka tura ta gida da uber.

rows.source: Now, Maurice is suing the couple for compensation over the firing, and is seeking compensation to the tune of $350 a day for the six-month, live-in gig she had initially been hired to do, albeit without a contract.
rows.output: Yanzu, Maurice yana neman di da mata diyya kan korar, kuma yana neman diyya da ta kai dala 350 a rana na tsawon watanni shida na aikin da ta fara yi, duk da cewa ba tare da kwangila ba.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, Maurice na karan ma'aurata don biyan diyya a kan koranta, kuma tana neman biyan diya da ya kai $ 350 a rana na watanni shida, kamar yadda yake a hayar aikin da aka dauke ta tayi, albeit ba tare da kwangila ba.

rows.source: "I want to show them, look, you don't do stuff like that," she told the Post on Friday, adding "I know it's discrimination."
rows.output: "Ina so in nuna musu, duba, ba ku yi abubuwa kamar haka ba," ta gaya wa Post a ranar Juma'a, inda ta kara da "Na san hakan na nuna wariya."
rows.reference: "Ina so in nuna musu, duba, ba’a yon abubuwa irin haka," ta fada ma Post a Jumma'a, kara da cewa "Na san don nuna bambanci ne."

rows.source: The couple have hit back at the claims that they are racist, saying that terminating Maurice's employment was the reasonable thing to do, fearing they could not trust her after offending her.
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun yi tir da da'awarsu cewa suna da wariya, inda suka ce cire Maurice daga aiki shine abin da ya dace, suna tsoron ba za su iya amincewa da ita ba bayan ta yi musu.
rows.reference: Ma'auratan sun sake mai da martani sunce mu ba ma nuna alamun wariyar launin fata, su na cewa koran Maurice abin da ya kamata su yi kenan, saboda tsoron ba za ta amince da su ba bayan sun aikata mata laifin.

rows.source: "My wife had sent her something that she didn't mean to say.
rows.output: "Matata ta aika mata wani abu da ta yi niyyan ta yi.
rows.reference: “Matata ta tura ma ta wani abu da bashi take nufin fada ba.

rows.source: She's not a racist.
rows.output: Ba ta da son rai.
rows.reference: Bata nuna wariyar launin fata.

rows.source: We're not racist people," husband Joel Plasco told the Post.
rows.output: Mun kasance ba mutane masu son launinsu ba," mijin Joel Plasco ya gaya wa Post.
rows.reference: mu ba masu nuna wariyar launin fata bane, “mijin Joel Plasco ya fadawa Post.

rows.source: "But would you put your children in the hands of someone you've been rude to, even if it was by mistake?
rows.output: "Amma za ka ba wa 'ya'yanka ga wani da ka yi wa rashin mutunci, ko da kuwa da kuskure?
rows.reference: "Amma za ku sanya 'ya'yanku a hannun wani wanda kuka kasance da yiwa laifi, ko da kuwa ta kuskure ne?

rows.source: Your newborn baby?
rows.output: Jaririn ku?
rows.reference: Jariri sabon haihuwa?

rows.source: Come on."
rows.output: "Kai, zo."
rows.reference: haba dai.’’

rows.source: Likening the suit to "extortion," Plasco said his wife was just two months off having a baby and was in a "very difficult situation."
rows.output: Kwatanta karar da "damfarar," Plasco ya ce matarsa ​​ta kasance kusan wata biyu daga haihuwa kuma tana cikin "mawuyacin hali."
rows.reference: ya na kwatanta kara da “kwace,” Plasco ya ce matarsa na da ciki wanda bai wuce watanni biyu ta samu jariri ba don haka tana cikin "yanayi mai wahala."

rows.source: "You're going to go after someone like that?
rows.output: "Za ka je ka yi wa wani irin haka?
rows.reference: "Za ku goyi bayan irin wannan abun?

rows.source: That's not a very nice thing to do," the investment banker added.
rows.output: Ba abu ne mai kyau ba," wani mai ba da lamuni ya kara.
rows.reference: Wannan ba abu ne mai kyau ba, "in ji ma’aikacin bankin zuba jari.

rows.source: While the legal case is still ongoing, the court of public opinion has been quick to denounce the couple on social media, slamming them for their behavior and logic.
rows.output: Yayin da shari'ar har yanzu tana ci gaba, kotun jama'a ta yi sauri wajen zargi da suka yi a shafukan sada zumunta, suna sukar su da halayensu da kuma tunaninsu.
rows.reference: Duk da yake shari'a na kan gudana, kotun ra'ayi na jama'a sun gaggauta suka ga ma'auratan a kan labarun kafofin watsa labarai, su na kushe su saboda halayyarsu da tsarin.

rows.source: Paddington publishers feared readers wouldn't relate to a talking bear, new letter reveals
rows.output: Masu buga Paddington sun ji tsoron cewa masu karatu ba za su iya danganta da bear mai magana ba, sabon wasiƙa ta bayyana.
rows.reference: Masu buga littafan Paddington su na tsoron masu karatu ba zasu so alaka da ‘yar tsana mai magana ba, sabuwar wasika ta ruwaito

rows.source: Bond's daughter Karen Jankel, who was born shortly after the book was accepted, said of the letter: "It's hard to put oneself in the shoes of somebody reading it for the first time before it was published.
rows.output: Ɗiyar Bond, Karen Jankel, wacce aka haifa kusan nan da littafin ya karɓi, ta ce game da wasiƙar: "Yana da wuya a sanya kanka a cikin takalmanka na wani da ke karanta shi a karon farko kafin a buga shi.
rows.reference: ‘yar Bond, Karen Jankel, wacca aka haifa ba da daɗewa ba bayan an yarda da littafin, ya ce: "Yana da wuya ka saka kanka cikin takalmin wanda ya karanta shi a karo na farko kafin a buga shi.

rows.source: It's very amusing knowing now what we know about Paddington's huge success."
rows.output: Yana da ban sha'awa sanin yanzu abin da muke da shi game da Paddington's babban nasara."
rows.reference: Yana da kyau yanzu a san abin da muka sani game da babban nasara na Paddington."

rows.source: Saying her father, who had worked as a BBC cameraman before being inspired to write the children's book by a small toy bear, would have been sanguine about his work being rejected, she added the 60th anniversary of the books publication was "bittersweet" after his death last year.
rows.output: Ta ce mahaifinsa, wanda ya yi aiki a matsayin mai daukar hoto na BBC kafin ya samu wahayi ya rubuta littafin yara bayan ya ga wata karamar bear, zai yi farin ciki da aikin da aka yi watsi da shi, ta kara cewa, bayan mutuwar mahaifinsa a shekarar da ta gabata, ranar cikar shekaru 60 da buga littafin "ta yi daci".
rows.reference: Da yake cewa mahaifinta, wanda ya yi aiki a matsayin mai daukar hoto a BBC kafin a yi masa wahayi don ya rubuta littafin yara ta hanyar karama ‘yar tsana, da yayi da na sani inda littafin bai karbu ba, ta kara da ranar bukin cikar littafin 60th da bugawa ya "mai wahala da dadi" bayan mutuwa sa a bara.

rows.source: Of Paddington, whom she describes as a "very important member of our family," she added her father was quietly proud of his eventual success.
rows.output: Na Paddington, wanda ta bayyana a matsayin "mamba mai matuƙar muhimmanci a cikin iyalinmu," ta kara cewa mahaifinsa yana da farin ciki a cikin shuru game da nasarar da ya samu a ƙarshe.
rows.reference: Daga Paddington, wadda ta bayyana a matsayin "mai mahimmanci daga cikin iyalinmu," in ji ta cewa mahaifinta yana da alfaharin da girman nasararsa.

rows.source: "He was quite a quiet man, and he wasn't a boastful person," she said.
rows.output: "Mutumin yana da shuru sosai, kuma ba ya son yabonsa," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Shi mutum ne shiru-shiru, kuma bai kasance mai alfahari ba," inji ta.

rows.source: "But because Paddington was so real to him, it was almost like if you have a child who achieves something: you're proud of them even though it's not your doing really.
rows.output: "Amma saboda Paddington ya kasance a gare shi, kamar yadda za ku kasance masu alfahari da yaranku idan sun cim ma wani abu: kina alfahari da su duk da cewa ba shi da alaƙa da ku da gaske.
rows.reference: "Amma saboda Paddington sun kasance ainihin masu gaskiya a gare shi, yana cewa danka ne yayi wata nasara babba: zaka yi alfahari akan su ko da yake ba haka bane ba.

rows.source: I think he viewed Paddington's success sort of in that way.
rows.output: Ina ganin ya ga nasara ta Paddington kamar haka.
rows.reference: Ina tsammanin ya ga irin nasarar da Paddington ke yi, a wannan hanyar.

rows.source: Although it was his creation and his imagination, he always used to give the credit to Paddington himself."
rows.output: Duk da cewa shi ne ya halicce shi da tunaninsa, sai ya ci gaba da ba da kima ga Paddington da kansa.
rows.reference: Ko da yake shi ne halittarsa da tunaninsa, ya kasance yana ba da girmamawa ga Paddington da kansa."

rows.source: My daughter was dying and I had to say goodbye over the phone
rows.output: Ɗiyata tana mutuwa kuma dole ne in yi waƙa a waya
rows.reference: ‘ya ta tana mutuwa kuma dole in yi mata bankwana a kan waya

rows.source: On landing her daughter had been rushed to Nice's Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, where doctors worked in vain to save her life.
rows.output: Lokacin da jirgin ya sauka, an kai 'yarta zuwa asibitin Louis Pasteur na Nice 2, inda likitoci suka yi ƙoƙarin da ba su yi nasara ba wajen ceto rayuwarta.
rows.reference: Su na sauke an yi gaggawar kai 'yarta asibitin Nice a Louis Pasteur 2, inda likitoci suka yi aiki a banza don ceto rayuwarta.

rows.source: "Nad was calling regularly to say it was really bad, that she wasn't expected to make it," said Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.output: "Nad ta kira akai-akai tana cewa yana da tsanani sosai, cewa ba a sa ran ta yi shi ba," in ji Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.reference: "Nad na kira a kai a kai don ya ce yana da muni sosai, wai bazata tashi ba," in ji Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.

rows.source: "Then I got the call from Nad to say she was going to die within the next two minutes and I had to say goodbye to her.
rows.output: Sannan na samu kiran Nad da ta ce za ta mutu cikin mintuna biyu masu zuwa kuma dole ne in yi mata bankwana.
rows.reference: "Sai na samu kiran daga Nad don cewa za ta mutu a cikin minti biyu nan gaba kuma dole in yi mata bankwana.

rows.source: And I did.
rows.output: Na yi.
rows.reference: Kuma na yi.

rows.source: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, darling.
rows.output: Na ce, "Tashi, ina son ku sosai, masoyina.
rows.reference: Na ce, "Tashi, ina son ki sosai, abar ƙaunata.

rows.source: I'll be with you soon.
rows.output: Zan kasance da kai nan ba da jimawa ba.
rows.reference: Zan kasance tare da ke ba da dadewa ba.

rows.source: I'll be with you.
rows.output: Zan kasance tare da kai.
rows.reference: Zan kasance tare da ke.

rows.source: The drugs doctors had given her to keep her heart pumping were slowly petering out and leaving her system.
rows.output: Magungunan da likitocin suka ba ta don ta ci gaba da bugun zuciya suna janyowa a hankali kuma suna barinta.
rows.reference: Magungunan da likitoci suka bata don ya cigaba da sa zuciyar ta aiki, sun fara dena aiki a hankali kuma su na barin yikinta.

rows.source: She had died some time before hand and this was it all shutting down.
rows.output: Ta mutu shekaru da dama kafin nan kuma wannan shi ne duk abin da ya rage.
rows.reference: Ta mutu wasu yan lokuta kafin yanzu kuma Wannan shi ke rufewa duka.

rows.source: I had to just sit there and wait, knowing this was all unfolding.
rows.output: Na yi ƙoƙarin in zauna a wurin in jira, na san wannan yana faruwa.
rows.reference: Dole na zauna kawai in jira, sanin cewa komai na warwarewa.

rows.source: I couldn't howl or scream or cry because I was in a situation surrounded by families and people.
rows.output: Ba zan iya yunƙurin yunƙurin yunƙurin yunƙurin ba saboda ina cikin wani yanayi da ke kewaye da iyalai da mutane.
rows.reference: Na kasa kuka ko ihu saboda ina zagaye da yan’uwa da mutane.

rows.source: I had to really hold it together."
rows.output: Na yi matuƙar ƙoƙari na riƙe shi tare."
rows.reference: Nayi iya kokarina don natsuwa.”

rows.source: Eventually Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, by now grieving for the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane alongside the other passengers - oblivious to the ordeal she was going through.
rows.output: A ƙarshe Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, yanzu tana cikin baƙin ciki saboda rasuwar 'yarta, ta shiga jirgin sama tare da sauran fasinjoji - ba tare da sanin wahalar da take ciki ba.
rows.reference: Daka karshe Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, ya zuwa yanzu tana jimamin mutuwar ‘yar ta, ta shiga jirgin tare da sauran fasinjojin- ba tare da la'akari da bala'in da ta ke ciki ba.

rows.source: "No-one knew," she said.
rows.output: "Babu wanda ya sani," ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ba wanda ya sani,”ta ce.

rows.source: "I had my head down, and tears were falling the whole time.
rows.output: Na yi kukan da na ke yi, na yi ta kuka.
rows.reference: “Nasa kaina a kasa, kuma hawaye na zuba duk lokacin.

rows.source: It's hard to explain, but it was on the flight I felt this overwhelming sense of sympathy for Nad.
rows.output: Ba abu ne mai sauƙi a bayyana ba, amma a cikin jirgin ya ji kamar na ji tausayin Nad.
rows.reference: Yanada matukar wahalar bayani, amma a cikin jirgin ne na fara jin wani babban tausayi ga Nad.

rows.source: That he needed my love and understanding.
rows.output: Cewa yana buƙatar soyayyata da fahimta.
rows.reference: Wai yana bukatar soyayya ta da fahimta ta.

rows.source: I knew how much he loved her."
rows.output: Na san yadda yake son ta."
rows.reference: Nasan irin yawan son da yake mata.”

rows.source: Grieving women post cards to prevent suicides on bridge
rows.output: Mata masu baƙin ciki suna aikawa da katunan don hana kashe kansu a kan gada
rows.reference: Mata masu jimami su na aika katunan don hana masu kashe su akan gada

rows.source: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide are working to prevent others from taking their own lives.
rows.output: Mata biyu da suka rasa masu ƙauna ga mutuwar kai suna aiki don hana wasu kashe kansu.
rows.reference: Mata biyu da suka rasa masoyan su ga kashe kansu su na aiki don hana wasu su kashe kansu.

rows.source: Sharon Davis and Kelly Humphreys have been posting cards on a Welsh bridge with inspirational messages and phone numbers that people can call for support.
rows.output: Sharon Davis da Kelly Humphreys suna aikawa da katunan rubutu a kan wani gada na Welsh tare da saƙonnin ƙarfafawa da lambobin waya da mutane za su iya kira don tallafi.
rows.reference: Sharon Davis da Kelly Humphreys su na ta aikatar da katuna a kan gadar Welsh tare da sakonnin wahayi da lambobin waya waɗanda mutane zasu iya kira don tallafawa.

rows.source: Ms Davis' son Tyler was 13 when he began suffering with depression and killed himself aged 18.
rows.output: Ms Davis' son Tyler ya kasance yana da shekaru 13 lokacin da ya fara fama da damuwa, ya kashe kansa yana da shekaru 18.
rows.reference: ‘Dan Ms Davis, Tyler, yana da shekara 13 lokacin da ya fara fama da ciwon bakin ciki kuma ya kashe kansa a shekara 18.

rows.source: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I have to feel everyday," she said.
rows.output: "Ba na son wani iyaye ya ji haka nake ji a kullum," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Ba na son kowane iyaye su ji yadda zan ji a kullun," in ji ta.

rows.source: Ms Davis, aged 45, who lives in Lydney, said her son was a promising chef with an infectious grin.
rows.output: Ms Davis, mai shekaru 45, wacce ke zaune a Lydney, ta ce danta mai shekaru 19 yana da hazaka a matsayin kuku kuma yana da murmushi mai ban sha'awa.
rows.reference: Ms Davis, mai shekaru 45, wacce ke zaune a Lydney, ta ce ɗanta ya kasance mai ba da gudummawa mai cike da ciwo.

rows.source: "Everyone knew him for his smile.
rows.output: "Dukanmu mun san shi da murmushin sa.
rows.reference: “Kowa ya san shi da murmushin shi.

rows.source: They always said his smile lit up any room."
rows.output: Sun ce murmushinshi yana haska kowace daki.
rows.reference: Su na yawan cewa murmushin shi yana haskaka kowane daki.

rows.source: However, he gave up work before he died, as he was "in a really dark place."
rows.output: Amma ya daina aiki kafin ya mutu, domin yana "a cikin wani wuri mai duhu sosai."
rows.reference: Duk da haka, ya bar aikin kafin ya mutu, yayin da yake "a cikin duhu."

rows.source: In 2014, Tyler's brother, who was 11 at the time, was the one to find his sibling after he had taken his own life.
rows.output: A shekarar 2014, dan’uwan Tyler mai shekaru 11 a lokacin ne ya gano ’yar’uwarsa bayan ta kashe kanta.
rows.reference: A shekarar 2014, ɗan'uwan Tyler, wanda yake dan shekara 11 a lokacin, shi ne ya sami gawar dan uwansa bayan ya ɗauki ransa.

rows.source: Ms Davis said: "I continually worry that there's going to be a knock on effect."
rows.output: Ms Davis ta ce: "Ina ci gaba da damuwa cewa za a sami tasirin da zai biyo baya."
rows.reference: Ms Davis ta ce: "Ina ci gaba da damuwa cewa akwai yiwuwar bugawa a kan sakama."

rows.source: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.
rows.output: Ms Davis ta kirkiro katunan, "don sanar da mutane cewa akwai mutane a can da za ku iya zuwa ku yi magana da su, ko da kuwa aboki ne.
rows.reference: Ms Davis ya kirkiro da katunan, "don sanar da mutane akwai mutanen da za ku iya zuwa wajen su kuma za ku iya magana da su, ko da kuwa aboki ne.

rows.source: Don't sit in silence - you need to talk."
rows.output: Kada ka zauna cikin shuru - kana buƙatar magana."
rows.reference: Kar ku zauna shiru- yakamata ku yi magana.”

rows.source: Ms Humphreys, who has been friends with Ms Davies for years, lost Mark, her partner of 15 years, not long after the death of his mother.
rows.output: Ms Humphreys, wacce ta kasance abokiyar Ms Davies shekaru da yawa, ta rasa Mark, abokin tarayya na shekaru 15, ba da daɗewa ba bayan mutuwar mahaifiyarsa.
rows.reference: Ms Humphreys, wacce ta kasance kawa ga Ms Davies na tsawon shekaru, ta rasa Mark, abokin ta na shekaru 15, bayan rasuwar mahaifiyarsa ba da daɗewa ba.

rows.source: "He didn't say that he was feeling down or depressed or anything," she said.
rows.output: "Bai ce yana jin baƙin ko damuwa ko wani abu ba," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Bai ce yana baya jin dadi ko yana cikn damuwa ko wani abu ba," in ji ta.

rows.source: "A couple of days before Christmas we noticed his change in attitude.
rows.output: "Kwanaki biyu kafin Kirsimeti ne muka lura da canjin halinsa.
rows.reference: "Kwanaki biyu kafin Kirsimeti mun lura da canji a yanayin halayyar sa.

rows.source: He was at rock bottom on Christmas Day - when the kids opened their presents he didn't make eye contact with them or anything."
rows.output: A ranar Kirsimeti, ya kasance a ƙasa - lokacin da yara suka buɗe kyautarsu, bai yi musanyar ido da su ko wani abu ba.
rows.reference: Ya kasance a tushen dutsen a ranar Kirsimeti - lokacin da yara suka bude kyaututtukan su bai yarda ya hada ido da su ba,”

rows.source: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.
rows.output: Ta ce mutuwarta babbar matsala ce a gare su, amma dole ne su yi aiki a kai: "Yana haifar da wani rami a cikin iyali.
rows.reference: Ta ce mutuwarsa babbar matsala ce a gare su, amma dole ne suyi aiki ta hanyarsa: "Yana bar gibi a cikin iyalin.

rows.source: It tears us apart.
rows.output: Yana raba mu.
rows.reference: Ya hargitsa mu.

rows.source: But we've all got to carry on and fight."
rows.output: Amma dole ne mu ci gaba da yin faɗa."
rows.reference: Amma dole mu cigaba da rayuwa da gwagwarmaya.”

rows.source: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.
rows.output: Idan kana fama da damuwa, za ka iya kiran masu taimakon masu ra'ayi kyauta a 116 123 (UK da Ireland), ka aika da imel zuwa jo@samaritans.org, ko ka ziyarci gidan yanar gizon masu taimakon masu ra'ayi a nan.
rows.reference: Idan kuna ƙoƙari ku jure, za ku iya kiran Samaritans kyauta akan 116 123 (Birtaniya da Ireland), imail jo@samaritans.org, ko ziyarci shafin yanar gizon Samaritan a nan.

rows.source: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation
rows.output: An bar makomar Brett Kavanaugh a cikin ruwa yayin da hukumar FBI ta fara bincike.
rows.reference: Kasancewar Brett Kavanaugh ya rataya ne a sama, saboda FBI sun fara bincike

rows.source: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.
rows.output: Na yi tunanin, idan za mu iya samun wani abu kamar abin da yake tambaya - binciken da aka takaita a lokaci, da kuma takaitacciyar hanya - za mu iya kawo dan karamin hadewa," in ji Mista Flake a ranar Asabar, inda ya kara cewa yana tsoron cewa kwamitin "yana rabuwa" a tsakanin tsayuwar dandalin jam'iyyu.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin, idan za mu iya samun wani abu kamar abin da yake nema - bincike ne kawai na takaitancen lokaci, a iyakance - yadda za mu iya kawo hadin kai kadan," in ji Mr Flake a ranar Asabar, inda ya kara da cewa yana tsoron kwamitin " ya rabe " saboda yawan ra’ayin siyasa.

rows.source: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?
rows.output: Me yasa Mista Kavanaugh da masu goyon bayan jam'iyyar Republican ba su so 'yan sanda su yi bincike?
rows.reference: Me yasa Mr Kavanaugh da magoya bayan jam'iyyar Republican sun so FBI su bincika?

rows.source: Their reluctance is all due to timing.
rows.output: Jajircensu ya samo asali ne daga lokacin.
rows.reference: Rashin so su ya ta’allaka ne da lokaci.

rows.source: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.
rows.output: Zabenaki na tsakiya ya kai makwanni biyar, a ranar 6 ga Nuwamba - idan, kamar yadda ake tsammani, jam'iyyar Republican ta yi rashin nasara, to za su kasance cikin mawuyacin hali wajen kokarin su samu mutumin da suka zaba ya zama shugaban kotun koli a kasar.
rows.reference: zaben tsakiyar wa’adi na sati biyar ne daga yanzu, a ranar 6 ga watan Nuwamba - idan, kamar yadda ake sa ran, 'yan Republican ba su yi kokari ba, to, za a taba su sosai a yunkurin su na daura mutumin da suke so a zaba zuwa mafi girman kotu a cikin kasa.

rows.source: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.
rows.output: George W. Bush ya kasance yana kiran Sanatan, yana roƙon su su goyi bayan Mista Kavanaugh, wanda ya yi aiki a Fadar White House na Mista Bush kuma ta hanyar shi ya sadu da matarsa ​​Ashley, wacce ita ce sakatariyar sirri ta Mista Bush.
rows.reference: George W. Bush yana ta daga waya yana kiran Sanatoci, yana rokon su don tallafawa Mr Kavanaugh, wanda yayi aiki a fadar White House ga Mr Bush kuma ta wurinsa ya hadu da matarsa Ashley, wanda shi ne magatakarda na Mr Bush.

rows.source: What happens after the FBI produces its report?
rows.output: Me ya faru bayan FBI ta samar da rahoton ta?
rows.reference: Me zai faru bayan FBI ta samar da rahoto?

rows.source: There will be a vote in the Senate, where 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats currently sit.
rows.output: Za a yi zaɓe a Majalisar Dattijai, inda 51 Republican da 49 Democrats suke zaune a yanzu.
rows.reference: Za ayi zabe a majalisar dattijai, inda 'yan Jamhuriyar Republican 51 da 49 Democrats ke zaune yanzu.

rows.source: It's still not clear whether Mr Kavanaugh can get to at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which would allow Mike Pence, the vice president, to break a tie and confirm him to the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Har yanzu ba a bayyana ba ko Mr. Kavanaugh zai iya samun aƙalla kuri'u 50 a kan bene na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, wanda zai ba da damar Mike Pence, mataimaki na shugaban kasa, ya yanke hukunci kuma ya tabbatar da shi a Kotun Koli.
rows.reference: Har yanzu ba a bayyana ko Mr Kavanaugh zai iya zuwa akalla kuri'u 50 a Majalisar Dattijai ba, wanda zai ba Mike Pence, mataimakin shugaban kasa, ya karya tayin kuma ya tabbatar da shi zuwa Kotun Koli.

rows.source: North Korea defector numbers 'drop' under Kim
rows.output: Yawan 'yan gudun hijira na Koriya ta Arewa sun ragu a karkashin Kim.
rows.reference: Lambobin masu murabus a Koriya ta Arewa ya'sauka' a karkashin Kim

rows.source: The number of North Korean defectors to South Korea has fallen since Kim Jong-un came to power seven years ago, a South Korean lawmaker has said.
rows.output: Yawan 'yan gudun hijira daga Koriya ta Arewa zuwa Koriya ta Kudu ya ragu tun bayan da Kim Jong-un ya hau mulki shekaru bakwai da suka gabata, a cewar wani dan majalisar Koriya ta Kudu.
rows.reference: Yawan mutanen Arewacin Koriya masu murabus zuwa Korea ta Kudu ya sauka tun lokacin da Kim Jong-un ya hau mulki a cikin shekaru bakwai da suka gabata, wani mai kula da ka'idoji na Koriya ta kudu ya ce.

rows.source: Park Byeong-seug, citing data from the South's unification ministry, said there had been 1,127 defections last year - compared with 2,706 in 2011.
rows.output: Park Byeong-seug, bisa ga bayanan da ma'aikatar hadin kan ta kudu ta bayar, ya ce an samu ficewa 1,127 a shekarar da ta gabata - idan aka kwatanta da 2,706 a shekarar 2011.
rows.reference: Park Byeong-seug, wanda ya bada bayanai daga ma'aikatar hadin kai ta Kudu, ya ce an samu raguwar murabus 1,127 a bara - idan aka kwatanta da 2,706 a shekarar 2011.

rows.source: Mr Park said tighter border controls between North Korea and China and higher rates charged by people smugglers were key factors.
rows.output: Mista Park ya ce, tsauraran matakan kula da kan iyaka tsakanin Koriya ta Arewa da Sin da kuma ƙarin kuɗin da masu safarar mutane ke biyan su ne manyan abubuwan da suka haifar da hakan.
rows.reference: Mr Park ya ce, karin tsaron kan iyakan da ke tsakanin Koriya ta Arewa da Sin da kuma karin yawan farashin da masu fasa kwari ke yi sun kasance manyan dalilai.

rows.source: Pyongyang has made no public comments.
rows.output: Pongyang ba ta yi wani bayani na jama'a ba.
rows.reference: Pyongyang bai yi wani bayani ba a baya ne.

rows.source: The vast majority of defectors from the North are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.
rows.output: Mafi yawan wadanda suka yi hijira daga arewa ana ba su 'yan ƙasar Koriya ta Kudu a ƙarshe.
rows.reference: Mafi yawan masu murabus daga Arewa su na samun kyautar zama dan kasar Koriya ta kudu.

rows.source: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have illegally crossed the border since the end of the Korean War in 1953.
rows.output: Seoul ta ce sama da 30,000 'yan ƙasar Arewa sun yi garkuwa da iyaka tun bayan yakin Koriya a shekarar 1953.
rows.reference: Seoul ya ce fiye da mutane 30,000 Arewa Koreans sun ketare iyaka ta hanyar haramtacciyar hanya tun lokacin karshen yakin Koriya a 1953.

rows.source: Most flee via China, which has the longest border with North Korea and is easier to cross than the heavily protected Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas.
rows.output: Mafi yawan 'yan gudun hijira suna gudu ta kasar Sin, wadda ke da iyaka mafi tsawo da arewa, kuma tana da sauki a wuce fiye da yankin da aka demobilize (DMZ) tsakanin kasashen biyu.
rows.reference: Yawancin mutane sun tsere daga kasar Sin, wanda ke da dogon iyakaci da Koriya ta Arewa kuma ya fi sauƙin ketarewa fiye da yankin (DMZ) dake da kwakwaran tsaro a tsakanin Korear biyu.

rows.source: China regards the defectors as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly repatriates them.
rows.output: An yi la'akari da 'yan gudun hijira a matsayin 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Sin, kuma sau da yawa suna tilasta dawo da su.
rows.reference: Kasar Sin ta na la'akari da masu murabus a matsayin masu shigowa ba bisa ka’ida ba a maimakon 'yan gudun hijira dan haka su na mai da su.

rows.source: Relations between the North and the South - who are still technically at war - have markedly improved in recent months.
rows.output: Dangantaka tsakanin Arewa da Kudu - waɗanda har yanzu suna cikin yaki - sun samu ci gaba sosai a cikin watanni masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Harkokin dangantaka a Arewa da Kudu - waɗanda har yanzu su na yaki - sun inganta a cikin 'yan watanni.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the leaders of the two countries met in Pyongyang for talks that centred on the stalled denuclearisation negotiations.
rows.output: A farkon wannan wata ne shuwagabannin kasashen biyu suka gana a Pyongyang domin tattaunawar da ta mayar da hankali kan tattaunawar da aka dakata.
rows.reference: Tun a farko wannan watan, shugabannin kasashen biyu sun gana a Pyongyang don tattaunawar da suka danganci tattaunawar sulhun rusa makaman nukiliya.

rows.source: This came after June's historic meeting between US President Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un in Singapore, when they agreed in broad terms to work towards the nuclear-free Korean peninsula.
rows.output: Wannan ya biyo bayan taron tarihi na watan Yuni tsakanin shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da Kim Jong-un a Singapore, inda suka amince a kan manyan sharuɗɗa na aiki don cim ma ƙasar Koriya ba tare da makami ba.
rows.reference: Wannan ya zo bayan taron kafa tarihi Yuni tsakanin shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da Kim Jong-un a Singapore, lokacin da suka amince da yarjejeniyar da za ta kai ga raba kasar da makaman nukiliya.

rows.source: But on Saturday, North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho blamed US sanctions for the lack of progress since then.
rows.output: Amma a ranar Asabar, Ministan Harkokin Waje na Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong-ho ya zargi takunkumin da Amurka ta yi da rashin ci gaba tun lokacin.
rows.reference: Bayan taron Yuni tsakanin shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da Kim Jong-un a Singapore, sun amince da su shiga yarjejeniya don amfani da Jamhuriyyar Arewa maso gabashin Congo.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the US, there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances, there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first," Mr Ri said in a speech to the UN General Assembly in New York.
rows.output: "Ba tare da a yarda da Amurka ba, ba za a yarda da tsaro na kasa ba kuma a cikin irin wannan yanayi, babu wata hanya da za mu yi watsi da kanmu da farko," in ji Mista Ri a jawabin da ya yi wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a New York.
rows.reference: Ya ce, "Ba tare da amincewa da Amurka ba, ba za mu amince da tsaron lafiyarmu ba, kuma a irin wadannan yanayi, babu wata hanyar da za lalata makaman mu da kanmu," in ji Mr Ri a cikin jawabinsa ga Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a birnin New York.

rows.source: Nancy Pelosi calls Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," says he is unfit to serve on the Supreme Court
rows.output: Nancy Pelosi ta kira Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," tana cewa ba shi da cancanta ya yi aiki a kotun koli
rows.reference: Nancy Pelosi ya kira Brett Kavanaugh "mai ban dariya," ya ce bai cacanci aiki a Kotun Koli ba

rows.source: House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi called Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical" and said that he was temperamentally unfit to serve on the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Shugabar ‘yan jam’iyyan adawa Nancy Pelosi ta kira mai neman mukami a kotun koli Brett Kavanaugh da “hysterical” kuma ta ce ba shi da halayyarka ta dace da zama a kotun koli.
rows.reference: Shugaban Jagora na gida Nancy Pelosi da ya kira zababben dan Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh, ya ce "ba shi da cancanta ikon yin aiki a Kotun Koli.

rows.source: Pelosi made the comments in an interview Saturday at the Texas Tribune Festival in Austin, Texas.
rows.output: Pelosi ta yi wannan magana ne a wani hirar da aka yi da ita a ranar Asabar a bikin Texas Tribune a Austin, Texas.
rows.reference: Pelosi ya yi sharhi a wata hirar ranar Asabar a shagali Texas Tribune a Austin, Texas.

rows.source: "I couldn't help but think that if a woman had ever performed that way, they would say 'hysterical,'" Pelosi said about her reaction to Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Thursday.
rows.output: "Ban iya jurewa ba na tunanin cewa idan mace ta taba yin haka, za su ce 'hysterical,' "Pelosi ta ce game da martaninta ga shaidan Kavanaugh a gaban kwamitin majalisar dattijai a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: "Na kasa daina tunanin cewa idan mace ta taba yin irin haka, za su ce 'mai ban dariya,'" Pelosi yace game da amsar ta akan shaidar Kavanaugh a gaban kwamitin majalisar dattijai a ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Kavanaugh emotionally denied allegations that he had sexually assaulted Dr. Christine Blasey Ford when they were both teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh ya musanta da zagi da aka yi masa na cewa ya yi wa Dr. Christine Blasey Ford fyade lokacin da suke matasan.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh cikin yanayi tausayi ya yi watsi da zargin cewa ya kai ma Dr harin jima’i. Christine Blasey Ford lokacin da suke yara duka.

rows.source: During his opening statement, Kavanaugh was very emotional, at times nearly shouting and choking up while discussing his family and his high school years.
rows.output: A lokacin da ya fara magana, Kavanaugh ya yi matuƙar damuwa, a wasu lokuta yana kama da tsawa kuma yana huci yayin da yake magana game da iyalinsa da shekaru na sakandare.
rows.reference: A lokacin jawabinsa na budewa, Kavanaugh ya nuna tausayin sa sosai, a wasu lokuta yana kusan yin kururuwa da shakewa yayin tattaunawa game da iyalinsa da shekarun sa na sakandare.

rows.source: He also explicitly condemned Democrats on the committee, calling the allegations against him a "grotesque and coordinated character assassination" organized by liberals angry that Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 presidential election.
rows.output: Ya kuma yi tsokaci a fili kan Democrats a cikin kwamitin, inda ya kira zargin da ake masa da "mugun harbi da aka tsara" wanda masu ra'ayin mazan jiya suka shirya saboda fushin da Hillary Clinton ta yi a zaben shugaban kasa na 2016.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, ya kushe jam'iyyar Democrat a bayyane akan kwamitin, yana kiran zarge-zarge a kansa "wanda aka yi wa' yan ta'adda, da tsararren dakushe kyawawan halaye", wanda' yan tawayen suka shirya, sun yi fushi da cewa, Hillary Clinton ta fadi zaben shugaban kasar 2016.

rows.source: Pelosi said that she believed Kavanaugh's testimony proved that he could not serve on the Supreme Court, because it showed that he is biased against Democrats.
rows.output: Pelosi ta ce ta yarda da shawaran da Kavanaugh ya yi cewa ba zai iya zama a kotun koli ba, saboda ya nuna cewa yana da son kai ga jam'iyyar Democrat.
rows.reference: Pelosi tace ta yarda cewa shaidar Kavanaugh ta tabbatar da cewa bazai iya yin hidima a kotun koli ba,saboda yana nuna bambanci akan yan jam’iyyar Democrat.

rows.source: "I think that he disqualifies himself with those statements and the manner in which he went after the Clintons and the Democrats," she said.
rows.output: "Ina ganin ya yi watsi da kansa da wadannan furucin da kuma yadda ya bi Clinton da jam'iyyar Democrat," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin cewa ya nuna rashin cancantar sa da wadannan maganganun da irin yadda ya bi bayan Clintons da yan jam’iyyar Democrat," in ji ta.

rows.source: Pelosi demurred when asked if she would try to impeach Kavanaugh if he is confirmed, and if Democrats gain the majority in the House of Representatives.
rows.output: Pelosi ta yi watsi da tambayar ko za ta yi ƙoƙarin tsige Kavanaugh idan an tabbatar da shi, kuma idan jam'iyyar Democrat ta samu rinjaye a majalisar wakilai.
rows.reference: Pelosi ya ta kauce lokacin da aka tambaye ta idan za ta yi kokarin tsige Kavanaugh idan an tabbatar da shi, kuma idan Democrat ta sami mafi rinjaye a majalisar wakilai.

rows.source: "I will say this -- if he is not telling the truth to Congress or to the FBI, then he's not fit not only to be on the Supreme Court, but to be on the court he's on right now," Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Zan ce wannan -- idan ba ya faɗa gaskiya ga Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ko ga FBI, to ba shi da cancanta ba kawai ya kasance a Kotun Koli ba, har ma ya kasance a kotun da yake yanzu."
rows.reference: "Zan ce wannan - idan bai fadi gaskiya ga majalisa ko FBI ba, to, ba kawai koyun koli ne bai dace da shi ba, amma harda kotun da yake a yanzu," in ji Pelos.

rows.source: Kavanaugh is currently a judge on the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals.
rows.output: Kavanaugh a halin yanzu shi ne alkalin kotun daukaka da saukaka ta D.C.
rows.reference: Yanzu haka Kavanaugh ya zama mai hukunci akan D.C. Zagayayyen kotun daukaka kara.

rows.source: Pelosi added that as a Democrat she was concerned about potential Kavanaugh rulings against the Affordable Care Act or Roe v. Wade, as he is considered to be a conservative justice.
rows.output: Pelosi ta kara da cewa a matsayin 'yar jam'iyyar Democrat, tana da damuwa game da yadda za a yanke hukunci na Kavanaugh kan Dokar Kula da Lafiya ko Roe v. Wade, domin ana ganin shi a matsayin alkalin shari'a na hagu.
