rows.reference: Ọ nọ n’ala ala na Ubọchi Ekeresimesi - mgbe ụmụaka mepere onyinye ha anya ya na nke ha akụtaghị ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla.”

rows.source: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.
rows.output: O kwuru na ọnwụ ya bụ nnukwu ihe mgbu nye ha, ma ha ga-arụ ọrụ n'ime ya: "Ọ na-akụnye oghere n'ezinụlọ.
rows.reference: O kwuru na ọnwụ ya bụ nnukwu nkụja n’ebe ha nọ, mana ha ga-arụkọta ọrụ iji gafere ya: “Ọ gbapuru oghere n’ime ezinụlọ ahụ.

rows.source: It tears us apart.
rows.output: Ọ na-akụda anyị.
rows.reference: Ọ na ekewa anyị.

rows.source: But we've all got to carry on and fight."
rows.output: Ma anyị niile ga-aga n'ihu ma lụọ ọgụ."
rows.reference: Mana anyị niile ga-aga n’ihu na agba mgba.”

rows.source: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agbasi mbọ ike, ị nwere ike ịkpọ ndị Samaritans n'efu na 116 123 (UK na Ireland), zipu ozi-e na jo@samaritans.org, ma ọ bụ gaa na webụsaịtị Samaritans ebe a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị na enwe nhịahụ ịga n’ihu, ị nwere ike ịkpọ Samaritans n’efu na 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, ma ọ bụ gaa na weebụsaịtị ndị Samaritans ebe a.

rows.source: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation
rows.output: Ihe ọdịnihu Brett Kavanaugh nọ n'ihe ize ndụ ka ndị FBI malitere nyocha.
rows.reference: Ọdịnihu Brett Kavanaugh tọgbọ n’ikuku ka ndị FBI na ebido nyocha

rows.source: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.
rows.output: "Ekwere m, ma ọ bụrụ na anyị nwere ike nweta ihe dị ka ihe ọ na-arịọ - nyocha nwere oge na oke - anyị nwere ike ịbata n'otu n'otu."
rows.reference: “Echere m, ọ bụrụ na anyị nwere ike ịnweta ihe dị ka ihe ọ na arịọ - nyocha amachiri n’oge, amachiri n’oke - anyị nwere ike iwete obere ịdị n’otu,” Maazị Flake kwuru na Satọde, na etinye na ọ na atụ ụjọ na ọgbakọ ahụ na “etisasi” n’ime mkpọchi ndọrọndọrọ gozusiri ike.

rows.source: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?
rows.output: Gịnị mere Maazị Kavanaugh na ndị na-akwado ya Republican anaghị achọ ka ndị FBI nyochaa?
rows.reference: Gịnị kpatara na Maazị Kavanaugh na ndị nkwado Repọblikan achọghị ka ndị FBI mee nyocha?

rows.source: Their reluctance is all due to timing.
rows.output: N'ihi oge, ha na-ewute.
rows.reference: Enweghị mmasị bụ n’ihi oge.

rows.source: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.
rows.output: Ntuli aka nke etiti oge bụ naanị izu ise site na Nọvemba 6 - ọ bụrụ na, dị ka a tụrụ anya ya, ndị Republican na-eme nke ọma, mgbe ahụ ha ga-enwe nnukwu ihe isi ike n'ịgbalị ị nweta onye ha chọrọ ka a họpụta n'oche kachasị elu n'ala.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka etiti oge bụ naanị n’ime izu ise na abịa, na Nọvemba 6 - ọ bụrụ na, dị ka atụrụ anya, ndị Repọblikan emeghị nke ọma, mgbe ahụ ha agaghị enwe ọtụtụ ike n’ọnwụnwa ha iji nweta nwoke ha chọrọ ka ahọpụta maka ụlọ ikpe kachasị n’ala.

rows.source: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.
rows.output: George W. Bush na-anọkarị na ekwentị ịkpọ ndị omebe iwu, na-agbali ka ha kwado Maazị Kavanaugh, onye rụrụ ọrụ n'ụlọ White House maka Maazị Bush ma zute nwunye ya Ashley, bụ onye ode akwụkwọ nke onwe ya.
rows.reference: George W. Bush na ewelite ekwentị iji kpọọ Ndị Ọmeiwu, na arịọ ha ka ha kwado Maazị Kavanaugh, onye rụrụ ọrụ na White House n’aka Maazị Bush ma site n’aka ya zute nwunye ya Ashley, onye nke bụ ọde akwụkwọ nkeonwe Maazị Bush.

rows.source: What happens after the FBI produces its report?
rows.output: Gịnị ka ọ ga-eme mgbe ndị FBI wepụtara akwụkwọ akụkọ ha?
rows.reference: Gịnị ga-eme mgbe ndị FBI weputere mkpesa ya?

rows.source: There will be a vote in the Senate, where 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats currently sit.
rows.output: A ga-enwe ntuli aka n'ụlọ omebe iwu, ebe ndị Republican iri ise na otu na ndị Democrat iri anọ na itoolu nọ ugbu a.
rows.reference: A ga-enwe ntuli aka na Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, ebe ndị Repọblikan 51 na Demokrat 49 nọ ugbu a.

rows.source: It's still not clear whether Mr Kavanaugh can get to at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which would allow Mike Pence, the vice president, to break a tie and confirm him to the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Ọ ka na-adịghị mma ma Maazị Kavanaugh nwere ike nweta votu iri ise na Senate, nke ga-enye Mike Pence, onye isi ala, ohere ịgbagọta ma kwupụta ya na Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu.
rows.reference: O dobeghi anya ma Maazị Kavanaugh enwere ike ịnweta opekata mpe ntuli aka 50 n’ala Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, nke ga-enye Mike Pence ohere, osote onye isi ala, ịkpọ ndapụta ya ma tinye ya na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị.

rows.source: North Korea defector numbers 'drop' under Kim
rows.output: nọmba ndị na-agbapụ na North Korea 'na-ada' n'okpuru Kim
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ ndị gbapụrụ na North Korea ‘gbadara’ n’okpuru Kim

rows.source: The number of North Korean defectors to South Korea has fallen since Kim Jong-un came to power seven years ago, a South Korean lawmaker has said.
rows.output: Ndị na-agbapụ na North Korea na South Korea agbadala kemgbe Kim Jong-un ghọrọ onye ọchịchị afọ asaa gara aga, onye omebe iwu South Korea kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ ndị gbapụrụ na North Korea gbagara South Korea agbadaala kemgbe Kim Jong-un banyere n’ọchịchị afọ asaa gara aga, onye ọmebe iwu South Korea kwuru.

rows.source: Park Byeong-seug, citing data from the South's unification ministry, said there had been 1,127 defections last year - compared with 2,706 in 2011.
rows.output: Park Byeong-seug, na-ekwu okwu sitere na ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka nchekwube nke ndịda, kwuru na e nwere mgbapụta 1,127 n'afọ gara aga - ma e jiri ya tụnyere 2,706 n'afọ 2011.
rows.reference: Park Byeong-seun, na arụtụ aka na data si na minitri njikọta South, kwuru na enweela mgbapụ 1,127 n’afọ gara aga - tụlee yana 2,706 na 2011.

rows.source: Mr Park said tighter border controls between North Korea and China and higher rates charged by people smugglers were key factors.
rows.output: Mazi Park kwuru na njikwa oke ala dị n'etiti North Korea na China na ọnụego dị elu nke ndị na-azụ ahịa na-akwọ ụgbọ mmiri bụ ihe ndị dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Maazị Park kwuru njikwa oke ala kpachikwuru akpachi n’etiti North Korea na China yana ụgwọ dị elu ndị na akpọfe ndị mmadụ na ana socha n’ihe ndị kpatara ya.

rows.source: Pyongyang has made no public comments.
rows.output: Pyongyang emela okwu ọha.
rows.reference: Pyongyang agwabeghị ọhaneze ihe ọ bụla.

rows.source: The vast majority of defectors from the North are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.
rows.output: Ihe ka ọtụtụ ndị na-apụ n'ebe ugwu na-enweta ikike obodo South Korea n'ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: A na enye ọtụtụ nke ndị gbapụrụ si na North akwụkwọ amaala nke South Korea.

rows.source: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have illegally crossed the border since the end of the Korean War in 1953.
rows.output: Seoul na-ekwu na ihe karịrị 30,000 ndị North Korea na-akwaga n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị n'ókèala ahụ kemgbe njedebe nke Agha Korea na 1953.
rows.reference: Seoul kwuru na ihe gafere ndị North Korea 30,000 gafere oke ala ahụ n’ụzọ dara iwu kemgbe ngwụcha nke Ọgụ Korea na 1953.

rows.source: Most flee via China, which has the longest border with North Korea and is easier to cross than the heavily protected Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị na-agbapụ site na China, nke nwere oke ala kacha ogologo na North Korea na ọ dị mfe ịgafe karịa ókè ndị a na-echebe nke ọma (DMZ) n'etiti Korea abụọ.
rows.reference: Imirikiti na esi China agbapụ, nke nwere oke ala kachasị ogologo n’etiti North Korea ma ka dị mfe ịgafe karịa Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) echedosiri ike n’etiti Korea abụọ ahụ.

rows.source: China regards the defectors as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly repatriates them.
rows.output: China na-ewere ndị na-agbapụ agbapụ dị ka ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ na-enweghị ikike kama ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ma na-akpagbu ha n'ike.
rows.reference: China na ahụta ndị ahụ gbapụrụ ọsọ ka ndị mgbabata dara iwu karịa ndị mgbabata ọsọ ndụ ma jiri iwe kpọghachi ha.

rows.source: Relations between the North and the South - who are still technically at war - have markedly improved in recent months.
rows.output: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti North na South, bụ́ ndị ka na-alụ ọgụ - n'ụzọ iwu - emewokwa nke ọma n'ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga.
rows.reference: Mmekọrịta n’etiti North na South - ndị ka nọ n’ọgụ - enwela mmelite ahụrụ anya n’ọnwa nso nso a.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the leaders of the two countries met in Pyongyang for talks that centred on the stalled denuclearisation negotiations.
rows.output: N'oge gara aga, ndị isi mba abụọ ahụ zutere na Pyongyang maka mkparịta ụka nke lekwasịrị anya na mkparịta ụka ndị a kwụsịrị.
rows.reference: Na mbido ọnwa a, ndị isi nke obodo abụọ ahụ hụrụ na Pyongyang maka ekwumekwu gbadoro na ụbụbọ mkposa ngwa ọgụ nuklịa.

rows.source: This came after June's historic meeting between US President Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un in Singapore, when they agreed in broad terms to work towards the nuclear-free Korean peninsula.
rows.output: Nke a sochiri nzukọ akụkọ ihe mere eme nke June n'etiti Onye isi ala US Donald Trump na Kim Jong-un na Singapore, ebe ha kwetara n'ozuzu na ha ga-arụ ọrụ maka mpaghara Korea na-enweghị nuklia.
rows.reference: Nke a bịara ka nnukwu nzụkọ Juun mere n’etiti Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump na Kim Jong-un na Singapore, mgbe ha kwenyere n’isiokwu sara mbara iji rụkọta ọrụ maka ala mmiri Korea na enweghị ngwa ọgụ nuklịa.

rows.source: But on Saturday, North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho blamed US sanctions for the lack of progress since then.
rows.output: Ma n'ụbọchị Satọde, Mịnịsta na-ahụ maka ihe ndị mba ọzọ nke North Korea, Ri Yong-ho, boro ebubo na mmachi ndị US bụ ihe kpatara na enweghị ọganihu kemgbe ahụ.
rows.reference: Mana na Satọde, Minista Ofesi nke North Korea Ri Yong-ho tara ntaramahụhụ ndị US ụta maka ọganihu na adịghị kemgbe ahụ.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the US, there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances, there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first," Mr Ri said in a speech to the UN General Assembly in New York.
rows.output: "Na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi ọ bụla na US, enweghị ntụkwasị obi na nchekwa anyị. N'okpuru ọnọdụ ndị a, enweghị ụzọ anyị ga-esi wepụ onwe anyị n'onwe anyị n'otu n'otu." Maazị Ri kwuru na okwu ya na ọgbakọ ndị isi mba ụwa na New York.
rows.reference: “Na enweghị ntụkwasị obi na US, agaghị enwe okwukwe na nchedo obodo anyị yana n’ụdịrị ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, enweghị ụzọ ọ bụla anyị ga-esi bụrụ ụzọ kwekọrịta otu oge ịkwasa ngwa ọgụ anyị,” Maazị Ri kwuru n’okwu na Mgbakọ Ezumezu UN na New York.

rows.source: Nancy Pelosi calls Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," says he is unfit to serve on the Supreme Court
rows.output: Nancy Pelosi na-akpọ Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," na-ekwu na ọ bụghị ya kwesịrị ịnọ n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu
rows.reference: Nancy Pelosi kpọrọ Brett Kavanaugh “isi mgbaka,” o kwuru na o tozughi iji rụọ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị

rows.source: House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi called Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical" and said that he was temperamentally unfit to serve on the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Onye isi oche ndị na-emegide Nancy Pelosi kpọrọ onye a họpụtara maka Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, Brett Kavanaugh, "ọnwụnwa" ma kwuo na ọ nweghị àgwà kwesịrị ekwesị iji rụọ ọrụ na Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu.
rows.reference: Onye Ndu Ndị Ntakịrị N’ụlọ Nzụkọ Nancy Pelosi kpọrọ onye nhọpụta maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Kavanaugh “isi mgbaka” ma kwuo na ọ na ewe iwe ọkụ iji rụọ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị.

rows.source: Pelosi made the comments in an interview Saturday at the Texas Tribune Festival in Austin, Texas.
rows.output: Pelosi kwuru okwu a n'ajụjụ ọnụ na Satọde na Texas Tribune Festival na Austin, Texas.
rows.reference: Pelosi kwuru okwu ndị ahụ n’ajụjụ ọnụ na Satọde na Texas Tribune Festival na Austin, Texas.

rows.source: "I couldn't help but think that if a woman had ever performed that way, they would say 'hysterical,'" Pelosi said about her reaction to Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Thursday.
rows.output: "Agaghị m akwụsị iche na ọ bụrụ na nwanyị emeworo otu a, ha ga-asị 'ọ na-enwe obi ụtọ,'" ka Pelosi kwuru banyere mmeghachi omume ya na nkwado Kavanaugh n'ihu Kọmitii Nchebe Senate na Tọzdee.
rows.reference: “Enwenwughi m ike ịkwụsị ịche na ọ bụrụ na nwanyị mee ụdịrị ihe ahụ, ha ga-ekwu ‘isi mgbaka,”” Pelosi kwuru maka mmetụta ya n’ihe akaebe Kavanaugh n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu na Tọsde.

rows.source: Kavanaugh emotionally denied allegations that he had sexually assaulted Dr. Christine Blasey Ford when they were both teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh ekpughere na ọ na-ewute ya na ebubo na o metọrọ Dr. Christine Blasey Ford mgbe ha bụ ndị na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh jiri nnukwu mwute gọnarị ebubo ndị ahụ na ọ wakporo Dk. Christine Blasey Ford n’ike mgbe ha abụọ bụ ndị ntorobịa.

rows.source: During his opening statement, Kavanaugh was very emotional, at times nearly shouting and choking up while discussing his family and his high school years.
rows.output: N'oge mmalite ya, Kavanaugh nwere mmetụta dị ukwuu, na mgbe ụfọdụ ọ na-afụ ụfụ ma na-akwa ákwá mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka ezinụlọ ya na afọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị ya.
rows.reference: N’oge nkwupute mmepe ya, mmụọ Kavanaugh di elu nke ukwuu, oge ụfọdụ ọ na achọ iti mkpu ma olu a na agbagbu ya ka ọ na ekwu maka ezinụlọ ya yana afọ ụlọ akwụkwọ kọleji ya.

rows.source: He also explicitly condemned Democrats on the committee, calling the allegations against him a "grotesque and coordinated character assassination" organized by liberals angry that Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 presidential election.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwukwa okwu n'ụzọ doro anya megide ndị Democrats nọ na kọmiti ahụ, na-akpọ ebubo e boro ya "ihe na-adịghị mma na nhazi nke igbu mmadụ" nke ndị liberals na-ewute na Hillary Clinton meriri ntuli aka onyeisiala nke afọ 2016.
rows.reference: Ọ kọtọkwara ndị Demokrat nọ n’ọgbakọ ahụ n’ụzọ doro anya, na akpọ ebubo emere ya “mgbagbu omume dị egwu n’anya, akpara akpa” nke ndị mmesapụ ahụ na ewe iwe na Hillary Clinton dara na ntuli aka onye isi ala 2016 haziri.

rows.source: Pelosi said that she believed Kavanaugh's testimony proved that he could not serve on the Supreme Court, because it showed that he is biased against Democrats.
rows.output: Pelosi kwuru na o kwenyere na ikpe Kavanaugh gosiri na ọ gaghị enwe ike ịnọ n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, n'ihi na o gosiri na ọ na-akwadosi ike ndị Republican.
rows.reference: Pelosi kwuru na ọ kwenyere na akaebe nke Kavanaugh gosiri ọ nweghị ike ịrụ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị, n’ihi o gosiri na ọ nweghị mmasị n’ebe ndị Demokrat nọ.

rows.source: "I think that he disqualifies himself with those statements and the manner in which he went after the Clintons and the Democrats," she said.
rows.output: "Ekwenyesiri m na na o na-akpasu onwe ya na okwu ndị ahụ na otu o si chụọ ndị Clinton na ndị Democrats."
rows.reference: O kwuru “echere m na ọ kagburu onwe ya site na iji okwu ndị ahụ yana n’ụzọ o si kwutọọ Clintons yana ndị Demokrat,”

rows.source: Pelosi demurred when asked if she would try to impeach Kavanaugh if he is confirmed, and if Democrats gain the majority in the House of Representatives.
rows.output: Pelosi jụrụ ajụjụ ma ọ ga-agbalị ịkpọpụta Kavanaugh ma ọ bụrụ na a kwadoro ya, ma ọ bụrụ na ndị Democrats nwetara ọtụtụ n'ime ụlọ ndị omebe iwu.
rows.reference: Pelosi dajụrụ mgbe ajụrụ ma ọ ga-achọ iwepu Kavanaugh ma ọ bụrụ na etinye ya n’oche, ma ọ bụrụ na ndị Demokrat nweta ọnụọgụgụ karịrị na Ụlọ nke Ndị Nnọchite.

rows.source: "I will say this -- if he is not telling the truth to Congress or to the FBI, then he's not fit not only to be on the Supreme Court, but to be on the court he's on right now," Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Agwa m ga-ekwu nke a -- ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị eziokwu o na-ekwu ndị omebe iwu ma ọ bụ ndị FBI, mgbe ahụ ọ bụghị ya ka ọ ga-adị na Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, ma ọ bụ na ụlọikpe ọ nọ ugbu a."
rows.reference: “M ga-ekwu nke a -- ọ bụrụ na ọ naghị agwa Kọngress ma ọ bụ ndị FBI eziokwu, mgbe ahụ ọ bụghị naanị na o tozughi ịnọ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị, ma ị nọ n’ụlọ ikpe ọ nọ na ya ugbu a,” Pelosi kwuru.

rows.source: Kavanaugh is currently a judge on the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals.
rows.output: Kavanaugh bụ onye ọka ikpe ugbu a na Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu nke D.C.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh bụ nnukwu ọka ikpe na D.C. Ụlọ Ikpe Sekuit nke Arịrịọ Mkpegharị.

rows.source: Pelosi added that as a Democrat she was concerned about potential Kavanaugh rulings against the Affordable Care Act or Roe v. Wade, as he is considered to be a conservative justice.
rows.output: Pelosi gbakwunyere na dị ka onye Democrat, ọ na-echegbu onwe ya banyere mkpebi ndị nwere ike ime Kavanaugh megide Affordable Care Act ma ọ bụ Roe v. Wade, ebe a na-ewere ya dị ka onye ikpe na-ekwenye ekwenye.
rows.reference: Pelosi kwukwara na ka onye Demokrat na ọ nwere nchegbu maka ntimiwu Kavanaugh ga-adị maka Affordable Care Act ma ọ bụ Roe v. Wade, ebe a na ahụta ya ka akwụmụtọ na egbochi mgbanwe.

rows.source: In his confirmation hearings, Kavanaugh sidestepped questions on whether he would overturn certain Supreme Court decisions.
rows.output: N'oge nyocha ya, Kavanaugh zụrụ ajụjụ banyere ma ọ ga-atụgharị ụfọdụ mkpebi Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu.
rows.reference: N’ọnụnụ itinye ya n’oche, Kavanaugh leghara ajụjụ ma ọ ga-atụgharị ụfọdụ mkpebi Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị.

rows.source: "It's not time for a hysterical, biased person to go to the court and expect us to say, 'isn't that wonderful,'" Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị oge maka onye na-enwe mmetụta uche na onye nwere echiche nke ọma ịga n'ụlọikpe ma na-atụ anya anyị ka anyị kwuo, 'ọ bụghị ihe magburu onwe ya?'" ka Pelosi kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị oge maka isi mgbaka, onye na asọ ihe iji gaa n’ụlọ ikpe ma tụọ anya na anyị ga-ekwu, “ọ na nke ahụ adịghị mma,”” Pelosi kwuru.

rows.source: And Women Need to Wield It.
rows.output: Na ụmụ nwanyị kwesịrị iji ya mee ihe.
rows.reference: Ụmụ Nwanyị Kwesịrị Iji Ya.

rows.source: It is a righteous diatribe, months and years of fury spilling over, and she can't get it out without weeping.
rows.output: Ọ bụ okwu ziri ezi, ọnwa na afọ nke iwe na-agbapụta, ọ na-enwekwa nsogbu ịwepụ ya na-enweghị ịkpagbu.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nkatọ ziri ezi, ọnwa na afọ iwe ọkụ na awofu, ọ nweghị ike ikwupute ya na ebeghị akwa.

rows.source: "We cry when we get angry," Ms. Steinem said to me 45 years later.
rows.output: "Anyị na-ebe akwa mgbe anyị na-enwe iwe," Ms. Steinem kwuru m n'afọ iri anọ na ise ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: “Anyị na ebe akwa mgbe iwe were anyị,” Nwada Steinem gwara m n’afọ 45 gachara.

rows.source: "I don't think that's uncommon, do you?"
rows.output: "Amaghị m na nke ahụ bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị, ọ bụ gị?"
rows.reference: “Echeghị m na nke bụ ihe ọhụrụ, ọ ihe ị che?”

rows.source: She continued, "I was greatly helped by a woman who was an executive someplace, who said she also cried when she got angry, but developed a technique which meant that when she got angry and started to cry, she'd say to the person she was talking to, "You may think I am sad because I am crying.
rows.output: Ọ gara n'ihu, "Enyere m aka nke ukwuu site n'aka nwanyị bụ onye isi oche ebe, onye kwuru na ọ na-ebe akwa mgbe ọ na-enwe iwe, ma mụta usoro nke pụtara na mgbe ọ na-enwe iwe ma malite ịka akwa, ọ ga-agwa onye ọ na-agwa, "Ị nwere ike iche na m na-ewute m n'ihi na m na-ebe akwa.
rows.reference: Ọ gara n’ihu, “Enwetara m nnukwu enyemaka n’aka nwanyị bụ otu onye isi oche n’otu ebe, onye kwuru na ya onwe ya bekwara akwa mgbe ọ na ewe iwe, mana ọ mụtara ụzọ nke pụtara mgbe ọ were iwe ma bido ịbe akwa, ọ ga-agwa onye ọ na agwa okwu, “Ị nwere ike ịche na m nwere obi mwute n’ihi na m na ebe akwa.

rows.source: I am angry."
rows.output: "Ana m agbawa."
rows.reference: Iwe na ewe m.”

rows.source: And then she just kept going.
rows.output: Na mgbe ahụ ọ na-aga n'ihu.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ ọ ga-agaba n’ihu.

rows.source: And I thought that was brilliant."
rows.output: Na m chere na nke ahụ bụ ihe ọhụrụ."
rows.reference: M chere na nke ahụ mara oke mma.”

rows.source: Tears are permitted as an outlet for wrath in part because they are fundamentally misunderstood.
rows.output: Mmiri na-ekwe ka ọ bụrụ ụzọ esi efunahụ iwe n'ihi na a na-ejighị ya kpọrụ ihe.
rows.reference: A na anabata anya mmiri ka mwepu maka iwe n'otu akụkụ n’ihi nghọta ya doro anya.

rows.source: One of my sharpest memories from an early job, in a male-dominated office, where I once found myself weeping with inexpressible rage, was my being grabbed by the scruff of my neck by an older woman - a chilly manager of whom I'd always been slightly terrified - who dragged me into a stairwell.
rows.output: Otu n'ime ihe ndị m na-echeta nke ọma site n'ọrụ mbụ m, n'ụlọ ọrụ ndị nwoke na-achị, bụ ebe mụ na ndị ọrụ ibe m na-akpakọrịta, bụ mgbe m hụrụ onwe m ka m na-ebe akwa n'ụzọ na-enweghị ike ikwupụta iwe. Ihe mere bụ na otu nwanyị okenye, onye njikwa na-atụ m egwu, onye m na-atụghị anya ya, were m n'olu wee dọkpụrụ m n'ime ụlọ mposi.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ncheta m kachasị foo n’anya m bụ n’ọrụ m na mbido, ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ nwoke gafere, ebe m hụrụ onwe m ka na ebe anya na nnukwu iwe, ka otu agadi nwanyị dọkpụrụ m n’azụ onu m - onye njikwa juru oyi onye m na atụtụ ụjọ - onye dọbara m n’akwa nrigo.

rows.source: "Never let them see you crying," she told me.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mgbe ị ga-enye ha ohere ịhụ gị na-ebe akwa," ọ gwara m.
rows.reference: “Ekwena ka ha hụ gị ebe ị na ebe akwa, “ọ gwara m.

rows.source: "They don't know you're furious.
rows.output: "Ha amaghị na ị na-enwe iwe.
rows.reference: “Ha amaghị na nnukwu iwe ji gị.

rows.source: They think you're sad and will be pleased because they got to you."
rows.output: Ha chere na ị na-ewute ma ha ga-enwe obi ụtọ n'ihi na ha nwetara gị."
rows.reference: Ha chere na ị na enwe obi mwute, ọ ga-atọ ha ụtọ n’ihi na ha nwetara gị.”

rows.source: Patricia Schroeder, then a Democratic congresswoman from Colorado, had worked with Gary Hart on his presidential runs.
rows.output: Patricia Schroeder, onye bụbu onye omebe iwu Democratic si Colorado, rụkọrọ ọrụ na Gary Hart n'ọrụ onye isi ala ya.
rows.reference: Patricia Schroeder, mgbe ahụ bụ nwanyị kọngress Demokrat si na Colorado, rụụrụ Gary Hart ọrụ n’ọsọ onye isi ala ya.

rows.source: In 1987, when Mr. Hart was caught in an extramarital affair aboard a boat called Monkey Business and bowed out of the race, Ms. Schroeder, deeply frustrated, figured there was no reason she shouldn't explore the idea of running for president herself.
rows.output: N'afọ 1987, mgbe Maazị Hart nwetara n'ime ihe na-akparị di na nwunye n'ụgbọ mmiri a na-akpọ Monkey Business ma wepụrụ onwe ya n'ọsọ ahụ, Oriakụ Schroeder, nke nwere nkụda mmụọ, chọpụtara na ọ nweghị ihe mere na ọ gaghị achọ ịnwale echiche nke ịgba ọsọ maka onye isi ala n'onwe ya.
rows.reference: Na 1987, mgbe ejidere Maazị Hart na mmekọ nwanyị na abụghị nwunye ya n’elu ụgbọ mmiri akpọrọ Monkey Business, ọ pụrụ n’ọsọ ahụ, Nwada Schroeder, na nnukwu iwe, chọpụtara na enweghị ihe kpatara na ọ gaghị eche maka ịpụta maka onye isi ala n’onwe ya.

rows.source: "It was not a well-thought-out decision," she said to me with a laugh 30 years later.
rows.output: "Ọ bụghị mkpebi e chepụtara nke ọma," ka o kwuru m n'olu ọchị mgbe afọ iri atọ gachara.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị echiche echere nke ọma, “ọ gwara m ya n’ọchị ka afọ 30 gachara.

rows.source: "There were already seven other candidates in the race, and the last thing they needed was another one.
rows.output: "Enwere ndị na-azọ ọkwa asaa ọzọ n'ọsọ ahụ, na ihe ikpeazụ ha chọrọ bụ onye ọzọ.
rows.reference: “Enweela ndị nhọpụta asaa ndị ọzọ n’ọsọ ahụ, ihe ọzọ ha achọghị bụ onye ọzọ.

rows.source: Somebody called it "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.""
rows.output: Onye ọzụzụ kpọrọ ya "Snow White na Dwarfs asaa."
rows.reference: Otu onye kpọrọ ya “Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.””

rows.source: Because it was late in the campaign, she was behind on fund-raising, and so she vowed that she wouldn't enter the race unless she raised $2 million.
rows.output: N'ihi na oge agbapụla n'oge mgbasa ozi, ọ nọ n'azụ n'ịtọrụ ego, ya mere, kwere nkwa na ọ gaghị abata n'ọsọ ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwetara nde $2.
rows.reference: N’ihi ọ bịaghị n’oge na mgbasa ozi ahụ, ọ nọ n’azụ na ịkpakọta ego, ya mere o jiri nwụọ iyi na ọ gaghị abanye n’ọsọ ahụ belụsọ na ọ nwetara nde $2.

rows.source: It was a losing battle.
rows.output: Ọgọ́ aghọ̀ na-adịgharị.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ọgụ a ga-ada.

rows.source: She discovered that some of her supporters who gave $1,000 to men would give her only $250.
rows.output: Ọ chọpụtara na ụfọdụ ndị na-akwado ya bụ́ ndị nyere $1,000 nye ụmụ nwoke ga-enye ya naanị $250.
rows.reference: Ọ chọpụtara na ụfọdụ ndị nkwado ya nyere ụmụ nwoke $1000 nyere ya naanị $250.

rows.source: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.
rows.output: "Ọ na-eche ma ha chere na m na-enweta mbelata?"
rows.reference: “Ị chere na m nwere ike ịnweta mwepu ego?” ọ tụlere.

rows.source: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.
rows.output: Mgbe o kwuru okwu ya na ọ gaghị ebido mgbọrọgwụ, obi tọgburu ya nke ukwuu - obi ụtọ maka ndị mmadụ na-akwado ya, iwe na usoro nke mere ka ọ sie ike ịkpọta ego na ịtọ ndị na-ahọpụta kama ndị nnọchianya, na iwe na okike - na ọ na-ewute ya.
rows.reference: Mgbe o kwuru okwu ya na ọ gaghị ebido mgbasa ozi n’uju, nnukwu obi mmụọ juputara ya n’ahụ - ekele maka ndị mmadụ kwadoro ya, iwe na sistemụ mere ka o sie nnukwu ike ịkpakọta ego ma gbado anya na ndị ntuli aka karịa ndị nnọchite, yana iwe na ịkpa oke nwoke na nwanyị - o gbadoro ya n’onu.

rows.source: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.
rows.output: "Ị gaara eche na mụ na-agbaji uche," ka Ms. Schroeder kwuru banyere ka ndị mgbasa ozi si eme ihe banyere ya.
rows.reference: “Ị nwere ike ịche na m nwere nnukwu ụjọ,” Nwada Schroeder chetara maka otu ndị nta akụkọ si wee hụta ya.

rows.source: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.
rows.output: "Ị ga-eche na Kleenex bụ onye na-akwado ụlọ ọrụ m.
rows.reference: “Ị nwere ike ịche na Kleenex bụ ụlọ ọrụ na akwado m.

rows.source: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?
rows.output: A na m eche, kedụ ihe ha ga-edobe n'elu ili m.
rows.reference: M chetara mgbe n eche, kedu ihe a ga-etinye n’okwute dị n’ili m?

rows.source: "She cried"?""
rows.output: "O tiri"?
rows.reference: Ọ bere akwa”?””

rows.source: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing
rows.output: Olee otu agha ahia US-China nwere ike isi na-erite uru n'obodo Beijing
rows.reference: Otu ọgụ azụmahịa US-China nwere ike isi dịịrị Beijing mma

rows.source: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.
rows.output: Mgbalị ndị mbụ nke agha ahịa dị n'etiti US na China dị egwu, na ọ bụ ezie na agha ahụ ka na-aga n'ihu, ọ nwere ike ịbụ na nkewa dị n'etiti mba abụọ ahụ ga-adị mma maka Beijing n'oge ogologo, ndị ọkachamara na-ekwu.
rows.reference: Mbuso agha mbido nke ọgụ azụmahịa dị n’etiti US na China kpuchiri nti, ebe ọgụ ahụ tere aka na ngwụcha, nkewa n’etiti obodo ndị ahụ nwere ike ibuteere Beijing elele n’ọdịnihu, ndị ọkachamara kwuru.

rows.source: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.
rows.output: Onye isi ala US, Donald Trump, malitere ịdọ aka ná ntị mbụ n'isi afọ a site n'ịtọ ụgwọ na mbupụ ndị China dị mkpa dị ka panẹli anyanwụ, ígwè na aluminiom.
rows.reference: Donald Trump, Onye isi ala US, buru ụzọ dọọ aka na ntị na mbido afọ a site na itinye ụtụ isi na ahịa mbupu ndị China gụnyere sọla panel, steel na aluminium.

rows.source: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.
rows.output: Mgbapụta kachasị mkpa na-abanye n'izu a na tarifụ na-emetụta $200 ijeri (£150 ijeri) nke ihe, na-ata ụgwọ ọkara nke ihe niile na-abịa na US site na China.
rows.reference: Mkpalite kachasị gosipụta batara n’izu a nwere ụtụ isi ọhụrụ na emetụta ọnụọgụ ijeri $200 (ijeri £150) n’ọnụahịa ngwaahịa, na etinye ụtụ isi n’ọkara ngwaahịa niile na esi na China abata US.

rows.source: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.
rows.output: Obodo Beijing enwetala n'ụzọ dị iche iche, na n'oge na-adịbeghị anya, ọ tinyere ụtụ isi ise ruo iri pasent na ngwaahịa $60 ijeri nke America.
rows.reference: Beijing megwara oge ọ bụla n’ụdịrị ahụ, nke nso nso a ịmanye ụtụ isi nke pasentị ise ruo iri n’elu ngwaahịa ndị America ruru ọnụọgụ ijeri $60.

rows.source: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.
rows.output: China ekweela nkwa ime ka US mee, na akụ na ụba kasị ukwuu n'ụwa na-adịghị ada ada.
rows.reference: China ekweela nkwa ịmakọ ndị US kwa mmereme, akụnụba obodo nke abụọ kachasị n’ụwa enweghị ike ịtabi anya n’oge ọ bụla dị anya.

rows.source: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.
rows.output: Ịtọhapụ Washington ka ọ daa n'ala pụtara ịgbaso ihe ha chọrọ, ma ịgbaso ndị US n'ihu ọha ga-abụ ihe na-akụda mmụọ nke ukwuu maka Xi Jinping, onye isi ala China.
rows.reference: Ịme ka ndị Washington gbatuo pụtara ịkwenye na ihe ndị achọrọ, mana ịkpọọrọ ndị US isi n’ihu ọhaneze ga-abụ nnukwu ihere maka Xi Jinping, onye isi ala nke China.

rows.source: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị nke ahụ, ndị ọkachamara na-ekwu na ọ bụrụ na Beijing nwere ike igwuri egwu ka ọ dị mma, nrụgide agha azụmahịa US nwere ike ịkwado China n'ụzọ dị mma n'oge ogologo oge site n'ibelata mmekọrịta dị n'etiti akụ na ụba abụọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkachamara ka na ekwusi ike na ọ bụrụ na Beijing ga-egwu kaadị ya nke ọma, akwumọkụ ọgụ azụmahịa US nwere ike ịkwado China n’ụzọ dị mma n’ọdịnihu site na iwedata ndabekọrịta dị n’etiti akụnụba abụọ ahụ.

rows.source: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.
rows.output: "Ọ bụ eziokwu na mkpebi ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị ngwa ngwa na Washington ma ọ bụ Beijing nwere ike ime ka ọnọdụ ndị na-amalite ịda mbà n'obi akụ na ụba na mba ọ bụla, bụ ihe dị ize ndụ karịa ka ndị na-ele anya kwuru na mbụ," ka Abigail Grace, onye nyocha nke na-elekwasị anya na Eshia na Center for New American Security, ụlọ ọrụ echiche.
rows.reference: “Na mmereme mkpebi ndọrọndọrọ mere ngwangwa na Washington ma ọ bụ Beijing nwere ike ịmepụta ọnọdụ na ebido ọgbaghara akụnụba n’ime otu obodo abụọ ahụ ka bụrụ ihe egwu karịa ihe ndị nlele kwenyegoro na mbụ,” Abigail Grace kwuru, onye nyocha na agbado anya na Asia na Center for New American Security, ndị ndụmọdụ.

rows.source: Syria 'ready' for refugees to return, says Foreign Minister
rows.output: Suriya 'adị njikere' maka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ịlaghachi, onye minista mba ofesi kwuru.
rows.reference: Syria ‘dị nkwadobe’ maka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ịlaghachite, Minista Ofesi kwuru

rows.source: Syria says it's ready for the voluntary return of refugees and is appealing for help to rebuild the country devastated by a more than seven-year long war.
rows.output: Suriya na-ekwu na ọ dị njikere maka ịlaghachi nke ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ n'efu ma na-arịọ maka enyemaka iji wughachi obodo ahụ mebiri emebi site na agha ogologo nke karịrị afọ asaa.
rows.reference: Syria kwuru na ọ dị nkwadobe maka nlaghachite nke ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ n’onwe ha, na arịọ maka enyemaka na ịrụgharị obodo ahụ nke ihe karịrị ọgụ nọrọ ogologo afọ asaa mebichara.

rows.source: Speaking to the United Nations General Assembly, Foreign minister Walid al-Moualem said conditions in the country are improving.
rows.output: N'okwu ya na United Nations General Assembly, Mịnịstrị na-ahụ maka mba ofesi Walid al-Moualem kwuru na ọnọdụ dị na mba ahụ na-emeziwanye.
rows.reference: Ikwu okwu n’ihu Mgbakọ Ezumezu United Nations, minista Ofesi Walid al-Moualem kwuru na ọnọdụ n’obodo ahụ na emelite.

rows.source: "Today the situation on the ground is more stable and secure thanks to progress made in combating terrorism," he said.
rows.output: "Taa ọnọdụ n'ala ka dịkwuo n'otu na nchekwa n'ihi ọganihu e nwere n'ịlụso iyi egwu ọgụ."
rows.reference: O kwuru “taa ọnọdụ dị n’ala ka dị mma ma nwee nchedo, ekele dịịrị ọganihu emere na igbochi ndị ọlụọ ọlaa,”.

rows.source: The government continues to rehabilitate the areas destroyed by terrorists to restore normalcy.
rows.output: Gọọmentị na-aga n'ihu na-eme ka mpaghara ndị ndị na-eyi ọha egwu bibiri dịghachi n'usọ.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị gara n’ihu na edozigharị mpaghara ndị ọlụọ ọlaa mebiri iji weghachite ihe otu o si adịbu.

rows.source: All conditions are now present for the voluntary return of refugees to the country they had to leave because of terrorism and the unilateral economic measures that targeted their daily lives and their livelihoods.
rows.output: Ugbu a, ọnọdụ niile dị maka ịlaghachi n'ụlọ n'efu nke ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, bụ ndị ha hapụrụ obodo n'ihi iyi egwu na ihe ndị na-eme ka akụ na ụba na-akpaghasị ha.
rows.reference: Ọnọdụ niile dị ugbu a maka nlaghachite nke ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ n’obodo ha hapụrụ n’ihi ndị ọlụọ ọlaa yana ụkpụrụ akụnụba nke otu ndị ezubere na obibi ndụ ha yana ọrụ aka ha.

rows.source: The UN estimates that more than 5.5 million Syrians have fled the country since the war began in 2011.
rows.output: Ndị UN na-atụ anya na ihe karịrị nde 5.5 ndị Siria apụọla n'obodo ahụ kemgbe agha malitere na 2011.
rows.reference: Ndị UN kpebiri na ihe gafere ọnụọgụgụ ndị Syria nde 5.5 agbafuola n’obodo ahụ kemgbe ọgụ ahụ bidoro na 2011.

rows.source: Another six million people still living in the country are in need of humanitarian assistance.
rows.output: Ndị mmadụ nde isii ọzọ na-aga n'ihu na-ebi n'obodo ahụ chọrọ enyemaka mmadụ.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụọgụ nde isii ọzọ ka bi n’ime obodo ahụ chọrọ enyemaka ndị mmadụ.

rows.source: Al-Moualem said the Syrian regime would welcome help in rebuilding the devastated country.
rows.output: Al-Moualem kwuru na ndị ọchịchị Syria ga-anabata enyemaka n'ịrụpụta obodo ahụ nke ihe mebiri emebi.
rows.reference: Al-Moualem kwuru na ọchịchị Syria ga-anabata enyemaka na ịrụgharị obodo ahụ mebiri emebi.

rows.source: But he stressed that it would not accept conditional assistance or help from countries that sponsored the insurgency.
rows.output: Ma o kwuru na ọ gaghị anabatakwa enyemaka ma ọ bụ enyemaka na-adịghị mma site n'aka mba ndị kwadoro ọgba aghara ahụ.
rows.reference: Mana o kwusikwara ike na ọ gaghị anabata enyemaka nwere ọnọdụ ma ọ bụ enyemaka si n’aka obodo ndị na akwado ọgbaghara ahụ.

rows.source: Europe clinches Ryder Cup victory in Paris
rows.output: Europe meriri na Ryder Cup na Paris
rows.reference: Europe jidere mmeri Ryder Cup na Paris

rows.source: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
rows.output: Otu Europe meriri 2018 Ryder Cup, na-emeri Team USA site na akara ikpeazụ nke 16.5 ruo 10.5 na Le Golf National n'èzí Paris, France.
rows.reference: Team Europe meriri 2018 Ryder Cup site na imeri Team USA na akara ikpeazụ nke 16:5 ruo 10.5 na Le Golf National na mpuga Paris, France.

rows.source: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
rows.output: N'ime ala US, ha enwetala mmeri ugboro isii na-esochi na ala Europe ma ha enwetabeghị mmeri na Ryder Cup na Europe kemgbe 1993.
rows.reference: Ndị US adaala ugboro isiii bịakọrọ ọnụ n’ala Europe, ha emeribeghị Ryder Cup na Europe kemgbe 1993.

rows.source: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.
rows.output: Europe laghachiri n'isi dị ka ndị otu Danish Captain Thomas Bjorn nwetara isi 14.5 ha chọrọ iji merie United States.
rows.reference: Europe weghachitere okpu eze ahụ ka otu nke kaptịn Thomas Bjorn nke Denmark ruru akara 14.5 ha chọrọ iji merie United States.

rows.source: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.
rows.output: Phil Mickelson nke US, onye gbara ọsọ n'oge egwuregwu ahụ, tụbara bọọl ya n'ime mmiri na ọkpọkọ 16, na-ekwe ka ọ tụfuo egwuregwu ahụ nye Francesco Molinari.
rows.reference: Onye ama ama nke US Phil Mickelson, onye nwere ọtụtụ nsogbu n’asọmpi ahụ, pianyere bọọlụ ya n’ime mmiri na ọkụkụ-3 maka oghere nke 16, tufuru asọmpi ya n’aka Francesco Molinari.

rows.source: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.
rows.output: Onye na-egwu bọọlụ Italy bụ Molinari na-egbuke egbuke n'ime oge niile, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ otu n'ime ndị egwuregwu anọ na-eme nke ọma 5-0-0 kemgbe a na-eme usoro asọmpi a ugbu a na 1979.
rows.reference: Onye gọlfụ nke Italy bụ Molinari mere nke ọma n’oge ya niile, bụrụ onye egwu 1-nke-4 iji gaa 5-0-0 kemgbe usoro asọmpi ahụ di ugbu a bidoro na 1979.

rows.source: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.
rows.output: Onye America bụ Jordan Spieth meriri onye egwuregwu kachasị ala na otu European, Thorbjorn Olesen nke Denmark, site na 5&4.
rows.reference: Jordan Spieth nke America dara 5na4 n’aka onye egwu pekarịsịrị n’ọkwa n’ime otu ndị Europe, Thorbjorn Olesen nke Denmark.

rows.source: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Onye ọkpụkpọ kacha elu n'ụwa, Dustin Johnson, dara 2 na 1 nye Ian Poulter nke England bụ onye nwere ike igwu egwuregwu ikpeazụ ya na Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Onye egwu kachasị n’ọkwa n’ụwa, Dustin Johnson, dara 2 na 1 n’aka Ian Poulter nke England onye nke nwegoro ike igwu na Ryder Cup ikpeazụ ya.

rows.source: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.
rows.output: Onye na-agba ọsọ n'ụgbọ mmiri nke asatọ, onye Spen bụ Sergio Garcia ghọrọ onye na-eme egwuregwu nke Europe niile na-ewulite ihe mgbaru ọsọ 25.5 n'oge ọrụ ya.
rows.reference: Onye ochie nke Ryder Cups, onye Spain Sergio Garcia bụrụ onye Europe kachasị nwee mmeri na asọmpi ahụ, onye nwere akara 25.5 n’ogologo oge egwuregwu ya.

rows.source: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.
rows.output: "Ana m ejighị anya na-ewute m, ma taa, enweghị m ike igbochi ya.
rows.reference: “Anaghị m ebekarị akwa mana taa enweghị m ike ịkwụsị ya.

rows.source: It's been a rough year.
rows.output: O nwere afọ a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ afọ siri ike.

rows.source: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.
rows.output: Obi dị m ụtọ maka Thomas ịhọrọ m na ikwere m.
rows.reference: Ana m ekele Thomas maka ịhọpụta m ma kwenye na m.

rows.source: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.
rows.output: Obi dị m ụtọ, obi dị m ụtọ ịnwetaghachi iko ahụ.
rows.reference: Obi juru m n’anụrị, enwere m obi anụrị ịnwetakwa iko ahụ ọzọ.

rows.source: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.
rows.output: Ọ bụ maka otu ahụ, na obi dị m ụtọ na m nwere ike inye aka," ka onye na-enwe mmetụta uche Garcia kwuru mgbe mmeri Europe gasịrị.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ maka ndị otu ahụ., enwere m anụrị na m nwere ike ịnyere aka,” nke Garcia juputara na mmụọ kwuru na mmeri Europe ahụ.

rows.source: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.
rows.output: Ọ na-ebufe okwute ahụ nye onye otu obodo ya bụ John Ram bụ onye meriri onye ama ama gọlfụ US bụ Tiger Woods 2&1 n'egwuregwu otu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Ọ nyefere mpịọkụ ahụ n’aka onye obodo ibe ya John Ram onye nke gbaturu ọkaibe gọlfụ Tiger Woods nke US 2na1 n’asọmpi otu na otu na Sọnde.

rows.source: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.
rows.output: "Obi dị m ụtọ nke ukwuu, imeri Tiger Woods, m tolitere na-ekiri onye ahụ."
rows.reference: “Nnukwu nganga a m nwere, imeri Tiger Woods, m na elele nwoke ahụ ka m na etolite,” Rahm dị afọ 23 kwuru.

rows.source: Woods lost all four of his matches in France and now has a record of 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.
rows.output: Woods tụfuru egwuregwu anọ niile na France ma ugbu a o nwere ndekọ nke 13-21-3 na Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Wood tufuru asọmpi anọ ya niile na France, ugbu a ọ nwere ndekọ nke 13-21-3 nke asọmpi ndekọ Ryder Cup.

rows.source: A strange statistic by one of the greatest players of all-time, having won 14 major titles second to only Jack Nicklaus.
rows.output: Otu ihe na-adịghị mma nke otu n'ime ndị egwuregwu kachasị ukwuu n'oge niile, na-emeri ihe nrite 14 dị mkpa nke abụọ naanị Jack Nicklaus.
rows.reference: Ọgụgụ na atụ n’anya nke otu n’ime ndị egwu kachasị n’oge niile, merigoro nnukwu iko 14 naanị onye nke abụọ n’azụ Jack Nicklaus.

rows.source: Team USA struggled all weekend to find the fairways with the exception of Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas and Tony Finau, who played high-calibre golf throughout the entire tournament.
rows.output: Otu USA na-agbasi mbọ ike n'izu ụka niile ịchọta ụzọ dị mma, ewezuga Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas na Tony Finau, ndị gbara bọọlụ dị elu n'oge niile asọmpi ahụ.
rows.reference: Team USA tara ahụhụ n’izu ụka niile iji chọta ụzọ gara aga wepuga naanị Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas na Tony Finau, ndị gwuru gọlfụ dị oke elu na asọmpi ahụ niile.

rows.source: US captain Jim Furyk spoke after a disappointing performance for his squad, "I'm proud of these guys, they fought.
rows.output: Onye isi ndị US bụ Jim Furyk kwuru mgbe arụmụka na-adịghị mma maka otu ya, "Obi dị m ụtọ n'ihe ndị a, ha lụrụ ọgụ.
rows.reference: Kaptịn US bụ Jim Furyk kwuru okwu ka ọ nwechara egwuregwu na adịghị mma maka otu ya, “Enwere m obi dị elu n’ebe ndị a nọ, ha gbara mgba.

rows.source: There was time this morning when we put some heat on Europe.
rows.output: O nwere oge n'ụtọ a ka anyị na-etinye okpomọkụ na Europe.
rows.reference: Enwere oge n’ụtụtụ a mgbe anyị chara ndị Europe ọkụ.

rows.source: We scrapped.
rows.output: Anyị kpọpụrụ.
rows.reference: Anyị dara.

rows.source: Hats off to Thomas.
rows.output: Ndo maka Thomas.
rows.reference: Ekele dịịrị Thomas.

rows.source: He is a great captain.
rows.output: Ọ bụ nnukwu onye isi.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ezigbo kaptịn.

rows.source: All 12 of his players played very well.
rows.output: Ndị egwuregwu iri na abụọ niile ya na-egwu nke ọma.
rows.reference: Ndị egwu 12 niile ahụ gwuru egwu nke ọma.

rows.source: We'll regroup, I'll work with the PGA of America and our Ryder Cup Committee and we'll move forward.
rows.output: Anyị ga-akpakọrịta, m ga-arụkọ ọrụ na PGA nke America na ndị otu anyị na-ahọpụta maka Ryder Cup, anyị ga-aga n'ihu.
rows.reference: Anyị ga-ahazigharị, m na ndị PGA nke America yana Ọgbakọ Ryder Cup ga-arụkọta ọrụ, anyị ga-aga n’ihu.

rows.source: I love these 12 guys and I'm proud to serve as captain.
rows.output: Ana m enwe mmasị na ndị ikom iri na abụọ a ma na-ewute m ịbụ onye isi.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ m ụmụ nwoke 12 a n’anya, obi dị m elu ịrụ ọrụ ka kaptịn.

rows.source: You have to tip your cap.
rows.output: Ị ga-etipịa okpu gị.
rows.reference: Ị ga-akpọ isi n’ala.

rows.source: We got outplayed."
rows.output: Anyị meriri."
rows.reference: Emeriri anyị nke ọma.”

rows.source: Red Tide Update: Concentrations decrease in Pinellas, Manatee and Sarasota
rows.output: Mmelite Red Tide: Mbelata na Pinellas, Manatee na Sarasota
rows.reference: Mmelite Mmiri Anụnụ: Mbịakọta belatara na Pinellas, Manatee na Sarasota

rows.source: The newest report from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission shows a general decrease in Red Tide concentrations for parts of the Tampa Bay area.
rows.output: Akụkọ ọhụrụ sitere na Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission na-egosi mbelata n'ozuzu na Red Tide maka akụkụ ụfọdụ nke mpaghara Tampa Bay.
rows.reference: Mkpesa kachasị ọhụrụ si na Florida Fish na Wildlife Commission na egosi mbelata zuru ọnụ na mbịakọta Mmiri Anụnụ maka akụkụ nke mpaghara Tampa Bay.

rows.source: According to the FWC, patchier bloom conditions are being reported in areas of Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte and Collier counties - which suggests decreasing concentrations.
rows.output: Dị ka FWC si kwuo, a na-akọ na ọnọdụ ifuru na-adị n'ụdị dị iche iche na mpaghara Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte na Collier - nke na-egosi na ọkọnọ na-ebelata.
rows.reference: Site na FWC, a na ekpesa ọnọdụ ntoju mpekere na mpaghara obere obodo nke Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte na Collies - nke na atụnye mbịakọta na ebelata.

rows.source: A bloom the Red Tide extends approximately 130 miles of coastline from northern Pinellas to southern Lee counties.
rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ na-acha uhie uhie na-agbatị ihe dị ka kilomita 130 nke coastline site na ugwu Pinellas ruo na ndịda Lee.
rows.reference: Ntoju nke Mmiri Anụnụ ahụ na adọtị ihe ruru maịlụ 130 nke akụkụ osimiri bido n’akụkụ ugwu nke Pinellas ruo ndịda obere obodo Lee.

rows.source: Patches can be found about 10 miles offshore of Hillsborough County, but at fewer sites relative to last week.
rows.output: A na-ahụ patches n'ime ihe dị ka kilomita iri n'ofè nke obodo Hillsborough, ma n'ebe ole na ole ma e jiri ya tụnyere izu gara aga.
rows.reference: Enwere ike ịhụ mpekere n’ihe dị ka maịlụ 10 akụkụ mmiri nke Hillsborough County, mana n’ebe ole ma ole na erughi nke izu gara aga.

rows.source: Red Tide has also been observed in Pasco County.
rows.output: Mmiri Uhie ahụ hụkwara na Pasco County.
rows.reference: Achọpụtakwala Mmiri Anụnụ na Pasco County.

rows.source: Medium concentrations in or offshore of Pinellas County have been reported in the past week, low to high concentrations offshore of Hillsborough County, background to high concentrations in Manatee County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Sarasota County, background to medium concentrations in Charlotte County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Lee County, and low concentrations in Collier County.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ n'ime ma ọ bụ n'oké osimiri nke Pinellas County, obere ruo nnukwu n'oké osimiri nke Hillsborough County, ndị na-adịghị ike ruo nnukwu n'ime Manatee County, ndị na-adịghị ike ruo nnukwu n'ime ma ọ bụ n'oké osimiri nke Sarasota County, ndị na-adịghị ike ruo ndị dị n'etiti Charlotte County, ndị na-adịghị ike ruo ndị dị elu n'ime ma ọ bụ n'oké osimiri nke Lee County, na obere n'ime Collier County.
rows.reference: Ekpesara ọkara mbịakọta na ma ọ bụ n’akụkụ mmiri nke Pinellas Country n’izu gara aga, mbịakọta obere ruo na nke dị elu n’akụkụ mmiri nke Hillsborough County, mbịakọta mgbakwasa ruo na nke dị elu na Manatee County, mbịakọta mgbakwasa ruo na nke dị elu na ma ọ bụ n’akụkụ mmiri nke Sarasota County, mbịakọta mgbakwasa ruo na ọkara na Charlotte County, mbịakọta mgbakwasa ruo na nke dị elu na ma ọ bụ n’akụkụ mmiri nke Lee County, yana mbịakọta dị obere na Collier County.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation continues to be reported in Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, and Collier counties.
rows.output: Mgbaka ume na-aga n'ihu na-akọ na Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, na Collier counties.
rows.reference: A ka na ekpesa mmekpa ahụ iku ime na obodo Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, na Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation was not reported in Northwest Florida over the past week.
rows.output: Mgbaka ume adịghị ka a na-akọ na North West Florida n'ime izu gara aga.
rows.reference: Ekpesaghị mmekpa ahụ iku ume na akụkụ Ugwu na ọdịda anyanwụ nke Florida n’ofe izu gara aga.
